en:
Shine the spotlight on me please,
we can't see anything here!
zh: 请用聚光灯照着我，我们这里什么都看不见！

en: Shine some light for me!! I can't see anything in there!
zh: 帮我打个光！！这里头我什么都瞧不见！

en:
Shine the spotlight on me please,
we can't see anything here!
zh: 请用聚光灯照着我，我们这里什么都看不见！

en: Shine some light for me!! I can't see anything in there!
zh: 帮我打个光！！这里头我什么都瞧不见！

en:
Well, they seem to have had a good time.
Maybe too good a time?
zh: 嚯，他们玩得挺嗨啊。是不是嗨过头了？

en: That's not right.
zh: 那不对劲。

en: Ah! What are those things?? Corpses!??
zh: 啊！那些是什么东西？？尸体吗？？

en: Am I still hallucinating or what?
zh: 我这是又出现幻觉了吗，怎么回事？

en: Corey, we're leaving!
zh: 科里，我们走！

en: No! We have to know what happened to the others!
zh: 不！咱们需要弄清楚其他人都跑哪去了！

en: take a bat too, it can be useful.
zh: 顺便搞一根球棒，防身用得着。

en: Are you... Are you sure you don't want to leave?
zh: 你……你确定咱们不走吗？

en: Not without knowing what's going on here.
zh: 在没搞清这鬼地方出什么事之前，我绝不走。

en: Are you getting anywhere?
zh: 你那边搞定没？

en:
It's the hacking program that
I had written to change my notes.
zh: 这就是我之前写来篡改期末分数的黑客软件。

en: It's old but it seems to work.
zh: 虽然版本老了点，但凑合能用。

en:
These campus geeks used some
famous people's names as codes.
zh: 这帮学校的死极客居然拿名人的名字当密码。

en: Famous people, like the lead singer of the Good Parrots?
zh: 名人？比如“好鹦鹉”乐队的主唱？

en:
Of course not ! Some famous people like...
Leonard De Vinci, Christopher Columbus...
zh:
当然不是！都是些真正的名人…
比如达芬奇、克里斯托弗·哥伦布…

en: I'm hanging with a real Geek!
zh: 我居然在跟一个纯种技术宅鬼混！

en: That worked out great for you when you crashed your PC.
zh:
当初你电脑蓝屏急得团团转的时候，
还不是求着我帮你修？

en: I just hope the others are ok.
zh: 我只希望其他人能平平安安的。

en: We'll find out soon enough what's going on.
zh: 咱们很快就能搞清楚是怎么一回事了。

en: Maybe it's a robbery!
zh: 没准是有人入室抢劫！

en:
A robbery? At Fallcreek?!...
Just like that, in the middle of the forest!?...
zh:
抢劫？在秋溪大学？！……在
这荒郊野岭的森林里吗？！

en: Alright, stop it. You're making me lose my concentration.
zh: 行了，别说了。你让我没法静下心了。

en: There we go! We can go inside!
zh: 搞定！我们可以进去了！

en: Yes! You're the best.
zh: 太牛了！你最厉害了。

en:
What a mess! The ones who did that
sure don't like reading much.
zh: 这一地狼藉！砸这地方的家伙绝对平时不爱读书。

en: To think that we were supposed to have a fun evening.
zh: 亏我先前还指指望今晚能过得开开心心呢。

en: Yeah, well, we'll be happy just to survive.
zh: 是啊，现在只要能捡回一条命，就烧高香了。

en: There's a passageway up there.
zh: 上面有一条通道。

en: We still have to reach it. You're the ape-man, you go first!
zh: 够是能够到，不过你应该是属猴的，你先上！

en:
With a little bit of effort, I have
to be able to hoist myself up there.
zh: 只要稍微使点劲，我应该能把自己拉上去。

en: Humph!
zh: （哼声）

en: Oh no! Not again!
zh: 卧槽！又来这套！

en: Get him!
zh: 干死它！

en: Humph! Come on, get up here!
zh: 来，快上来！

en: Ahhh!!!! Pull me up!!! Pull me up!!!
zh: 啊！！！拽我一把！！！快把我拉上去！！！

en: Man! These guys are real book worms huh?
zh: 我的天！这帮家伙生前是把书当饭吃了吗？

en: There's blood on the floor, better be careful.
zh: 地板上有血迹，最好小心点。

en: Two horribly mutilated students.
zh: 两名被残忍肢解的学生。

en: Hey! What is that thing?!  It's alive!
zh: 我去！这他妈是什么鬼玩意？！它居然还是活的！

en: I don't like that. I don't like that Corey!
zh: 这感觉太不妙了。科里，我真的很害怕！

en: Stay with me babe! Above all, don't touch it!
zh: 宝贝，跟紧我！千万别碰这脏玩意！

en: Hey ok, I'm not stupid!
zh: 行啦，我又不是傻子！

en:
Wait! The resistance of these things comes
from the special proteins contained in their blood.
zh:
等等！这些怪物的抵抗力源自
它们血液中所含的特殊蛋白质。

en:
They are especially concentrated around the heart,
which contains tissue that oxidizes more slowly.
zh:
这些蛋白质集中在心脏周围，
因为心脏的组织氧化速度较慢。

en:
Use this syringe to take some
blood directly from the organ.
zh: 用这个注射器直接从那个器官中抽点血。

en:
The oxidized proteins will give you an energy boost.
I assure you: it's completely harmless.
zh:
这些被氧化的蛋白质能让你干劲满满。我保证：
这药剂绝对安全无副作用。

en:
In order to recover blood samples,
use the syringe on the hearts before they disappear.
zh:
为了收集血液样本，请在心脏消失之前，
在它们身上使用注射器。

en: It will give you an effective serum.
zh: 这会给你提供有效的血清。

en: That went well...
zh: 进展很顺利嘛…

en: I feel like vomiting...
zh: 恶心死我了，真是反胃……

en: No OBSCURE 2 saved game available.
zh: 未检测到《恶夜杀机2》的存档。

en: Loading.
zh: 加载中…

en: Unable to load!
zh: 无法加载！

en: Save the game?
zh: 保存游戏吗？

en: Do you really want to overwrite this saved game?
zh: 你真的要覆盖这个存档吗？

en: Saving.
zh: 正在保存。

en: Save failed!
zh: 保存失败！

en: I know this model.
zh: 我知道这个型号。

en: Where did you learn to do that?
zh: 你跟哪学的这开锁手艺？

en: During the week I spent in jail...
zh: 在我坐牢的那一个星期里…

en:
Yeah... I needed some money. Someone
made me an attractive proposition.
zh:
是啊…那会儿缺钱花，
正好有人给我指了条赚快钱的野路子。

en: A stupid scam, you mean.
zh: 你是指跟着傻乎乎去搞诈骗吧。

en: Yeah. A stupid mistake. My last one, fortunately.
zh:
对，一脚踩进泥潭里了。
不过幸好，这是我最后一次犯蠢。

en: OK. I've opened it.
zh: 好，我打开了。

en: Not bad at all!
zh: 行啊，挺有一手！

en: Let's go!
zh: 我们走！

en: The Fallcreek dam...
zh: 秋溪水坝…

en:
If we want to put our injured there,
we'll have to clean out the parasites.
zh:
要想把伤员安顿过来，
咱们要先去把里面的脏东西清理干净。

en:
This "thing". It looks like the spores
that we were injected with at Leafmore.
zh:
这“东西”。
它看起来很像我们在利夫莫尔高中时被注射的孢子。

en: No, it's different this time... I can feel it...
zh: 不，这次不太一样…我能感觉得到…

en: Let me have a look. I think I can do something about it.
zh: 让我看看，我想我能做点什么。

en: Are you getting anywhere?
zh: 你那边搞定没？

en:
I feel that I am linked with the spores, but they...
are releasing something evil... I have to be careful...
zh:
我感觉自己和那些孢子连上了，
但它们…在释放某种很诡异的力量…要当心点…

en: Something has changed in you...
zh: 你身上发生了一些改变…

en: Many things have changed.
zh: 很多事情都变了。

en:
Yeah you've mastered all of this...
While I have become addicted to pills.
zh:
是啊，你把这股力量玩得挺转…
而我却成了一个药罐子。

en: Your willpower, Stan. That's the real medicine.
zh: 你的意志力才是真正的解药，斯坦。

en: What a mess. It looks like a squat.
zh: 这鬼地方太烂了，跟难民营似的。

en: Yeah. I lived in a slum like that not so long ago.
zh: 是啊，前不久我也在类似的猪窝里凑合过。

en: Die!
zh: 去死吧！

en: What a disgusting pile of fat!
zh: 真是一坨恶心透顶的死肥肉！

en:
Students transformed by a flower.
Doesn't that remind you of something?
zh:
花把学生变成这样，
这有没有让你想起点什么？

en: Yes... The weed keeps coming back.
zh: 没错，这鬼花就跟杂草一样割完又长。

en: I don't understand... about Kenny.
zh: 我不明白…肯尼为什么会这样。

en:
He shouldn't have smelled that flower.
That made things worse.
zh:
他不该去闻那朵花的。
那让情况变得更糟了。

en:
Mmm... You have to admit that it's not easy...
having this thing... inside us.
zh: 唉，毕竟身体里塞着这么个鬼东西…换谁都不好受。

en:
You need to try to stay sane.
I wouldn't want to have to kill you.
zh: 你最好脑子放清醒点，我可不想回头亲手把你崩了。

en: Don't get carried away. I'm managing.
zh: 少瞎操心了，我心里有数。

en: Try not to die now...
zh: 现在可千万别死了…

en: You're dreaming. I'm not done yet.
zh: 做你的美梦去吧，老子还没那么容易死。

en: Aie!
zh: 哎哟！

en: I should have known...
zh: 我早该知道的…

en: Please, not a word.
zh: 拜托，别说了。

en: We must be below water level.
zh: 我们现在一定在水位线以下。

en:
This is the ideal landmark for
a lowlife like Kenny: it's dark, and it stinks.
zh:
对于肯尼这种人渣来说，
这里简直是完美的藏身处，因为又黑又臭。

en: The turbine room...
zh: 是涡轮机房

en: These things seem pretty dangerous.
zh: 这些东西看起来非常危险。

en: No way. It'll be as easy as eating pancakes!
zh: 怎么可能，这还不是随便搞！

en:
We'll take on the world if we need to,
but we're going to find Amy...
zh:
哪怕与整个世界为敌，
我们也要找到艾米…

en: Come on Sven, it's your turn to get moving now!
zh: 来吧，斯文，轮到你动起来了！

en: What's this huge thing?
zh: 这个大家伙是什么？

en: No idea. A sewage machine, maybe.
zh: 不知道，也许是污水处理机吧。

en: It stinks around here.
zh: 这地方真是臭的要死。

en: Whenever it hurts, think about what he did to Mei!
zh: 每次感到痛苦时，想想他对王梅做过的事！

en: I think about her a lot actually...
zh: 其实，我经常会想起她…

en: Accept me as I am Shannon!
zh: 接受现在的我吧，夏侬！

en: I'll accept you when you are dead.
zh: 等你咽了气，我倒是能勉强接受你。

en: You're not going to come out of this alive!
zh: 你休想活着离开这里！

en: I've already taken from you what I wanted.
zh: 我已经从你身上得到了我想要的东西。

en: You let me down, little sister.
zh: 你让我失望了，妹子。

en: That's not true. I'm trying to help you to die!
zh: 别装了，我其实是在帮你早日超生！

en:
Can anyone hear me? Amy is trapped inside
the dam. We need welding equipment.
zh:
能听到我说话吗？艾米被困在水坝里了。
我们需要焊接设备。

en: It's Sven. We're on our way! We're almost there!
zh: 我是斯文。我们正在路上！马上就到！

en: Hey, viking-dude, get yer butt over here pronto!
zh: 嘿，那个维京野人，麻溜地滚过来！

en: I'm coming you little snot-rag.
zh: 催什么催，你这惹人嫌的跟屁虫。

en:
The professor modified the syringe. Now it will hold
more blood or serum or whatever, to inject ourselves with.
zh:
教授改装了注射器。现在它可以容纳更多血液、
血清或其他能注射进我们体内的东西。

en: Yummy.
zh: 真美味。

en: I don't want to think about it: it makes no sense whatsoever.
zh: 我不想去琢磨这事，这根本说不通。

en: Is Amy still down there?
zh: 艾米还在下面吗？

en: Yeah. She hasn't moved.
zh: 嗯，她一动不动。

en: She'll be OK if we fix the freight elevator controls.
zh: 只要我们修好货运电梯的控制面板，她就会没事的。

en: What's the matter?
zh: 怎么了？

en:
Nothing. It'll be OK. As soon as these
medicines start having an effect.
zh: 没事，会好起来的，只要这些药开始起效。

en:
The professor is going around the rooms,
looking for another entrance. He just left.
zh: 教授正在各房间里转悠，寻找另一个入口，他刚出去。

en: BACH
zh: BACH

en: BELL
zh: BELL

en: DALI
zh: DALI

en: KANT
zh: KANT

en: I hope there'll be some cute guys there.
zh: 我希望那里头能有几个帅哥。

en: Right. What about me then?
zh: 呃，那我不算？

en: You're not a guy Kenny, you're a friend.
zh: 算了吧，肯尼，你在我这不算男人，只是个死党。

en: No comment.
zh: 我无语了。

en:
We're gonna have a hard time getting in without the twins.
They know some guys from the brotherhood, unlike us.
zh:
如果没有那对双胞胎，我们想进去可就难了。
她们不像我们，她们认识兄弟会里的几个人。

en: Don't worry, I'm on it...
zh: 放心吧，我来搞定…

en: Maybe this will change that bouncer's mind...
zh: 也许这个能让那个保安改变主意…

en: Don't be a pain Kenny, we're in, it's cool...
zh: 别犯傻了，肯尼，我们已经进来了，没事的…

en: Are you sure this is a good idea?
zh: 你确定这是个好主意吗？

en:
Of course! This place is full of kids from good families
who spend their cash partying hard!
zh:
那必须的！这地方满街都是有钱人家的少爷小姐，
正挥金如土寻欢作乐呢！

en: Yep and we're gonna get wrecked at their expense.
zh: 没错，今天咱们也跟着蹭吃蹭喝，不醉不归！

en:
Stupid bimbo! I offer her a little kissing
action and she doesn't want to!
zh:
真是个装清高的傻妞！
小爷我赏光想跟她亲热亲热，她还不识抬举！

en: Maybe you shouldn't have thrown up on her first dude...
zh: 哥们，好歹你刚才别先吐人家一身啊……

en: So what do I have to do then?
zh: 那我到底该怎么办？

en: C'mon... Let's have another drink.
zh: 好啦…我们再去喝一杯。

en:
Yeah! Let's go! Her friend's not bad actually,
I reckon I could have her no problem.
zh:
没错！说起来，她旁边那朋友身材有点劲爆啊，
看我过去把她拿下！

en: We must be able to get in from up there!
zh: 我们一定能从上面进去！

en:
That we've come to this, having to
climb up on the roof to get to a party.
zh: 蹭个派对居然还要翻屋顶，真是头回见。

en:
Could you drag this crate over there,
I can't do it, I'm just a weak girl.
zh:
帅哥，能帮我把这箱子挪过去吗？
人家力气小，搬不动嘛。

en: Yeah, sure.
zh: 行，好说。

en: Hmm, I like to see you work out.
zh: 啧啧，我就爱看你流汗卖力气的样子。

en:
Yeah? Does it make you all hot and sweaty for me?
I could use the exercise!
zh:
真的？看得你心里小鹿乱撞了没？
这点体力活刚好当热身！

en: Don't worry, I'm sure someone will take pity on you inside.
zh: 别担心，我相信里面会有人关照你的。

en: All these glasses... Looks like someone got a head start.
zh: 这么多杯子…看来有人早就先喝上了。

en: Look, they forgot their dirty magazines.
zh: 哟，连这儿都落了本小黄书。

en: So rich kids are human beings after all.
zh: 看来这帮有钱少爷也是俗得很。

en: What is this mess?
zh: 这乱七八糟的是搞什么？

en: Well... People had fun!
zh: 这个嘛…看来大家玩得很疯！

en: But...
zh: 但是…

en: They've engraved a code.
zh: 他们刻下了一串密码。

en: Just hurry up Amy...
zh: 快点啦，艾米…

en: Aw, what's the matter? Are you scared?
zh: 哟，怎么着？这就怂啦？

en: No, I want to know what's going on here!
zh: 不，我想知道这里到底发生了什么！

en: Do you see? These guys look cooked to me!
zh: 看见没？我觉得这帮人全都嗨过头了！

en: I somehow doubt it...
zh: 不知怎么的，我不太相信…

en: These guys are fanatics.
zh: 这帮家伙是狂热分子。

en:
Maybe their principles are somewhat
more... serious than ours.
zh:
也许他们有自己的行事准则……
呃，比我们认真多了。

en: Like I said: they are fanatics.
zh: 就像我说的：他们是狂热分子。

en: Man, what is all this madness!!!?
zh: 我的妈呀，这鬼地方到底怎么了！！！？

en: Oh my God, it can't be true! What a nightmare!
zh: 哦，我的天，这不可能是真的！简直是场噩梦！

en: I don't believe it... It's happening again!
zh: 我不相信…这种事又发生了！

en: What are you talking about?
zh: 你在说什么啊？

en:
At the college I was at, two years ago,
students died from crap like this.
zh:
两年前我读的高中里，
就有学生因为这种鬼东西死掉了。

en: I thought that was just a local myth...
zh: 我原以为那只是个当地的都市传说…

en: And I suppose what we just killed was a local myth, was it?
zh: 那咱们刚才弄死的那个怪物，也是个‘传说’呗？

en: We ought to take a look downstairs.
zh: 我们应该去楼下看看。

en: I don't know Kenny.
zh: 我拿不准，肯尼。

en: Would you rather stay here and die?
zh: 你更愿意留在这里等死吗？

en: Huh.
zh: 呃。

en: What a bloodbath!
zh: 简直杀疯了！

en:
Oh my god... We can't stay here!!!
They're going to tear us to pieces!!
zh: 它们会把咱们给生吞活剥了的！！

en: Crap! What now?
zh: 该死！现在怎么办？

en: Aargh!
zh: 啊！

en: Those things are fast!
zh: 那些东西速度太快了！

en: Don't leave me Kenny, for heaven's sake!
zh: 肯尼，看在天老爷的份上，别丢下我！

en: Don't worry we'll get out of here.
zh: 别担心，我们会逃出去的。

en: And we have to find the others!
zh: 而且我们必须找到其他人！

en: Let's first try and get out there.
zh: 我们还是先想办法逃到外面去吧。

en: Aargh!
zh: 啊！

en: They're coming from everywhere!
zh: 它们从四面八方冲过来了！

en: This is getting worse...
zh: 情况变得越来越糟了…

en: It's disgusting... They almost look like human beings!!
zh: 真倒胃口…这玩意看着跟人似的！！

en:
The flower... That's what we smelled at Sven's.
What if that caused it?!
zh:
那朵花…就是我们在斯文那儿闻到的那个。
万一就是它引起的呢？！

en: Stay calm!
zh: 保持冷静！

en: But everyone inhaled it, including us!
zh: 可大家都吸进去了，也包括我们！

en: You're right... Your face! It's starting to mutate!
zh: 你说的对…你的脸！开始变异了！

en: WHAT?!!!
Relax, I'm just kidding!
zh: 放宽心，逗你玩呢！

en: Let's just get out of here.
zh: 我们还是快点离开这里吧。

en: Oh my god!
zh: 哦，我的天啊！

en: They really had no chance at all.
zh: 简直就是死路一条，根本逃不掉。

en:
I see something. Delta, theta, gamma...
they're letters in the Greek alphabet.
zh:
我发现了点东西。德尔塔Delta、
西塔Theta、伽马Gamma…
它们是希腊字母表里的字母。

en:
The brotherhood use it to distinguish themselves
from other fraternities.
zh: 兄弟会用它们来区别于其他的大学社团。

en: What a stupid idea.
zh: 真是够蠢的。

en: Have you seen this flower?
zh: 你看到这朵花了吗？

en: It looks different to the others.
zh: 它看起来跟其他的花不太一样。

en: Wow... That thing blew my mind!
zh: 哇塞…那玩意简直爽到飞起！

en: My head is spinning...
zh: 我的头在天旋地转…

en: Books...
zh: 书…

en:
Concentrate Kenny, I know you can do it.
Our lives might depend on it.
zh:
集中精神，肯尼，我知道你可以的。
我们的命可能就全靠这了。

en: Don't worry, I have no intention of dying in a library.
zh: 省省吧，我可没打算把命交代在图书馆里。

en:
They're not right in the head,
whoever created this system!
zh: 设计这套破系统的家伙，脑子绝对进水了！

en:
All part of the Brotherhood's MO.
The books at the top must be reserved for the elite.
zh:
这全都是兄弟会做事的套路。
最上面的书一定是给精英预留的。

en:
Mei and Jun told me about this "Brotherhood".
It's been around for 200 years!
zh:
梅和珺跟我提过这个“兄弟会”。
它已经存在了200年！

en:
All the members are supposed to help each other,
like a family of sorts. And they're highly selective.
zh:
所有的成员应该互相扶持，
就像个家庭一样，而且他们的筛选极度严格。

en: Well I won't be joining any time soon. I'd rather die!
zh: 我反正打死也不想加这种破组织，我宁愿死！

en:
So he lit the match and held it near his pants.
Dude! The smell! The explosion! Awesome!
zh:
然后他划燃火柴凑到裤子旁边。
哥们！那味道！那爆炸！绝了！

en: That's total crap dude!
zh: 满嘴跑火车吧你，哥们！

en: Yep, everywhere...
zh: 是啊，到处都是…

en: It's a multi-key lock. There's a note:
zh: 这是一把多重密钥锁。上面有一张便签：

en:
"Only to be opened in case of an emergency by authorised
persons. Contact Delta Theta Gamma headquarters."
zh:
“仅限授权人员在紧急情况下开启。
请联系德尔塔·西塔·伽马总部。”

en: There's a note:
zh: 上面有一张便签：

en:
"Only to be opened in case of an emergency by authorised
persons. Contact Delta Theta Gamma headquarters."
zh:
“仅限授权人员在紧急情况下开启。
请联系德尔塔·西塔·伽马总部。”

en:
Cool, a stun gun! This thing paralyses a
living creature by firing thousands of volts at it!
zh:
爽，是电击枪！
这玩意可以释放几千伏特的电压把活物电瘫痪！

en: I'm not even going to ask what it's doing in there...
zh: 我甚至都不想问为什么这东西会在这儿…

en: Eugh, what is that???
zh: 呃，那是什么？？？

en: It's still alive I'd say.
zh: 我觉得它应该还活着。

en: If I throw up, don't mind me will you?
zh: 待会儿我要是吐出来，你可别怪我啊？

en: Be my guest...
zh: 请便…

en: So I won't be shooting my load tonight then huh?!
zh: 那我今晚难道没法快活了？！

en: You just save your ammunition for later.
zh: 你还是把你的‘子弹’存着以后再射吧。

en: Hmm, I have a headache like... five days a month.
zh: 嗯，我一个月里总有那么…五天会头疼。

en: Here, drink this...
zh: 来，把这个喝了…

en: What about the others? What are they doing?
zh: 其他人呢？他们在干什么？

en: We could take advantage of the opportunity...
zh: 咱们正好可以趁热打铁…

en:
Ok, I feel better now. Maybe I'll meet up with a girlfriend from
Delta Thêta Gamma! The others will catch up with us later.
zh:
行了，我缓过来了。说不定
还能在德尔塔·西塔·伽马交个女朋友呢！
其他人待会儿会自己跟上来。

en:
The analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2)
is not detected. Please insert an analog controller
(DUALSHOCK®2) to controller port 1.
zh: 未检测到模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）。请将模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）插入控制器端口1。

en:
The analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2)
is not detected. Please insert an analog controller
(DUALSHOCK®2) to controller port 2.
zh: 未检测到模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）。请将模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）插入控制器端口2。

en:
No analog controllers (DUALSHOCK®2) are detected.
Please insert an analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2)
in controller port 1 and controller port 2.
zh: 未检测到模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）。请将模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）插入控制器端口1和端口2。

en:
The analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2) is not detected.
Please attach the analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2)
to controller port 1, and press the <PS2_CROSS> button to continue.
zh: 未检测到模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）。请将模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）连接至控制器端口1，然后按 <PS2_CROSS> 键继续。

en:
The analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2) is not detected
in controller port 1. Please remove the controller from
controller port 2 and insert it in controller port 1 to
continue the story in single player mode or insert
an analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2) in controller port 1.
zh: 控制器端口1未检测到模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）。请从控制器端口2拔下控制器并插入端口1，以便在单人模式下继续游戏，或者将模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）插入控制器端口1。

en:
The analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2) is not detected
in controller port 2. Press the <PS2_CROSS> button to continue
the story in single player mode or insert
an analog controller (DUALSHOCK®2) in controller port 2.
zh: 控制器端口2未检测到模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）。按 <PS2_CROSS> 键在单人模式下继续游戏，或者将模拟控制器（DUALSHOCK®2）插入控制器端口2。

en: He is going to pay me for it! Nobody touches my wheels!
zh: 老子非剥了他的皮不可！敢动我的爱车，活腻了！

en: Jeez-Louise! It's only a car!
zh: 天呐！至于吗，不就是辆破车！

en:
It is the quintessential automobile!
Anyway we really need my shotgun right now...
zh:
那可是我命根子一样的极品飞车！
行了，咱们现在当务之急是找到老子的散弹枪……

en:
Ok, then, I'll follow you...
I have no choice, the others already left.
zh:
行吧，那我跟你走……
也没别的路了，大家都不知道跑哪去了。

en: Corey, we really shouldn't have gone off the road like this...
zh: 科里，我们真的不该偏离主路的…

en: I guess all of the campus areas are overrun...
zh: 我猜整个校园区域都被攻陷了…

en: We're really in it up to our necks...
zh: 咱们这回真是自身难保了…

en:
With the shotgun our situation will improve.
My car can't be far off.
zh:
只要枪在手，一切都好说。
我的车应该就在附近。

en: My baby... He crashed my baby...
zh: 我的小宝贝…那畜生毁了我的小宝贝…

en:
Don't you think you are exaggerating a bit?
And what about Mei huh?
zh:
你不觉得你有点夸张了吗？
那梅怎么办？

en: HE CRASHED MY BABY!!! THAT BASTARD!!!!
zh:
他把我的小宝贝给毁了！！！
那个狗日的畜生！！！！

en: YOU CAN'T HIDE!!! I'LL HAVE YOUR SKIN JERK!!!
zh:
你个怂狗有种别躲！！！
老子今天非扒了你的皮不可，杂种！！！

en: It is an electric chain saw. It works on batteries.
zh: 这是一把电锯，用电池供电的。

en: Yeah, like a cellphone...
zh: 是啊，跟手机差不多，每天都要充充电……

en: Right, but don't confuse them ok.
zh: 对，但你可别把它们搞混了。

en:
Um yeah, anyway these batteries
probably won't last too long...
zh: 呃是啊，不过这些电池可能撑不了太久…

en: This forest is freaking me out...
zh: 这林子邪门得很，我瘆得慌……

en: You're such a wuss.
zh: 瞧你那怂样。

en: Aren't you maybe afraid?!
zh: 说的好像你就不害怕似的？！

en: Yes, but I'm trying to keep it together okay?
zh: 怕啊，可我不像你，我正死撑着呢，OK？

en: Phew!!! That was a close one!!!
zh: 呜！！！好险啊！！！

en: This is really bad, if only we could find some help!
zh: 这下是真的糟了，要是能找到人帮忙就好了！

en:
How we are going to find the others
now that the bridge is gone?
zh: 既然桥已经断了，我们怎么去和大家汇合？

en:
No choice, we move on. We'll try to contact
them once we're out of this forest.
zh:
没办法，我们继续往前。
等离开这片森林，我们就试着联系他们。

en: This is going nowhere.
zh: 这样走根本出不去。

en: Yeah, you're right!
zh: 是啊，你说得对！

en: I'm sick of these trees, I want to get back to civilization!
zh: 我受够了这些树木，我想回到人类社会！

en: We can't be far from campus.
zh: 我们应该离校园不远了。

en: That must be the hospital.
zh: 那一定是医院。

en: Then we're certainly going to find some help!
zh: 那我们肯定能找到人帮忙了！

en: First we'd have to be able to get in.
zh: 那也得我们先能进得去才行。

en: Yeah... It looks pretty quiet... Not even an ambulance siren...
zh:
是啊…看起来太安静了…
甚至听不到救护车的警笛声…

en: I hope Mei's ok...
zh: 我希望梅没事…

en: A little late to think about that now... moron.
zh: 现在才想起来担心？晚了，大傻瓜。

en: I know, I was stupid. It's not the first time.
zh: 我知道，是我脑子抽风。反正也不是头一回了。

en: Do you see? There are ledges all along the wall.
zh: 你看到了吗？整面墙上都是突出的边缘。

en: Yeah I see! I think I can use them!
zh: 嗯，看到了！我想我能攀着它们过去！

en: Not this again!
zh: 别又来这套！

en: Don't fall!
zh: 别掉下去！

en: Do you have any other dumb things to say?
zh: 除了废话，你的嘴还能吐出点象牙不？

en: Hey! That's enough okay!
zh: 嘿！适可而止，好不好！

en: Sorry, when I risk my life, I'm irritable.
zh: 抱歉，当我把命豁出去的时候，脾气就会有点暴。

en: Come on blondy! What are you waiting for? An invitation?
zh:
麻溜点，金发妹！
磨蹭什么呢？还要给你发请帖啊？

en:
Continue like that and I won't need
an invitation to kick you where it really hurts.
zh:
你要是再敢嘴贱，
我不介意请你尝尝断子绝孙脚。

en: Come on goldylocks, work with me!
zh: 快上来，金发大美女，搭把手可以不？

en:
Mymy, you're a real sweetheart aren't you?
I wonder what Mei sees in you.
zh:
哎呀呀，你嘴可真甜啊，不是吗？
我真怀疑王梅到底看上你哪一点了。

en:
What are you complaining about?
This dude drives worse than you!
zh:
你有什么好抱怨的？
这家伙的驾驶技术比你还烂！

en: That's a real comfort Amy...
zh: 那可真让人安慰啊，艾米…

en: But you're insured, right?
zh: 不过你买了保险，对吧？

en:
The insurance companies don't want anything to do with me.
They say that I should go back to riding a bike.
zh:
保险公司根本不想理我。
他们说我应该回去骑自行车。

en: What was that?
zh: 刚才那是什么声音？

en: They remind me of Mei when she gets angry.
zh: 它们让我想起梅生气时的样子。

en: Right now I sympathise with her.
zh: 我现在倒挺能理解她的感受了。

en: Corey!
zh: 科里！

en: OK! stop the ultrasounds!
zh: 行了！收收你那超声波海豚音吧！

en:
Don't go too far away Amy, if I were
to lose you, I think Sven would kill me.
zh:
别走太远，艾米，如果我把你弄丢了，
我觉得斯文会宰了我的。

en: Yeah right!
zh: 吹，接着吹！

en: You'd better believe it Amy.
zh: 我真没跟你开玩笑，艾米。

en: Nice!
zh: 太棒了！

en: Nice gun!
zh: 好枪！

en: Cool!
zh: 帅啊！

en: A bat... cool.
zh: 球棒…帅。

en: It might come in handy...
zh: 这可能会派上用场…

en: I would have preferred a gun.
zh: 我更想要一把枪。

en: A hockey stick. Sven will be happy!
zh: 一把冰球杆。斯文会高兴的！

en: Cool!
zh: 帅啊！

en: I'll take it. You never know...
zh: 我拿上了，以防万一嘛…

en: That must cause a lot of damage...
zh: 这威力肯定非常大…

en: A shotgun. Some people I know are going to suffer...
zh: 一把散弹枪。有些家伙要倒大霉了…

en: Fantastic. Things are going to heat up now!
zh: 棒极了，接下来可要热闹了！

en: Spiked club
zh: 带刺木棒

en: Pack of 3 flashbangs
zh: 闪光弹三个

en: Bat
zh: 球棒

en: Golf club
zh: 高尔夫球杆

en: Hockey stick
zh: 冰球杆

en: Flare gun
zh: 信号枪

en: Chainsaw
zh: 电锯

en: Flashball
zh: 闪光弹发射器

en: Crossbow
zh: 十字弩

en: Mini SMG
zh: 微型冲锋枪

en: Dynamite
zh: 炸药

en: Uber flashlight
zh: 强光手电筒

en: Gun
zh: 手枪

en: Shotgun
zh: 散弹枪

en: Stun gun
zh: 电击枪

en: Flashbang
zh: 闪光弹

en: Mei? Mei?!
zh: 梅？梅？！

en: Jun?!

They're just behind the door...
I think they know I am in the room...
zh:
它们就在门外…
我总觉得它们知道我就躲在屋里…

en: We're close! I'm with Sven! We're coming to get you!
zh: 我们快到了！我和斯文在一起！我们这就来救你！

en: Please, hurry up...
zh: 求求你们，快点…

en:
Damn it, there's no other way of getting in there!
The magnetic lock is totally destroyed!
zh:
我操，没有别的方法可以进去了！
电磁锁已经被完全破坏了！

en:
Impossible to hack that! We have
to find another way. Fast!
zh:
根本没办法黑进去！
我们必须另想办法。快！

en:
I can't do it anymore, Mei. It's just like the stories they told us
when we were kids. But it's true. There really are monsters, Mei.
zh:
姐，我撑不下去了。这简直和
小时候听的恐怖故事一模一样。
但它们居然是真的……梅，这里真的有怪物……

en: Hold on Jun, we're coming!
zh: 坚持住，珺，我们来了！

en: This is going to be close!
zh: 时间紧迫，快！

en: Is this really your car?
zh: 这真的是你的车吗？

en:
Yes, yes. It's Jun who has the key.
Let's go get her! No time to lose!
zh:
是的，没错。钥匙在珺那儿。
我们去找她！没时间浪费了！

en: It's a dead-end. We have to climb.
zh: 这是死路，我们要爬上去。

en: We'd just have to move this box.
zh: 我们只需要移开这个箱子就行。

en: Jeez, it's really dark in here! The fuses must have blown !
zh: 操啊，这里面真黑！一定是保险丝烧断了！

en: Jun is in my bedroom. Let's go up !
zh: 王珺在我的卧室里，我们上去！

en: The cellar is closed.
zh: 地下室的入口关上了。

en: Jun is not in the basement.
zh: 珺不在地下室。

en:
These displays show what the security cameras
in the basement are recording!
zh: 这些显示屏播放的是地下室监控录下来的画面！

en: Let's hurry! Jun's life is at stake!
zh: 我们快点！珺的命危在旦夕！

en: They're trying to get in!! Help me!!!
zh: 它们想闯进来！！救命啊！！！

en: Hold on, we're on our way!
zh: 坚持住，我们马上就到！

en: Meiiii...
zh: 梅…

en: We're close Jun, trust me. They won't get you!!!
zh: 我们就在附近，珺，相信我。它们抓不到你的！！！

en: Mei, They got in!!!
zh: 梅，它们闯进来了！！！

en: Jun!!! Damn it! Quickly Sven!
zh: 珺！！！该死！快点，斯文！

en: We're almost there!
zh: 我们马上就到了！

en: We're not going the right way!
zh: 我们走错路了！

en: JUN!!! NO!!!
Let her go!!!
zh: 放开她！！！

en: Oh no! She fell!
zh: 糟糕！她掉下去了！

en: I can't see where she is!
zh: 我看不见她在哪！

en: I'm sorry...
zh: 对不起…

en: Mei?
zh: 梅？

en: JUN!!! Tell me you're ok!
zh: 珺！！！快告诉我你没事！

en:
I fell into the cellar... I don't know where I am!
It's dark here...
zh:
我摔进地窖了…根本看不清这是哪…
这里好黑啊……

en:
Let's go to the Reception area downstairs!
The basements are packed with cameras...
zh:
我们去楼下的接待处！
地下室里到处都是摄像头…

en: We can track her down on the security monitors!
zh: 我们可以在监控屏幕上追踪她的位置！

en: We're coming to help you! Don't move sweetie!
zh: 撑住，我们这就过去！千万待在原地别动！

en:
I'm dying of fear Sven...
Jun has always been there for me...
zh: 斯文，我快吓疯了…珺一直以来都是我的支柱…

en: She's going to make it, don't worry.
zh: 她会挺过来的，别担心。

en: This thing is old! There is a dial to adjust the picture...
zh: 这玩意太旧了！有一个旋钮可以调节画面…

en: Jun! We see you!
zh: 珺！我们看到你了！

en: I'm scared Mei! There's strange noises everywhere!
zh: 我很害怕，王梅！到处都是奇怪的声音！

en: Calm down. I'm going to help you.
zh: 冷静点。我会帮你的。

en: Thanks...
zh: 谢谢…

en:
Oh please, this has got to be it: the main switch!
That has got to open the doors! Oh please please please!
zh:
老天保佑，总开关千万要是这一个啊！
这样门就能开了！求你了，快开门吧，老天保佑！

en: If only I could see more! I need more light!
zh: 要是我能看清点就好了！我需要更多光线！

en: huh?
zh: 啊？

en: Down to the basement! Quickly!!!!
zh: 下到地下室！快点！！！！

en: This can't be happening, this really can't be happening!
zh: 这不可能是真的，这绝对不可能是真的！

en: We're almost there!
zh: 我们马上就到了！

en: Where are you Jun ?? Where are you ?!
zh: 珺，你在哪？？你在哪？！

en: We're almost there Mei, we're almost there!
zh: 我们就快到了，梅，就快到了！

en: Out of the way!
zh: 闪开！

en: Die! Die!
zh: 去死！去死啊！

en: Nobody is going to come between me and my sister!
zh: 谁也别想拆散我和我妹妹！

en: We're locked in!
zh: 我们被锁在里面了！

en: Let's see about that later, for now we just go on.
zh: 那事待会再说，现在只能硬着头皮往前走了。

en:
For once I can go into the girl's showers,
and it really isn't what I want.
zh:
我好不容易能进一次女生浴室，
可这真不是我想象中的那种情况。

en: Ugh, that's just gross!
zh: 呃，真恶心！

en: Jun !... Jun !!! Sven, something happened to her !
zh: 珺！……珺！！！斯文，她出事了！

en: Don't think about it, just move!
zh: 别胡思乱想了，快走！

en: I can't stay here while Jun's life is at risk;
zh: 在珺命悬一线的时候，我怎么能等死

en: she's my sister, I love her, I can't live without her!
zh: 她是我妹妹，我爱她，没有她我活不下去！

en: We're gonna go look for her. We'll bring her back.
zh: 我们会去找她的，我们会把她带回来。

en: Jun ! I can't see you on the screen anymore!
zh: 珺！我在监控屏幕上看不到你了！

en: I can see a light!
zh: 我看到有光了！

en: Be careful!
zh: 小心！

en: Oh no!
zh: 啊不！

en: You're gonna pay! I'm going to bust you up!!!
zh: 你要为此付出代价！我要把你砸得稀烂！！！

en: Do you think we're gonna get out of this alive?
zh: 你觉得我们能活着逃出去吗？

en: Of course! Trust me.
zh: 当然能！相信我。

en: Thanks for being there, Mei. I love you big sister.
zh: 谢谢你一直陪着我，梅。我爱你，姐姐。

en: Now Jun, just... concentrate okay?
zh: 珺，现在只管集中注意力，好吗？

en: Kill it Sven !
zh: 弄死它，斯文！

en: Die you big freak!
zh: 去死啊，你这个大怪物！

en:
Approach the edge so that you can
lift up another character.
zh: 靠近边缘，以便将另一名角色拉上来。

en:
Place your character under Corey
so that Corey can lift your character.
zh:
将你的角色停留在科里下方，
以便科里能够托起你的角色。

en: Press <PS2_SQUARE> to lift the second character.
zh: 按 <PS2_SQUARE> 托起第二名角色。

en:
Press <PS2_SQUARE> several times to stop hoisting
the second game character.
zh: 多次按 <PS2_SQUARE> 键停止拉起第二名角色。

en: I should be able to hang on to that ledge.
zh: 我应该能抓住那个边缘。

en:
Once you are hanging, use the left analog stick
to move sideways.
zh: 抓稳后，使用左摇杆进行左右移动。

en: Press <PS2_TRIANGLE> to drop yourself.
zh: 按 <PS2_TRIANGLE> 松手下落。

en: Jun... I don't believe it!
zh: 珺…我真不敢相信！

en:
I... I don't believe it either.
I can't believe she's gone...
zh:
我…我也不敢相信。
我无法接受她已经走了…

en:
We have to get out of here before
we all end up like that!
zh: 我们必须在沦为那种下场之前逃离这里！

en:
So students turned into monsters because
they got busy without using protection?!
zh:
这么说，学生们是因为‘干那事’
没做安全措施才变成怪物的？！

en:
They should have know better!
You should always use contraceptives!
zh:
他们应该更懂事的！
任何时候都应该用避孕药具！

en: Well... It's a little bit too late for a morality lesson now!
zh: 行了…现在才上道德教育课，未免有点太迟了！

en: They're everywhere! It's an epidemic!
zh: 到处都是这玩意！这简直是瘟疫！

en: We'll take a stepladder next time huh?
zh: 下次我们带个折叠梯，好吗？

en: I'm hoping there won't be a next time.
zh: 我希望没有下一次了。

en: I wonder if May's going to be all right.
zh: 我不知道梅能不能挺过去。

en: She's going to need us, that's for sure.
zh: 她肯定需要我们支持她，这是一定的。

en: This is Richard James...
zh: 我是理查德·詹姆斯…

en: Hi, Prof...
zh: 你好，教授…

en:
Corey, I found it! The flower is a natural
drug from the poisonous Solanaceae family.
zh:
科里，我查到了！这花含有一种天然毒素，
属于有毒的茄科植物。

en: It seems to have undergone cellular mutation!
zh: 它似乎经历了细胞突变！

en:
And? What are you waiting for professor?
A research grant?!
zh:
然后呢？你还在等什么，教授？
等研究经费拨下来吗？！

en: If you want to help, meet us at the hospital.
zh: 如果你想帮忙，就到医院跟我们碰头。

en: I'm already here Corey! I'm in the lab on the ground floor.
zh: 我已经在这里了，科里！我就在一楼的实验室里。

en: Ok professor, see you down there.
zh: 好的，教授，就那儿见。

en: Look!
zh: 看！

en: I can't believe Jun is gone... I hope Sven is ok.
zh: 我不敢相信珺已经走了…我希望斯文没事。

en:
You mean you waited for all of this stuff
to happen before deciding to hit on Sven?
zh:
你是说你非要等到发生这一连串的事，
才决定去倒追斯文吗？

en: Oh, grow up! He's just a friend!
zh: 哦，成熟点吧！他只是个普通朋友！

en: Really? You won't find another guy like him Amy.
zh:
真的假的？艾米，
像他这种痴情男人你打着灯笼都找不着第二个。

en: I know, just leave it alone okay?
zh: 我知道，别说这个了，好吗？

en: The elevator is jammed!
zh: 电梯卡住了！

en: We have to find another way down!
zh: 我们要另想办法下去！

en: Jeez Amy, don't poke my eyes out!!
zh: 天呐，艾米，你差点弄瞎我的眼睛！！

en: Then keep your eyes on my face, not anywhere else.
zh: 那你最好看着我的脸，别乱瞟其他地方。

en: The poor thing... When is this carnage going to stop?!
zh: 好可怜…这场惨剧什么时候才能停止？！

en: Move Amy! Move!
zh: 快走，艾米！快点！

en: But where are you going?!
zh: 可你要去哪？！

en: To the elevator!
zh: 去电梯那儿！

en:
Come on Mei, you've got to pull through!
Jun would have wanted you to live!
zh:
来吧，梅，你必须挺过来！
珺在天之灵也会希望你活下去的！

en:
Just... Don't talk to me right now, okay Sven?
I need some time...
zh:
现在…先别跟我说话好吗，斯文？
我需要静一静…

en: Corey is somewhere in this hospital.
zh: 科里肯定被困在这医院的某个角落。

en: Let's try to get in!
zh: 我们想办法进去！

en: The electric airlock isn't working.
zh: 电子气压锁打不开。

en:
There must be a manual system you
can use when there's a power outage!
zh: 停电的时候，一定有手动应急系统可以使用！

en: Whew! It's good to be safe!
zh: 呜！安全了真好！

en: Yeah we're safe but we're also trapped.
zh: 是啊，虽然安全了，但我们也出不去了。

en: This thing weighs a ton!
zh: 这玩意沉得要死！

en: To the palace, coach driver!
zh: 起驾回宫，车夫！

en: Right away ... princess.
zh: 遵命…我的公主殿下。

en: It's been a long time!
zh: 真是久违了！

en: You look like a koala from where I'm standing.
zh: 从我这角度看，你就像只考拉。

en:
Come a little bit closer then and I'll show you what
a Koala can drop on your stupid head!
zh:
那你再走近点，我让你见识一下
考拉能往你那愚蠢的脑袋上砸下什么东西！

en: Jeez Corey, are you nervous or something? Can't hack it?
zh: 天呐科里，你是不是腿软了？到底行不行啊？

en:
If you make me laugh Sven, I'm going to fall and
break my back. Then I'll be really pissed off!
zh:
你要是逗我笑，斯文，我肯定会掉下去摔断脊梁骨。
到时候我可绝对饶不了你！

en: Stop it you stupid-norwegian-wannabe-icehockey-freak!
zh: 闭嘴吧，你这个愚蠢的挪威冰球狂热分子！

en: Hmpff !
zh: 哼！

en: Slave! My carriage!
zh: 奴隶！我的马车！

en: By the way, did you know? Amy is crazy about you.
zh: 对了，你还不知道吧？艾米可是对你迷得不行。

en: Maybe...
zh: 也许吧…

en:
All you need to do is stay alive... and she needs to stay alive.
I can hear the wedding bells already!
zh:
你只需要活下去…她也得活下去。
我仿佛已经听到婚礼的钟声了！

en: Let's just hope they don't turn out to be funeral bells.
zh: 但愿它们最后不会变成丧事的喇叭声。

en: Aiiiiie !
zh: 哎呀呀！

en: Are you sure you want to go back up?
zh: 你确定要再上去吗？

en: It's OK... ow... I can manage...
zh: 没事…嗷…我撑得住…

en: Aïe ! A fractured vertebra...
zh: 哎哟！脊椎骨折了…

en: Ouch ! That must hurt.
zh: 噢！那肯定疼死了。

en: Ow!
zh: 噢！

en: What an idiot... Do you enjoy this or something?!
zh: 真是个白痴…你是不是有自虐倾向啊？！

en: Stop it. It really hurts...
zh: 别闹了，真的很痛…

en: You made a serious mistake, Kenny !
zh: 你这回真是糊涂啊，肯尼！

en: I'm not afraid of you little boy...
zh: 我才不怕你，小鬼…

en:
You've gotten bigger.
But you're still as stupid as you ever were!
zh:
你体型变大了，
但还和以前一样蠢！

en: I'll make you shut up!
zh: 老子要让你闭嘴！

en: Why are you doing this Kenny ?!
zh: 你为什么要这么做，肯尼？！

en: I don't need you guys anymore! Not ANY of you!
zh: 我再也不需要你们了！你们中的任何一个！

en: You're going to die Kenny !
zh: 明年的今天就是你的忌日，肯尼！

en: It's worse to see someone die than to actually die, Corey...
zh: 看着别人死去，比自己死去更痛苦，科里…

en: You were our friend, Kenny!
zh: 咱们好歹曾经也是兄弟啊，肯尼！

en: Friend? That word is meaningless!
zh: 朋友？那词毫无意义！

en:
You're forcing me to kill you,
after all that we went through at Leafmore!
zh:
在利夫莫尔历经生死之后，
你居然逼我杀了你！

en: Leafmore was just the beginning! This is where it ends!
zh: 利夫莫尔只是个开始！这一切就在这里结束！

en:
Open your eyes Stan,
accept the disease that's eating you away!
zh:
睁大眼睛看清现实吧，斯坦，
去接受那正在吞噬你的病毒吧！

en: Go away! Just... Go away!
zh: 滚开！快…滚开！

en: You're too dangerous Kenny!
zh: 你现在就是个定时炸弹，肯尼！

en: I'll show you how dangerous I am!
zh: 我会让你见识一下我有多危险！

en: How could you have changed so much?!
zh: 你怎么会变这么多？！

en: I just did... And you can, too!
zh: 我就变了…而且你也可以！

en: Awww... Let me win Shannon... for old time's sake!
zh: 噢…让我赢吧，夏侬…看在往日情分的面上！

en: I'll let you die. You'll be better off that way, believe me.
zh: 我会送你去死。相信我，这样你也解脱了。

en: You attended athletics class Corey?
zh: 科里，你这身手是跟体育老师学的？

en:
Actually, my girlfriends never lived on the ground floor...
And their dads didn't like me.
zh:
其实，我历任女朋友从来都不住一楼…
而且她们家的大人都不太喜欢我。

en: I wonder why.
zh: 我很好奇为什么。

en: It's getting closer!!
zh: 它越来越近了！！

en: But what is it?!
zh: 可那到底是什么？！

en: I don't want to know!
zh: 我一点也不想知道！

en: That thing is here!
zh: 那玩意来了！

en: Let's go! Friggin elevator!!!
zh: 我们走！该死的电梯！！！

en: It's in my head!
zh: 它跑到我脑子里去了！

en: I don't feel well... We have to get a move on!
zh: 我感觉不太舒服…我们要加紧行动了！

en: We're dead! We're so dead!!
zh: 我们死定了！我们死定了！！

en: I can't think straight...
zh: 我没法静下心思考…

en: I... borrowed a battery pack from the hospital.
zh: 我…从医院借了个电池组。

en:
I modified it so that it would be compatible
with your equipment.
zh: 我改装了它，好让它能适配你的设备。

en: It will last longer.
zh: 它能用得更久。

en: Really? You can do that sort of thing?
zh: 真的吗？你还会做这种事？

en:
Of course! I may be a biology teacher,
but I also surf the Internet!
zh:
当然了！我虽然只是个生物老师，
但我也是会上网冲浪的好吧！

en: Oh yeah...right, of course.
zh: 噢是啊…对，那是当然的。

en: There is a computer connected to the intranet in one room.
zh: 其中一个房间里有一台连接到局域网的电脑。

en:
Some slightly idiotic interns stored a recipe
for home-made dynamite on the server.
zh:
一些有点蠢的实习生在服务器上
存了自制炸药的配方。

en:
I never thought I'd say this,
but maybe you should try and use it!
zh:
虽然我做梦也没想到自己会说这话，
但也许你们该试着做点炸药出来！

en: This hospital has a lot of chemicals.
zh: 这家医院里有很多化学试剂。

en:
If you look around, you'll definitely find what you need to
build a home-made explosive.
zh:
如果你四处找找，
一定能找到制作自制炸药所需的所有原料。

en:
They locked the whole system to protect themselves.
I should be able to hack into it...
zh: 他们为了自保锁定了整个系统。我应该能黑进系统里…

en: The magnetic card doesn't work any more!
zh: 磁卡已经不能用了！

en: The card reader is broken. There's no way to get through.
zh: 读卡器坏了。根本没法通过。

en: Open
zh: 打开

en: This door is missing a wheel.
zh: 这扇门缺了个轮子。

en: The door is locked from the inside.
zh: 门从里面锁上了。

en:
The basement... Now's not the time
to take out the garbage cans...
zh: 地下室…现在可不是去倒垃圾桶的时候…

en: The basement door is securely closed.
zh: 地下室的门紧紧关着。

en: Shoot! They already locked the doors! Drat!
zh: 该死！他们已经把门锁上了！真讨厌！

en: Oh no! It's night and they've already locked the doors!
zh: 哦不！已经是晚上了，他们把大门都锁了！

en: The door is blocked off.
zh: 门被堵死了。

en:
The magnetic reader is so badly broken
that I can't even hack it...
zh: 读卡器坏得太彻底了，我连黑都黑不进去…

en:
The monsters have smashed
the card reader to pieces! It can't be used!
zh: 怪物把读卡器砸了个粉碎！已经没法用了！

en: Maybe I can hack the card reader...
zh: 也许我能黑进这个读卡器…

en: The door is closed. There's a magnetic card reader.
zh: 门是关着的。旁边有一个磁卡读卡器。

en:
There's a magnetic card system beside it,
I can try to hack into it.
zh: 旁边有一个磁卡系统，我可以试着黑进去。

en:
You need a magnetic card to open this door?
What are they protecting behind it?
zh:
这扇门需要磁卡才能打开？
门后保护着什么东西？

en:
If Mei were here, she would be able
to hack into this electronic lock.
zh: 如果梅在这儿，她一定能黑进这把电子锁。

en:
It's electronically locked. Maybe Mei could hack
into the system. She knows everything about computers...
zh:
它被电子锁锁住了，也许梅能黑进系统，
她对电脑无所不知…

en: Go through
zh: 通过

en: The door is locked by a digital code.
zh: 门被密码锁锁住了。

en: They locked it behind them.
zh: 他们从里面把门锁上了。

en: Go through the window
zh: 翻窗通过

en: The door is locked.
zh: 门锁上了。

en: Enter
zh: 进入

en: Go through the ventilation duct
zh: 通过通风管道

en: Go through the crack
zh: 钻进去

en: They locked it!
zh: 他们锁门了！

en: Oh no! They locked it!
zh: 糟糕！他们把门锁了！

en: Better ask Kenny for help.
zh: 最好找肯尼帮帮忙。

en: Humpf... I think I still need Kenny here.
zh: 哼…看来这儿还是需要肯尼过来。

en: Humpf... I think I still need Kenny here.
zh: 哼…看来这儿还是需要肯尼过来。

en: There's no way we can open this without Kenny.
zh: 没有肯尼的话，我们根本打不开这扇门。

en: The door is closed, the bouncer refuses to let us inside.
zh: 门关着，保安拒绝让我们进去。

en: It's closed. They must be in class.
zh: 门锁着，他们一定是去上课了。

en: It's closed. The guy who uses this room went out.
zh: 门锁着。这房间的使用者出门了。

en:
It looks as though there's a party going on here.
We're not going to invite ourselves.
zh:
这里看起来像是在开派对。
我们还是别不请自来了。

en: The door is locked from the inside.
zh: 门从里面锁上了。

en: The door is locked from the inside.
zh: 门从里面锁上了。

en:
I could take a peek...
but what will Mei think?
zh:
我倒可以偷偷看一眼…
但是被梅知道了会怎么想？

en: There's something stuck behind.
zh: 后面被什么东西卡住了。

en: This room is locked.
zh: 这间房间锁上了。

en:
There can't be any patients here,
the door is closed.
zh: 这儿不可能有病人，门锁着呢。

en:
The emergency door is stuck.
Isn't security great?.
zh:
应急门被卡住了。
安全措施做得真好啊。

en: The lock is really rusty. It's impossible to open.
zh: 锁已经彻底生锈了，根本打不开。

en: It seems that the door is locked from the inside.
zh: 门似乎是从里面被反锁了。

en: The door is locked from the inside.
zh: 门从里面锁上了。

en: The door is locked from the inside.
zh: 门从里面锁上了。

en: It seems that the door is locked from the inside.
zh: 门似乎是从里面被反锁了。

en: They must already have left for the evening.
zh: 他们今晚肯定早就已经离开了。

en: She must have gone out, the door is locked.
zh: 她一定是出门了，门是锁着的。

en: It seems there's no one here.
zh: 这儿似乎没有人。

en:
She's closed her door so she
can go take a shower.
zh: 她锁上了门，想去冲个凉。

en: They have blocked off this part of the building.
zh: 这栋大楼的这一部分已经被封死了。

en:
It's locked and they've forgotten
to turn off their sound system!
zh: 门锁上了，而他们居然忘了关音响系统！

en:
There's something that's trying to force the door,
better not stay here!
zh: 有什么东西正在撞门，最好别待在这儿！

en:
They've blocked off the boys' washroom.
Just as well, with that smell.
zh:
他们把男厕所封死了。
不过也挺好，毕竟那味道真的太呛了。

en: It's impossible to open this door.
zh: 根本打不开这扇门。

en: It's impossible to open this door.
zh: 根本打不开这扇门。

en: The door to the boys' washroom is stuck.
zh: 男厕所的门卡住了。

en: The door is blocked by the locker.
zh: 门被更衣柜堵住了。

en: First, I have to lift up Mei.
zh: 首先，我必须把梅拉上去。

en: First, I have to lift up Mei.
zh: 首先，我必须把梅拉上去。

en: The teachers' staircase is blocking the door.
zh: 教师专用楼梯挡住了这扇门。

en: There's something that's blocking the door.
zh: 有些东西堵住了这扇门。

en: There's something that's blocking the door.
zh: 有些东西堵住了这扇门。

en: The teachers' staircase is blocking the door.
zh: 教师专用楼梯挡住了这扇门。

en:
Shoot...it's stuck. 
I should have gone to the cafeteria.
zh: 该死…卡住了，我本来应该去食堂的。

en: The door is stuck.
zh: 门卡住了。

en: The door is stuck.
zh: 门卡住了。

en:
We can't get inside...
To think that that's where it all started.
zh:
我们进不去…想一想，
这里才是所有噩梦开始的地方。

en:
The hall has collapsed.
It's impossible to open the door.
zh: 门厅已经坍塌了，根本打不开这扇门。

en: We have to find another way to get to the library.
zh: 我们需要另找一条路去图书馆。

en: It's stuck. It won't open.
zh: 被卡住了，打不开。

en: It's stuck. It won't open.
zh: 被卡住了，打不开。

en: The library door is stuck.
zh: 图书馆的门卡住了。

en: The door is closed.
zh: 门关着。

en:
It's useless to try to open it,
we can go through the hole.
zh:
没必要费劲去开这扇门，
我们可以从破洞钻过去。

en: The door is too damaged to be opened.
zh: 门坏得太严重了，已经没法打开。

en: I've got to go back to Corey.
zh: 我得回到科里那儿去。

en: Open the window
zh: 打开窗户

en: This washing machine is blocking the entrance.
zh: 这台洗衣机把入口给堵住了。

en: It's closed, but there's glass in the door...
zh: 门虽然关着，不过门上有块玻璃…

en: I'm not going in without Amy.
zh: 没有艾米我才不进去。

en: Glass in the door...
zh: 门上有玻璃，或许可以打碎

en: It's late. They must have closed the door to go to sleep.
zh: 太晚了，他们一定是锁上门睡觉去了。

en: Closed.
zh: 关闭。

en: The door is blocked by this black thing.
zh: 门被这个黑色的小东西给堵住了。

en: The door is blocked by this thing.
zh: 门被这玩意给堵住了。

en: This thing looks like a living oil slick.
zh: 这玩意看起来就像是一滩活着的油渍。

en: The door is blocked by this thing.
zh: 门被这玩意给堵住了。

en: This black thing is moving by itself!
zh: 这个黑色的小东西居然自己在动！

en:
Blocked again! But the construction
work is supposed to be done today...
zh: 又被堵了！但施工明明今天就该结束了的…

en: The door is securely closed.
zh: 门紧紧关着。

en:
The door won't open any more.
The electrical system is out of service.
zh:
门再也打不开了。
电力系统已停止服务。

en:
If we break the glass, we can unlock
the door from the inside.
zh: 如果砸碎玻璃，我们就能从里面把门打开。

en: There's no point. There's no one there.
zh: 没意义，里面没人。

en: Locked!
zh: 锁上了！

en:
We're not supposed to enter
other people's homes like this.
zh: 我们不该这样闯进别人的家里。

en: The handle is broken.
zh: 把手坏了。

en: The handle is broken.
zh: 把手坏了。

en: It's impossible to open this door.
zh: 根本打不开这扇门。

en: Oh no!. Another locked door.
zh: 哦不！又是一扇锁着的门。

en: The door is blocked off.
zh: 门被堵死了。

en: The door is blocked off.
zh: 门被堵死了。

en: The door is blocked off.
zh: 门被堵死了。

en: The door is blocked off.
zh: 门被堵死了。

en: This aura is blocking the door.
zh: 这股黑气正挡在门口。

en: Better not to leave alone.
zh: 最好不要单独离开。

en: We can't leave Mei and Sven outside.
zh: 我们不能把梅和斯文丢在外面。

en:
This door is locked by
an electronic security system.
zh: 这扇门被电子安全系统锁住了。

en:
A magnetic lock.
I can hack into that.
zh: 电磁锁。我能黑进系统。

en: A magnetic lock. Mei should be able to hack into that.
zh: 是电磁锁。梅应该能黑进去。

en: Je dois casser les chaises pour pouvoir ouvrir la porte.
zh: 我得砸碎这些椅子才能开门。

en: The door is open now.
zh: 门现在开了。

en: This bed has seen a lot of girls come and go.
zh: 这床见证了太多女人的来来去去。

en: Pig!
zh: 死流氓！

en: But you are the only one who stayed Mei...
zh: 可你是唯一留下来的那个，梅…

en:
Walking around on your bare feet in here means
you'll be picking mushrooms from between your toes.
zh: 在这里光脚走来走去，你的脚趾缝里肯定会长满蘑菇。

en: Jeez, Sven can be really weird!
zh: 天呐，斯文这人可真有够怪的！

en: Let's go!
zh: 我们走！

en:
I have an exam tomorrow, you idiot!
If I fail, YOU ARE SO DEAD!!
zh:
我明天还有考试，你这个白痴！
如果我考砸了，你死定了！！

en: I just love your warm and outgoing personality.
zh: 我就是喜欢你这种热情奔放的性格。

en: Sven's room is around here.
zh: 斯文的房间就在这附近。

en: We're in for quite an evening. It's going to be great!
zh: 今晚一定很有意思。太期待了！

en: You're not very noisy, usually.
zh: 你平时话其实不太多。

en:
It doesn't mean anything... but if we're talking
about your friends, I can tell you some stories.
zh:
这代表不了什么…不过如果要聊你的那些朋友，
我倒能给你讲不少段子。

en:
How about coming to my bedroom?
I've got some Barry White... and vodka!
zh:
要不要去我的卧室坐坐？
我准备了巴里·怀特的歌…还有伏特加！

en: Do you have a waterbed?
zh: 你有水床吗？

en: I'm not easy you know...
zh: 我可没那么容易上钩，你懂的……

en:
Of course not. I'm really interested
in your inner beauty; you know that.
zh:
那是当然。
其实我真的更在乎你的内在美，这你懂的。

en: Hey, baby, I have an itch.
zh: 嘿，宝贝，我这儿有点发痒。

en: You want me to scratch it?
zh: 要我帮你抓抓吗？

en: I need to go to the gym; get a workout.
zh: 我想去趟健身房，锻炼一下。

en: Yeah? You wanna do it together?
zh: 是吗？想一起去吗？

en: Hihihi
zh: 嘻嘻嘻

en: Hey dude, go and stare at somebody else!
zh: 喂，小子，看别人去！盯我干嘛！

en: Hihihi!
zh: 嘻嘻嘻！

en:
Why don't you record this on video or something?
You can keep looking at it.
zh:
你干嘛不用录像机 录下来呢？
这样你就能一直盯着看了。

en: Hihihi!
zh: 嘻嘻嘻！

en: Sorry, but I am already spoken for...
zh: 抱歉，我已经名花有主了…

en: Hihihi!
zh: 嘻嘻嘻！

en: Excuse me baby, but I prefer red heads.
zh: 对不起啊宝贝，但我更喜欢红发妹。

en: Hahaha !
zh: 哈哈哈！

en: Mei! What's going on?
zh: 梅！发生什么了？

en: I don't know; what is that place?
zh: 我不知道，这是什么地方？

en: Sven had better not be playing tricks on us.
zh: 斯文这家伙最好别在这儿跟我们耍花招。

en: Help me ! ... Please!...
zh: 救救我！…求求你们！

en: That guy is crazy!  Help !
zh: 那家伙疯了！救命！

en: Where is the other half of me?
zh: 我的另一半在哪儿？

en: I am here, Jun! Jun!
zh: 我在这儿呢，珺！珺！

en: I need the other half of me...
zh: 我需要我的另一半…

en:
Look at me, see how satisfied I am...
Pleasure has opened its petals inside my body.
zh:
看着我，看我有多么满足…
快感已在我体内绽放。

en:
A new flower will blossom and it will be
the one that men will not be able to have.
zh:
一朵全新的花将会绽放，
它将是男人们永远无法触碰的秘密。

en: What are you saying? Amy?
zh: 你在胡说些什么啊？艾米？

en:
Come on, you jerk! Let her go, or
you're going to deal with me!
zh:
喂，你这个狗杂种！
放开她，不然有你好看的！

en: We gotta do something!
zh: 我们需要做点什么！

en: My head feels like it's going to explode.
zh: 我的头感觉快要炸掉了。

en: Mei...
zh: 梅…

en: Mei!
zh: 梅！

en: Oh, it's you...
zh: 噢，是你啊…

en: Oh, my head...
zh: 噢，我的头…

en:
Here, drink this, it worked for me. We're already late for the
Delta Theta Gamma party. Will your sister come with us?
zh:
给，喝这个，我喝了挺管用的。
我们去德尔塔·西塔·伽马派对
已经迟到了。你妹妹要跟我们一起去吗？

en: Leave her, she's exhausted.
zh: 别管她了，她已经精疲力竭了。

en: Give me my camera!
zh: 把我的摄像机还给我！

en: I'll get you the tape later!
zh: 我待会把录像带给你！

en: I don't want to see you on it!!!
zh: 我才不想在里面看到你！！！

en: Open up, you piece of crap!!!
zh: 开门啊，你这没用的狗东西！！！

en: What's that noise? Where are we?
zh: 那是什么声音？我们这是在哪？

en: Something's coming, can you feel it?
zh: 有什么东西要过来了，你能感觉到吗？

en: He is using her... He likes that... The filth... The humiliation.
zh:
他正在利用她…他很享受
那个…这肮脏的…屈辱。

en: She belongs to him... She lies to him... She is his thing.
zh: 她属于他…她对他撒谎…她是他的玩物。

en: Here we go again!
zh: 又来了！

en: But what's going on?
zh: 但到底是怎么回事？

en: He desires me, Sven. They all want me.
zh: 他渴望得到我，斯文。他们都想得到我。

en: NO! Corey, you bastard...
zh: 不！科里，你这混蛋…

en: Stop, Sven! Just stop!
zh: 住手，斯文！快住手！

en: Get lost... you jerk!
zh: 滚开…你这个臭流氓！

en: Oops! Sorry!
zh: 哎呀！抱歉！

en: On our way to another binge.
zh: 我们正准备去下一场狂欢呢。

en: And I guess we can't leave because we're all out of gas?
zh: 那我想，我们不能走，是因为我们的汽油全用光了吗？

en: Humm...
zh: 嗯…

en: Don't hurt me! Nooo!
zh: 别伤害我！不要！

en: Hey, let her go!
zh: 嘿！放开她！

en: Hey you! Stop! HEY!
zh: 嘿，你！站住！嘿！

en: Crap!
zh: 混蛋！

en: That's shocking!
zh: 太让人震惊了！

en: That's shocking!
zh: 太让人震惊了！

en: That's shocking!
zh: 太让人震惊了！

en: What is that thing?
zh: 那是什么东西？

en: That's shocking!
zh: 太让人震惊了！

en: Who's there?
zh: 谁在那儿？

en: I feel empty... Why do I feel empty?
zh: 我感觉空荡荡的…为什么我会觉得心里空荡荡的？

en: Killing a person has never benefitted anyone.
zh: 杀人从来不会给任何人带来好处。

en: Shannon!
zh: 夏侬！

en: Corey! Corey!!!!
zh: 科里！科里！！！！

en: Sven!
zh: 斯文！

en: Whew! You're alive!
zh: 哇哈哈！你还活着！

en: Shannon  is too. But Kenny won't be bothering us any more.
zh: 夏侬也活着。但肯尼再也不会来烦我们了。

en: Cool! Now, listen:  we escaped to the lake on boats.
zh: 太好了！听着，我们乘船逃到了湖边。

en:
Stan and the professor contacted me.
They're on Turtle Stone Island.
zh: 斯坦和教授联系了我，他们在龟石岛上。

en:
We lost them in the fog. Escape there if you can;
we'll try to join you with Amy.
zh:
我们在大雾里跟他们走散了。如果可以的话，
你们想办法逃去那里，我们会带上艾米去和你们汇合。

en: OK. We'll do our best.
zh: 好的，我们会尽全力的。

en: My arms hurt...
zh: 我的胳膊好酸…

en: You haven't even started!
zh: 你甚至都还没开始划呢！

en: If you only knew...
zh: 你要是知道就好了…

en: Staaaaannnnn!!!  Sveeeennnn!!!
It's quiet.
zh: 太安静了。

en: Too quiet...
zh: 安静得有些反常…

en: Corey, I think we have a visitor...
zh: 科里，我想我们有客人来了…

en: Well, what do you know? I was starting to get bored.
zh: 开什么玩笑？我刚好正觉得无聊呢。

en:
Poor Amy, I think I know what your brother made
her suffer through. He already had his eye on her before.
zh:
可怜的艾米，我大概知道你哥哥让她经历了
什么样的痛苦折磨。他以前就已经盯上她了。

en: I know. I'm sorry.
zh: 我知道，我很抱歉。

en: Where did they come from??
zh: 它们到底是从哪冒出来的？？

en: Leave us alone!
zh: 离我们远点！

en: Here. In your face!
zh: 吃我一拳！

en: Will they never leave us in peace?
zh: 它们难道就不能让我们清静清静吗？

en: Your friends, the spores, are pretty intrusive.
zh:
你的那些‘朋友’，就是这些孢子，
可真是有够死皮赖脸的。

en:
You don't know how close you are to the truth.
But I didn't choose to have them in my blood...
zh:
你根本不知道你有多接近真相。
但我也不想让这些脏东西流在我的血液里…

en:
Kenny can whine all he wants, but I experienced
my fair share of horrors at Leafmore too!
zh:
肯尼爱怎么抱怨是他的事，
但我在利夫莫尔经历的恐怖体验，
比起他来也只多不少！

en: I can imagine.
zh: 我能想象得出。

en: I hope Stan is OK...
zh: 我希望斯坦没事…

en: It seems you like him.
zh: 看起来你挺中意他的。

en: I'm just relieved that I'll see him again. That's all.
zh: 我只是想到能再次见到他，松了口气而已，仅此罢了。

en:
Now Shannon, I think you have
a crush on him! Yeah you do!
zh:
得了吧夏侬，我觉得你就是对他有意思！
承认吧，你绝对有！

en: OK. Forget it, you adolescent little boy.
zh: 行了，别说了，你这个幼稚的青春期小毛孩。

en:
Don't worry Shannon.
It happens to everybody, you know.
zh:
别担心，夏侬，这种事发生在
每个人身上都很正常，你懂的。

en:
You're a real warrior, Amy! And as blond
as a Norwegian goddess... A valkyrie!
zh:
你是个真正的战士，艾米！
你的金发就像北欧神话的女武神瓦尔基里一样！

en:
Sven, you are taking this scandinavian
routine a little bit too far!
zh: 斯文，你这套‘北欧梗’玩得未免也太过了吧！

en:
I know that you were born in Norway, but really,
you lived here all your life didn't you?
zh:
我知道你出生在挪威，但说真的，
你这一辈子不都是在这儿度过的吗？

en: A cemetery...
zh: 墓地…

en:
I saw a house just behind there.
We have to get passed this mausoleum.
zh:
我看到后面有一栋房子。
我们必须绕过这片墓地。

en: This mechanism isn't new!
zh: 这机关有些年月了！

en: These people must have something to hide.
zh: 这些人肯定有啥不可告人的秘密。

en:
At the dam, Sven... Kenny was there, wasn't he? 
What did he do to me?
zh:
在水坝那里，斯文…肯尼当时也在对吧？
他对我做了什么？

en: I don't know Amy! But he's dead now.
zh: 我不知道，艾米！但他现在已经死了。

en: Watch out!
zh: 小心！

en: Damn!
zh: 该死！

en: Are you okay Amy?
zh: 你没事吧，艾米？

en: What happened, Sven?
zh: 发生了什么事，斯文？

en: We were at the dam and... I don't remember!
zh: 我们当时在水坝，然后…我不记得了！

en: Try to forget about it...
zh: 那就试着去忘记它吧…

en: I feel... dirty...
zh: 我感觉…好脏…

en: I won't let you go, Amy, even if it kills me.
zh: 我不会放开你的，艾米，即使要了我的命也绝不放手。

en: Why? It's the same everywhere.
zh: 为什么？无论在哪儿都是一样的惨剧。

en: I'll take care of you.
zh: 我会照顾你的。

en: Thank you, Sven...
zh: 谢谢你，斯文…

en: Oh no. Here's another one!
zh: 哦不。又来了一只！

en: Just kill it!
zh: 直接杀了它！

en: We're there! The island isn't huge.
zh: 我们到了！这个岛并不大。

en: We'll end up finding the others.
zh: 我们迟早会找到其他人的。

en: It looks like a message left by an abandoned child...
zh: 这看起来像是一个被遗弃的孩子留下的留言…

en: Je... di... diah? What kind of name is that?
zh: 杰…迪…戴亚？这算什么名字？

en: Pfff! Who knows where they are!
zh: 嘁！谁知道他们在哪儿！

en: They could be almost anywhere around here.
zh: 他们大概就在这一带的某个地方。

en: Hey, I recognize them!
zh: 嘿，我认出他们了！

en: It looks as though we missed a few at Leafmore...
zh: 看来我们在利夫莫尔漏掉了几个怪物…

en: The inhabitants seem pretty calm here.
zh: 这里的居民看起来还挺安详的。

en:
Hey! We went into this huge house
that was falling apart. Where are you?
zh:
嘿！我们进了一栋快要坍塌的豪宅。
你们在哪儿呢？

en: Not far away, apparently. We're coming.
zh: 显然离得不远，我们来了。

en: What were those things??
zh: 刚才那些是什么东西？？

en: They were different from the other creatures.
zh: 它们和我们之前遇到的怪物不太一样。

en: Why are we fighting Stan?
zh: 斯坦，我们为什么要去拼死战斗？

en: Because we didn't survive adolescence just to die here...
zh:
因为我们九死一生撑过了利夫莫尔的青春期，
可不是为了到这儿来送命的…

en: Surviving? What about living? Living... right now?
zh:
仅仅是撑过去吗？那生活呢？
真正的活着…此时此刻？

en: That shout...
zh: 刚刚那声尖叫…

en: It's creeping me out.
zh: 听得我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

en: I picked up a battery pack in a storeroom.

"Stan Jones, average F"... It's strange.
I don't feel any nostalgia for this place.

“斯坦利·琼斯，平均成绩：不及格”…真奇怪。
我对这地方可没有一丝怀念。

en:
"Shannon Matthews, A+"
And look where it has gotten us...

“夏侬·马修斯，成绩：优秀”
可看看这成绩把我们带到了什么鬼地方…

en: What a mess!

en: It's strange. I feel almost nauseous...
zh: 真奇怪。我感觉直反胃…

en:
I feel bad about everything we lost here.
Our innocence for that matter.
zh:
我为我们在这儿失去的一切感到难过。
尤其是我们曾经的纯真。

en:
Those monsters just now... 
We fought them before, here at Leafmore!
zh:
刚才的那些怪物…
我们以前在利夫莫尔和它们打过交道！

en:
If there's such a thing as a destiny,
I want to exchange mine for a better one!
zh:
如果命运这玩意儿真的存在，
我真想把我这烂命换个好点儿的！

en: I think I'll become a locksmith.
zh: 我觉得我以后可以去当个锁匠了。

en:
There are more and more flowers!
I think we're due for some weeding.
zh:
这儿的花越来越多了！
我看是时候来一次大除草了。

en:
First, there's something I have to settle
with Mr Psycho-face. For Sven.
zh:
首先，我必须找那个电锯脸把账算清楚。
为了斯文。

en:

zh: 我们需要去找到其他人。他们一定在里面。

en:
We can't abandon the others like that,
we have to meet up with them!
zh: 我们不能就这样抛下其他人，我们必须去跟他们汇合！

zh: 你遇到什么麻烦需要我帮手吗？

en: Well, good... I think we're going to see the sun come up...
zh: 好吧，太好了…我想我们能看到太阳升起了…

en:
Stan? Shannon? We're in a bit of trouble here.
I managed to escape!
zh:
斯坦？夏侬？我们这儿遇到大麻烦了。
不过我想办法逃脱了！

en: They took Amy. I'm going to try to get her back.
zh: 他们把艾米带走了，我需要去把她救回来。

en: Don't do anything stupid Corey...
zh: 别做傻事，科里…

en: I can get them!
zh: 我能对付他们！

en: Corey... By yourself, you're going to get killed!
zh: 科里…只靠你一个人，你会送命的！

en: Fallcreek's middle-class dungeon!
zh: 秋溪大学的地下简直是地牢！

en: I always hated this place.
zh: 我一直都讨厌这个鬼地方。

en:
Socrates 3, this is Professor James,
do you read me? Over.
zh:
苏格拉底3号，我是詹姆斯教授，
能听到我说话吗？收到请回答。完毕。

en:
This is Socrates 3, I read you loud and clear.
We're hitting some turbulence. Stand by. Over.
zh:
我是苏格拉底3号，收听清晰。
我们目前正遇到气流颠簸。请稍候，完毕。

en: We have a new pick-up location: Lincoln stadium.
zh: 我们有了新的接头地点：林肯体育场。

en:
I repeat: pick up the specimen on
the Lincoln stadium grass. Over.
zh: 重复：去林肯体育场的草坪上带走样本，完毕。

en: Roger, Mr James. Lincoln Stadium. Out.
zh: 明白，詹姆斯先生，林肯体育场，通话结束。

en: Corey, what do you think you're doing?!
zh: 科里，你到底想干什么？！

en: For crying out loud!
zh: 哎呀，真是服了！

en: Wow... This fraternity building is huge!
zh: 哇…这个兄弟会大楼好大啊！

en: It looks like a ceremonial room...
zh: 看起来像是一个大礼堂…

en:
They're either megalomaniacs or they have
something they're trying to compensate for.
zh:
这帮人要么是狂妄自大，
要么就是有什么缺陷，企图通过这个来弥补。

en: ... They're escaping with Amy...
zh: …他们带着艾米逃跑了…

en: ... Hey... What is this?...
zh: …嘿…这是什么？…

en: .... No!! Not you... it's not possible...
zh: …不！！不是你…这不可能…

en: Useless walky-talky... !
zh: 这破对讲机又没用了…！

en: All these things come from Leafmore!
zh: 所有的这些东西全都是从利夫莫尔运来的！

en: It seems that the Friedmans are superstars here.
zh: 看起来弗里德曼兄弟在这儿简直就是偶像级的人物。

en: Great. So there's a future for psychopaths...
zh: 太好了，看来心理变态狂还是挺有前途的…

en:
They stuffed the things we fought
at Leafmore 2 years ago!
zh:
他们把我们两年前在利夫莫尔
打倒的怪物做成了标本！

en: Nice collection. That brings back memories...
zh: 收藏得真不错，这真勾起了回忆…

en: One of them still has bullet marks.
zh: 其中一个上面甚至还有子弹的痕迹。

en: So it's this tree that messed everything up...
zh: 所以，正是这棵变异树把一切都给毁了…

en: The first mortifilia...
zh: 第一株魔蒂菲拉…

en: I fought monsters in high school, did time in prison,
zh: 我在高中和怪物拼过命，坐过牢，

en:
and now I find myself in a fraternity of crazies,
just because some idiots sniffed some flowers...
zh:
而现在我居然身处一个疯子扎堆的兄弟会里，
仅仅是因为有些蠢货去闻了几朵花…

en:
At least you'll have something
interesting to tell your children.
zh:
至少你以后有挺有意思的事
可以讲给你的孩子们听了。

en: Sacrificing others is not a sacred thing!
zh: 牺牲别人可算不上什么神圣的事！

en: No, it's murder.
zh: 不，这就是谋杀。

en: Power always ends up in the hands of madmen...
zh: 权力最终总是会落入疯子们的手中…

en:
"Lost for the benefit of humanity, while they were
opening the gates of eternity"? Benefit? Uh... not really.
zh:
“为人类的利益而牺牲，与此同时，
他们正在开启永恒之门”？利益？呃…并不觉得。

en: Maybe they see the Friedmans that way...
zh:
也许在他们眼里，
弗里德曼兄弟就是那样的伟人吧…

en:
I never thought my brother would
become a deformed pervert...
zh:
我做梦也没想到我哥哥
会变成一个畸形的变态…

en: Deformed? Who are you calling deformed?!
zh: 畸形？你叫谁畸形呢？！

en:
I remember my sister was a pretty girl,
not the pathetic goth-wannabe that you are now!
zh:
我记忆里的妹妹是个漂亮的女孩，
而不是像你现在这样，是个可怜又做作的哥特非主流！

en: Come on, Stan. Show me what you can do. Give it to me...
zh:
来啊，斯坦，让我看看你有什么本事。
使出你的浑身解数来…

en: I'm too old to be playing games!
zh: 我都这把年纪了，可没闲心陪你玩游戏！

en:
I know you're afraid, Shannon. I can smell it.
You reek of fear and... hmmmm excitement, little sister?
zh:
我知道你害怕了，夏侬，我闻得出来。
你身上散发着恐惧的恶臭，还有…嗯哼，
兴奋的渴望，好妹妹？

en: Being afraid is a sign that I'm still human!
zh: 懂得害怕正说明我还算个人类！

en:
Hey Kenny! Maybe you should get something
for that skin of yours! You're breaking out my man!

en: I always thought that urban legends were fairy tales,
zh: 我过去一直觉得，那些都市传说不过是些奇幻故事，

en: But 2 years ago I attended Leafmore High,
zh: 但两年前，我就读于利夫莫尔高中，

en:
an old and respected educational institution
that was run by the Friedman brothers:
zh:
那是一所历史悠久且备受尊崇的教育机构，
由弗里德曼兄弟管理着。

en:
Leonard and Herbert - twin brothers
that had specialised in experimental botany.
zh:
莱纳德与赫伯特——这对双胞胎兄弟，
他们专攻实验植物学。

en:
Life was beautiful then, and I remember so many good
times with my friends Ashley, Josh, Kenny and Shannon...
zh:
那时候的生活非常美好，我还记得许多和朋友们
艾什莉、乔什、肯尼和夏侬在一起的快乐时光…

en:
... Until Herbert Friedman decided
to use the students as guinea pigs
zh:
直到赫伯特·弗里德曼决定，
将学生们当作实验小白鼠

en:
for an experiment that would save the life
of his diseased brother, Leonard.
zh:
去进行一项只为拯救他病入膏肓的
兄弟——莱纳德的实验。

en:
All of us were infected with mutated spores
that Friedman released into the air.
zh:
我们所有人都吸入了弗里德曼释放到
空气中的变异孢子，
并遭到了感染。

en: To survive, we had to kill our teachers.
zh: 为了活下来，我们不得不杀了我们的老师。

en:
After that night, I did a lot of
bad stuff and ended up in prison.
zh:
在那荒唐的一夜过后，我又做了很多混账事，
最终锒铛入狱。

en: But I served my time without protesting.
zh: 但我老老实实地坐完了牢，没有任何怨言。

en:
I'm out now, and I just want to forget
about Leafmore and everything that happened there.
zh:
我现在出狱了，我只想彻底遗忘利夫莫尔高中
以及在那里发生过的一切事情。

en: OK, I'm coming with you!
zh: 好的，我跟你们一起去！

en:
We have to get a move on, Mei.
We're going to miss the drinks at Sven's!
zh:
我们要加快动作了，梅。
不然我们就赶不上斯文那儿的接风酒了！

en: Mais, qu'est-ce qui se passe ?
zh: 但是，这到底发生什么了？

en: Do you want a better reason to fight?
zh: 你还想要一个更充足的战斗理由吗？

en: Come on, it's gone.
zh: 得了吧，它已经不在了。

en: Talk
zh: 交谈

en:
Take this syringe and test it on the dead monsters.
You should be able to create serum with...
zh:
拿上这个注射器，在怪物尸体上测试一下。
你应该能用提取的物质制作出血清…

en: It doesn't work.
zh: 没有效果。

en: I'm not leaving without Sven.
zh: 没有斯文我绝不离开。

en: I'm not going to go there without Shannon.
zh: 没有夏侬我是不会去那里的。

en: I'm not going to go there without Stan.
zh: 没有斯坦我是不会去那里的。

en:
The lock doesn't look very strong to me.
I think I can pick it!
zh:
这把锁看起来不是很牢固。
我觉得我能撬开它！

en: I'm sure I can pick the lock on that door.
zh: 我确信我能撬开那扇门上的锁。

en: I have the jitters.
zh: 我有点紧张得发抖。

en: I've gotta stop smoking weed.
zh: 我真的不能再抽大麻了。

en:
I've lost my touch since
I've settled down. It'll come back.
zh:
自从安定下来以后，我的手艺都生疏了。
不过很快就能找回感觉的。

en:
This lock is from before my time.
I don't recognize it at all!
zh:
这把古董锁肯定比我还老。
我完全认不出它的结构！

en: Hey! I can't get through! There must be a valve!
zh: 嘿！我过不去！这里肯定有一个阀门！

en: Hey! I can't get through! There must be a valve!
zh: 嘿！我过不去！这里肯定有一个阀门！

en: Shoot. If anything happens to Amy...
zh: 该死。要是艾米出了什么意外…

en: Buttons and rust all around. It's useless now.
zh: 按钮都生锈坏掉了，现在已经没用了。

en: I'm not going to get hit by a blade!
zh: 我可不想被砍一刀！

en:
It's all a question of timing...
Come on. Let's take a deep breath and go.
zh:
这完全是个时机把握的问题…
来吧。深吸一口气，冲！

en: I'm not leaving without Corey.
zh: 没有科里我不会走。

en: We're running out of fresh air.
zh: 我们快要缺氧了。

en:
There is this black thing on the door, Shannon.
Can you take a quick look?
zh:
门上有这团黑色的东西，夏侬。
你能过来看一下吗？

en:
This black thing is blocking the door.
Have a look at it, Shannon. I can't understand it.
zh:
这黑漆漆的东西堵住了门。
你来看看吧，夏侬。我看不懂这玩意。

en: Did you take a close look at the door?
zh: 你仔细看过那扇门了吗？

en:
We can't go through right now, but from here
we should be able to manage the pressure in the pipes.
zh:
我们目前无法过去，
不过从这里应该可以调节管道气压。

en:
We can't go through right now, but from here
we should be able to manage the pressure in the pipes.
zh:
我们目前无法过去，
不过从这里应该可以调节管道气压。

en:
By gradually redirecting the steam to the pipes,
we should be able to get through without getting burnt.
zh:
通过逐渐分流管道里的蒸汽，
我们就可以顺利穿过，不被烫伤。

en:
By gradually redirecting the steam to the pipes,
we should be able to get through without getting burnt.
zh:
通过逐渐分流管道里的蒸汽，
我们就可以顺利穿过，不被烫伤。

en:
One of us should try to move forward,
while the other controls the nozzles.
zh: 一个人试着向前推进，另一个人在控制台调节喷嘴。

en:
One of us should try to move forward,
while the other controls the nozzles.
zh: 一个人试着向前推进，另一个人在控制台调节喷嘴。

en:
There must be a master valve
around here, to cut off the pressure.
zh: 这附近应该有一个总阀，能切断整个气压。

en:
There must be a master valve
around here, to cut off the pressure.
zh: 这附近应该有一个总阀，能切断整个气压。

en: Be careful! I don't want to become fish food.
zh: 小心点！我可不想变成鱼饲料。

en: The elevator is out of service. We need to restore power.
zh: 电梯已停止服务。我们需要恢复电力供应。

en: My lock-picking kit hasn't been used in a while.
zh: 我的撬锁工具包已经很久没用过了。

en: We need welding equipment to repair this freight elevator!
zh: 我们需要电焊设备来修理这个货梯！

en:
Guys. If we don't have welding equipment,
we're not going to get Amy out of there!
zh:
伙计们。如果我们没有电焊设备，
就没办法把艾米从里面救出来！

en: Who are they???
zh: 它们是什么人？？？

en: Those things weren't like the others...
zh: 刚才那些怪物似乎和别的家伙不太一样…

en: Oh no! I lost my pills...
zh: 糟糕！我把药给弄丢了…

en: Amy!
zh: 艾米！

en: Hey!!! Don't touch her!!
zh: 喂！！！不许碰她！！

en:
Say goodbye to your offspring Kenny, because
whatever it is, we are not going to let it live.
zh:
跟你的孽种说再见吧，肯尼，
因为无论生出来的是个什么怪胎，
我们都绝不会让它活在这个世上。

en:
Sorry little brother, this family is dysfunctional
enough with just you and me in it.
zh:
抱歉了小老兄，光是咱们俩在，
这个家就已经够支离破碎的了。

en: The cellar door. It is closed.
zh: 地下室的门，它是关着的。

en: The bar... we're not going to find Jun there!
zh: 吧台…我们不可能在那里找到王珺的！

en:
This bar is well-stocked, but it's probably
not the right time to consume anything.
zh: 这个吧台藏酒丰富，不过现在显然不是喝酒的时候。

en: The power's back.
zh: 电力恢复了。

en: It's working now.
zh: 它现在恢复运作了。

en: My bed. It's my favorite playing field.
zh: 我的床，这是我最喜欢的战场。

en:
Corey's bed; as soft as the bottom
of a concrete swimming pool.
zh: 科里的床；硬得就像是水泥游泳池的池底一样。

en: The urinals are blocked.
zh: 小便池堵住了。

en: A pyramid made of different types of beer cans.
zh: 用各种啤酒罐堆成的金字塔。

en: I've broken nearly all my bones with this skateboard...
zh: 我玩这块滑板时，浑身的骨头几乎都被摔断过一次…

en: Corey's skateboard. My only rival.
zh: 科里的滑板，我唯一的宿敌。

en:
You can see into the campus gardens
through the window.
zh: 透过这扇窗户，你可以看到学校的花园。

en: My office. I love the mess, it's my way of doing things.
zh:
我的书桌。
我就喜欢这种凌乱感，这就是我的行事风格。

en: It's the same sort of chaos in Corey's head.
zh: 科里的脑子估计也是这样乱七八糟。

en: My bed. It's my favorite playing field.
zh: 我的床，这是我最喜欢的战场。

en:
Corey's bed; as soft as the bottom
of a concrete swimming pool.
zh: 科里的床；硬得就像是水泥游泳池的池底一样。

en: My cupboard. There's only old stuff in there.
zh: 我的壁橱，里面只堆了一些过时的旧物。

en: Corey's closet. A frightening place.
zh: 科里的衣柜。一个阴森恐怖的地方。

en: Show your face in room 200, Sven
zh: 来200号房间露个面，斯文

en: A vending machine. It's my fault if it's out of order.
zh: 自动贩卖机，它坏了都是我的错。

en:
I've already tried hacking this machine,
but it's out of order.
zh:
我以前试着破解过这台机器，
不过它已经坏掉了。

en: Vending machine for processed sugar and bad coffee.
zh: 售卖精制糖和劣质咖啡的自动贩卖机。

en: I don't think they want to be disturbed.
zh: 我觉得他们不想被打扰。

en: The toilets are filthy
zh: 厕所里非常肮脏。

en: A tangle of dirty toilet paper blocks the passage.
zh: 一团脏兮兮的卫生纸堵住了过道。

en:
An old telephone that is sometimes
taken for a slot machine.
zh: 一部老式电话机，有时会被人误当成老虎机。

en: Candles. We're really in the girls wing.
zh: 蜡烛，果然是在女生宿舍区。

en: Exotic and humorous postcards.
zh: 异域风情且充满幽默的明信片。

en: The wall is covered in gaudy flyers.
zh: 墙上贴满了花里胡哨的传单。

en:
Here lies Corey Wilde, who lived
in anger and died because of it.
zh:
这里躺着科里·怀尔德，
他一生都活在愤怒之中，并因此而丧命。

en:
Here lies Mei Wang, who only loved her sister
because it was like looking in a mirror.
zh:
这里躺着王梅，她之所以只爱她妹妹，
仅仅是因为那感觉就像是在照镜子。

en: I drink water here whenever I have a hangover.
zh: 每次我宿醉难受的时候，都会来这儿喝水。

en: I love this fountain! I always use it when I am thirsty!
zh:
我爱死这个饮水机了！
我口渴的时候总会来这儿喝水！

en: The gate is closed solid.
zh: 铁门被牢牢锁死。

en: The gate closes electronically.
zh: 大门是电子控制关闭的。

en: A cabinet for the residents' files.
zh: 用来存放宿舍成员档案的柜子。

en: Office supplies.
zh: 办公用品。

en:
A note that says: 
"Washrooms are not bedrooms".
zh: 一张写着“洗手间不是卧室”的便签。

en: This machine is a caffeine dealer for the entire residence.
zh: 这台机器就是整个宿舍楼的‘咖啡因供应商’。

en:
The safety regulations of the student dormitory.
We have violated all of them.
zh:
学生宿舍的安全条例。
不过我们把上面的规矩全都触犯了个遍。

en: Some flyers for the Burning Balls concert.
zh: 几张‘燃烧之球’乐队演唱会的传单。

en: Nice-smelling candles.
zh: 香薰蜡烛。

en: Foreign postcards for exchange students.
zh: 写给交换生的国外明信片。

en:
This fountain distributes water that tastes
like it came from a flower vase.
zh:
这个饮水机里流出来的水，
尝起来就像是花瓶里的水一样有股怪味。

en: A closet full of boxes.
zh: 堆满箱子的壁橱。

en: Some candles.
zh: 几支蜡烛。

en: Boxes containing the rotting remains of food.
zh: 装着腐烂食物残渣的箱子。

en: This girl's life has gone down the wash basin.
zh: 这个女孩的一生就像水流进洗脸池一样彻底完了。

en:
The window shattered when Jun
was thrown through it. That was a terrible fall.
zh:
珺被扔出去的时候撞碎了这扇窗户。
那一摔太惨烈了。

en: Jun's bed. Nothing more frigid to me than this.
zh:
王珺的床，
对我来说，没有比这更冰冷的地方了。

en:
Jun's bed. I like listening to
her breathing when she sleeps.
zh:
王珺的床，
我喜欢在她睡觉时听着她的呼吸声。

en: Mei's bed. It's nothing like mine.
zh: 王梅的床，和我的床完全不一样。

en: My bed. That's where I dream of Corey.
zh: 我的床，我就是在这儿梦见科里的。

en: Jun's desk.
zh: 王珺的书桌。

en: Mei's desk. She's the computer geek of this dorm.
zh:
王梅的书桌。
她是这栋宿舍楼里的电脑怪杰。

en:
My desk. On it is the PC that
I am modding at this moment.
zh:
我的书桌。
上面有我目前正在改装的电脑。

en:
Chinese calligraphy that represents
enjoyment. One of each.
zh:
写着‘享乐’二字的中国书法作品。
我们一人一幅。

en: Jun's arm - soaked with her blood. Poor, poor Jun.
zh:
王珺的断臂——浸满了她的鲜血。
可怜的王珺。

en: The grid is closed.
zh: 铁栅栏门已经锁上了。

en:
No use going there, 
Jun didn't go in that direction.
zh: 去那里没用，珺不是往那个方向去的。

en: These machines don't give out change or drinks.
zh: 这些售货机既不吐零钱也不出饮料。

en: It's locked and I've lost my keys.
zh: 锁上了，而我把钥匙给丢了。

en: No need to go here, Jun can't be found this way.
zh: 不用过去，那边找不到珺的。

en: No need to go here, Jun can't be found this way.
zh: 不用过去，那边找不到珺的。

en: If I look in there, Mei will gauge my eyes out.
zh: 如果我往里乱看，梅绝对会把我的眼睛给挖出来的。

en: They won't open for me. I'm known here.
zh: 她们不会给我开门的。大家早就认识我了。

en: A soda machine for the ladies.
zh: 一台专门给女生们准备的汽水机。

en: We could climb up there. But it is too high.
zh: 我们可以爬到那上面。但它实在太高了。

en: A monitoring display.
zh: 一台监控显示器。

en: Impossible to continue that way: it's closed.
zh: 无法继续前进了：门锁着呢。

en: No need to go here, Jun can't be found this way.
zh: 不用过去，那边找不到珺的。

en: The fitness gym is closed.
zh: 健身房关门了。

en: This girl's life flowed away like water down the drain.
zh: 这个女孩的生命，就像下水道里的水一样流逝了。

en: Corey's memo-board, He wouldn't survive without it.
zh: 科里的记事板，要是没有这玩意儿他根本就没法活。

en: A magnetic card reader.
zh: 一个磁卡读卡器。

en: Some lockers where  students hide their liquor.
zh: 学生们用来藏私酒的一些储物柜。

en:
A small dormitory garbage can.
The smell coming from it is terrible.
zh:
宿舍里的小垃圾桶。
从里面散发出来的味道实在是太难闻了。

en: An electric panel. It is Jun who put the current back on.
zh:
一个配电盘。
是珺把电源给接通的。

en: This garbage has been haunting the cellar for an eternity.
zh: 这些垃圾已经在地下室里堆了有八辈子了。

en: You have to find a way of getting up.
zh: 你必须想办法爬上去。

zh: 挣扎

zh: 战斗

zh: 降下

zh: 确定

zh: 按SELECT键( <PS2_SELECT> )显示物品栏。

zh: 继续游戏

zh: 重新控制角色

zh: 读取游戏存档

Are you sure you want to exit the current game?
The progress you have made so far will be lost.
zh:
确定要退出当前游戏吗？
你当前的游戏进度将会丢失。

You can manage your weapons in the weapons menu.
Press <PS2_SELECT> to display it.
zh:
你可以在武器菜单中管理你的武器。
按 <PS2_SELECT> 显示菜单。

en:
You can manage your weapons in the weapons menu.
Press SELECT button (<PS2_SELECT>) to display.
zh:
你可以在武器菜单中管理你的武器。
按SELECT键( <PS2_SELECT> )显示菜单。

en:
The weapons screen lets you assign up to
4 weapons per person.
zh: 武器界面允许你为每人分配最多4件武器。

en:
Press <PS2_R1> or <PS2_L1> until the list of 
weapons displays.
zh:
按下 <PS2_R1> 或 <PS2_L1> 键，
直到显示武器列表。

en: Amy!
zh: 艾米！

en: Mei!
zh: 梅！

en: How are you? Are you ok?
zh: 你怎么样？你还好吗？

en:
We've been worse. You haven't seen
Sven and Jun have you?
zh: 我们还撑得住。你看见斯文和珺了吗？

en: Quite a specimen you've got there! Who are you?
zh: 你那儿居然有这么个怪物标本！你是谁？

en:
Richard James. I teach Biology on campus and
I mentor the Delta Theta Gamma Brotherhood.
zh:
理查德·詹姆斯，我是学校的生物老师，
也是德尔塔·西塔·伽马兄弟会的导师。

en: What are these things?
zh: 这些东西到底是什么？

en: For now all I can say is that it is, or once was, human
zh: 目前我只能说，它曾经…至少曾经是人类。

en:
The organs are all still there. There are these
purple marksall over it.
zh:
器官都完好地保留着。
但它浑身都布满了这种紫色的斑痕。

en:
This... this is Matt! I recognize his tattoo!
But we saw him not that long ago and he was fine!
zh:
这…这是麦特！我认得他的纹身！
可是我们不久前才见过他，他当时还好好的啊！

en: It's that flower that's done this!
zh: 是那种花害了他！

en: Flower?
zh: 花？

en: That one we smelled!
zh: 就是我们闻过的那种！

en: Given the nightmares I've had, I am inclined to agree.
zh: 考虑到我做过的那些噩梦，我倾向于同意这一说法。

en:
Students remain as they are, quite...
oblivious of certain biological laws.
zh:
学生们还是一如既往，对某些生物学定律…
完全是一无所知啊。

en: But if you've smelled it too, why haven't you all mutated?
zh: 可是如果你们也闻过它，为什么你们没有变异？

en:
We... We took an energy drink to fight off a headache.
Maybe that counters whatever it is that makes
you go crazy? Hell... I don't know!
zh:
我们…我们当时因为头痛喝了瓶能量饮料。
也许那玩意能抵消导致人发疯的某些毒素？
该死…我也不清楚！

en: I haven't felt anything.
zh: 我倒是什么感觉都没有。

en: I'm going to do some tests on this flower and this... student
zh: 我准备对这朵花，还有这个…学生做些化验检测。

en:
You'll find an exit if you go
through the dance hall. Good luck!
zh: 穿过舞厅你们就能找到出口。祝你们好运！

zh: 宿醉

zh: 兄弟会惊魂

zh: 终于重见天日

zh: 科里的爱车

zh: 寻找王珺

zh: 在王珺的房间

zh: 医院的哀歌

zh: 病房

zh: 医院实验室

zh: 医院仓库

zh: 进入水坝

zh: 配电箱房

zh: 需要拯救的艾米

zh: 离开水坝

zh: 浮桥小吃店

zh: 墓地

zh: 肮脏的浴室

en: In the house's basement
zh: 古宅地下室

zh: 废墟中的厕所

zh: 利夫莫尔高中，中央庭院

zh: 悬在高处的桌子

en: Depths of Leafmore
zh: 利夫莫尔的深渊

en: Return to the Brotherhood
zh: 重返兄弟会

en: The enthroning room
zh: 加冕厅

en: The stadium
zh: 体育场

en: Where are Amy and Kenny?
zh: 艾米和肯尼在哪儿？

en: Reunion
zh: 重聚

en: Amy?? Damn, what is she doing!?
zh: 艾米？？该死，她在那儿干什么！？

en: The elevator controls are dead...
zh: 电梯控制面板锁死了…

en: Stan?! Stan!!!
zh: 斯坦？！斯坦！！！

en: PICASSO
zh: PICASSO

en: LINCOLN
zh: LINCOLN

en: PASTEUR
zh: PASTEUR

en: DEVINCI
zh: DEVINCI

en: Mei?!
Corey!!! Where are you??
zh: 科里！！！你在哪里？？

en: I'm at the hospital with Amy... My car: it's dead...
zh: 我和艾米在医院呢…至于我的车，它彻底报废了…

en: I'm worried about you Corey...

en:
The viral infection has spread quickly
on campus. From 9 recorded patients
last month, the figure has increased
to 34 today. Everything points
to a general lack of moral standards
when considering how fast the contamination
has spread. The disease is developing
mainly among those who enjoy nights
of binge-drinking, and unprotected intercourse.

This new virus is easily transmitted
through bodily fluids. On the other hand,
"traditional" STD's are in regression.
It is like the new virus is killing off the competition [...]
zh:
病毒感染在校园内迅速蔓延。
从上个月登记在案的9名病患，
到今天这个数字已经激增至34人。
鉴于污染扩散之快，所有证据都指向了
学生们普遍缺乏道德约束。
该疾病主要在热衷于夜间狂欢纵酒以及
无保护性行为的群体中传播。

这种新病毒极易通过体液传播。
另一方面，‘传统’性病却在呈现减少趋势。
这感觉就像是新病毒正在将竞争对手消灭殆尽…

en:
[...] Fallcreek campus is plagued by
a collective psychosis. The mental affliction
is strangely contradictory: on the one hand
it causes a profound sexual anxiety and,
on the other, a hyperactive libido.

The students are disorientated,
and are torn between their fears
and an insatiable sexual appetite.

Some have recurring nightmares
that reveal primitive and violent emotions
emerging from their subconciousness [...]
zh:
…秋溪大学校园正遭受着集体精神病症的困扰。
这种精神折磨是奇妙的矛盾体：一方面，
它引起了深刻的性焦虑；
但另一方面，它又极度亢进了性冲动。

学生们彻底迷失了方向，
挣扎在内心的恐惧与无法被满足的生理欲望之间。

部分人开始出现反复发作的恶梦，
这些梦境展现了正从他们潜意识深处苏醒的
原始而暴力的情感…

en:
Male subject 22 years old, Rh factor O neg.
Cause of death: Victim bled to death
after having been cut and raked by
an unknown weapon [...]

Remarks: The body contains traces
of an unknown black substance, concentrated
in the lungs and in the genital area.

The lungs are definitely the first area
that was exposed to the substance
(which seems parasitic in nature);
probably after taking some kind of narcotic
via the respiratory system.

This death is to be connected with that
of the girlfriend of the victim. Her lungs
were completely clean, contrary
to her reproductive organ. Contagion through
genital contact with any of the
bodies mucus membranes (through
intercourse for example) seems likely
at this point.

I recommend an epidemiological study
at Fallcreek Academic Hospital
to identify the viral agent.
zh:
男性受害者，22岁，Rh阴性O型血。
死因：受害者在被未知武器切割和
抓伤后失血过多而死…

备注：尸体体内含有未知黑色物质的残留，
主要集中在肺部和生殖器区域。

肺部绝对是第一个接触到该物质（看起来
具有寄生性）的区域，
这很可能是通过呼吸系统吸入了某种毒品后导致的。

此死因可能与受害者女友的死亡存在关联。
与受害者不同，该女的肺部非常干净，
但她的生殖器官里却发现了这种物质。
目前来看，通过生殖接触以及
身体任何粘膜接触（例如性行为）
进行传染的可能性极高。

我建议在秋溪大学附属医院展开流行病学研究，
以查明这种病毒病原体。

en:
The flower seems to be the product
of a cross between several parasitical plants.

It is able to relieve pain and act
as an anaesthetic, but causes extremely lucid
and frightening hallucinations as well.
There are indications that the flower
has enjoyed some popularity as a party drug
amongst the student population of Fallcreek.

As they opened their petals this evening,
the flowers released a massive cloud
of black spores that seemed to act independent
of each other during their dispersal.

At the same time that the flowers blossomed,
their parasitic spores activated themselves
in the bodies of those who had used them
for recreational purposes.

This process remains unexplained,
but it is certain that the metamorphosis
of the students took place at this point.
zh:
这种花似乎是几种寄生植物杂交的产物。

它能够缓解疼痛并起到麻醉作用，
但同时也会引起极其清晰且令人惊恐的幻觉。
有迹象表明，这种花作为一种派对毒品在
秋溪大学的学生群体中颇受欢迎。

今晚当它们绽放花瓣时，这些花释放了
大量的黑色孢子云，
这些孢子在扩散过程中似乎彼此独立运作。

在花朵绽放的同时，
寄生的孢子，将会在吸食此花的人体内被激活。

这其中的原理依然无法解释，但可以肯定的是，
学生们的变异正是从这一刻发生的。

en:
The flower is sensitive to light. Nevertheless
it has a very effective defense system:
if exposed to a source of light it closes
its petals hermetically, protecting
it's photosensitive cells.

Sunlight was unable to prevent
its propagation throughout Fallcreek County.
The flowers feed and propagate from
a supremely widespread root system which
- in order to destroy it - must be terminated
at the source.

Regrettably, because of the complex
root structure, we are unable to locate
it's origins at this time.
zh:
这种花对光线很敏感。然而它有一套
非常有效的防御系统：
一旦暴露在光源下，它就会紧紧闭合花瓣，
以保护其感光细胞。

阳光也无法阻止它在整个秋溪县的蔓延繁殖。
这些花是通过一个极度庞大的根系网络
获取养分并扩散的，
要彻底铲除它们，必须从源头上斩断根系。

遗憾的是，由于其复杂的根系结构，
我们目前仍然无法找到它的源头所在。

en:
April 16, 1903.

I, Theodore Willidge, current President of
the United States of America, today pledge
allegiance before the High Brothers of Delta Theta Gamma.

As an honorary member of the Fraternity, I pledge
to open the doors of government to its members,
and to provide them with political, legislative,
administrative and financial support.

By my blood, I pledge to ensure the perpetuity
of the bond of honor that unites Delta Thêta Gamma
and the American States. Together, we will make sure
that any new president who comes to power will be
trained and enthroned. In this way, there will always be
a virtuous soul at the heart of our country [...]
zh:
1903年4月16日。

我，西奥多·威利奇，现任美利坚合众国总统，
今日在德尔塔·西塔·伽马的高阶兄弟面前立誓效忠。

作为本兄弟会的名誉成员，
我承诺向兄弟会成员敞开政府大门，
并为他们提供政治、立法、行政和财政方面的支持。

我以我的热血起誓，确保维系德尔塔·西塔·伽马
与美利坚合众国之间的荣誉纽带万世不替。
我们将共同确保，
任何新登台的总统都必须经过兄弟会的培养与加冕。
如此，我们国家的心脏地带将永远会有
一位充满道德品质的灵魂执掌政权…

en:
"Mens sana in corpore sano."

Because the spirit is also influenced by the body,
Delta Theta Gamma requires that its members
be in excellent physical condition.

On Wednesday, the traditional rowing
and nature orientation trials will take place.
To obtain instructions, meet at the summer
headquarters of the fraternity on the edge of the lake!
zh:
“健全的精神寓于健康的体魄。”

因为人的精神同样受到肉体的影响，
德尔塔·西塔·伽马兄弟会要求其成员必须具备
极其优秀的身体素质。

本周三将进行传统的赛艇和户外定向越野测验。
请到湖畔的兄弟会避暑总部集合获取指示！

en:
April 18, 1903.

I'm stuck here, at Leafmore. My body can no longer
tolerate light after I injected myself with mortifilia cells.

It's changing... I can no longer move.
Undoubtedly, I won't be able to write anymore soon.
I failed. Instead of giving me eternity, mortifilia
is going to kill me. How ironic!

I leave behind me my young son, Jedidiah.
The genes I transmitted to him during conception
were already mutating. Even so, his mother
and I wanted him to live. He is strong,
but his psychological state is troubling.
At times he can be very agressive.

Mortifilia has powers that exceed my predictions.
My emotions are changing. Anger rises
in me more and more frequently. [...]
zh:
1903年4月18日。

我被困在利夫莫尔这里了。
在向体内注射了魔蒂菲拉细胞后，
我的身体再也无法承受光线了。
它正在发生质变…我再也无法动弹。
毫无疑问，用不了多久，我就会字也写不了。
我失败了。
魔蒂菲拉非但没有赐我永生，反而要夺去我的性命。
真是莫大的讽刺！

我留下我年幼的儿子，杰迪戴亚。
我传递给他的基因已经发生了变异。
但即便如此，我和他的母亲还是希望他活下去。
他很坚强，但他的心理状态很令人担忧。
有时候他会表现得极具攻击性。

魔蒂菲拉的威力超出了我的预测。
我的情绪正在被它左右。
我感到越来越难以抑制内心的狂怒。…

en:
"Leafmore private school was voted
to be closed for demolition yesterday"
declared our mayor, Mr. Hazelhof.

The high school, built in 1902 by
the brothers Leonard and Herbert Friedman,
apparently has serious water drainage problems.
A team of experts was sent to the site and found
that the basement of the school was flooded
and that there was some kind of parasite infestation.

Parents took the opportunity to bring up the case
of the unexplained disappearance of students
from the boarding school. "It is unacceptable
to ignore the pain of the parents in this way",
declared Mr. Craig, the father of one of the
victims, who thinks that "the cover-up of this
matter seems to be convenient for a lot of
people in high places" [...]
zh:
“利夫莫尔私立学校已于昨日经投票决定
关闭并予以拆除，”
我们的市长哈泽尔霍夫先生宣布。

这所由莱纳德与赫伯特·弗里德曼兄弟于
1902年建造的高中，
显然存在严重的排水问题。
一队专家被派往现场，发现学校地下室被淹，
并且存在某种寄生虫泛滥的情况。

家长们借此机会提起了该学校学生离奇失踪的事件。
“像这样无视家长们的痛苦是无法让人接受的，”
其中一名受害者的父亲克雷格先生声称，
他认为“对此事的蓄意隐瞒，
似乎迎合了许多高层人士的利益”…

en:
May 6, 1904. 103rd Traditional Ceremony
of the Assembly of Lodges; Paris, in the
basement of 51 rue de Montmorency. 

We thank each Head Lodge of our ninety-six
brother countries to have sent their Master
of Ceremonies on this occasion. 

On the occasion of this celebration,
the High Brothers have unanimously
voted to enscribe the recent works
of Leonard and Herbert Friedman
in the Fraternity's codices. 

Their discoveries concerning the possibility
of eternal life promise Delta Theta Gamma
a paramount place among the prominent powers
of this planet.
zh:

51号的地下室举行。

在此我们感谢来自96个友好国家的各分会
派出了他们的代表。

在此次庆典上，高阶兄弟们一致投票通过，
将莱纳德和赫伯特·弗里德曼最近的科学
成果载入兄弟会法典。

他们关于永生可能的发现，
将许诺德尔塔·西塔·伽马在地球的
各大顶峰势力中占据至高无上的地位。

zh: 已解锁。
