en: Oh no! I've lost the connection.
zh: 糟糕！连接中断了。

en: The computer is locked up. I'll have to hack the password.
zh: 电脑被锁定了，我需要破解密码才行。

en: The security system is broken.
zh: 安全系统已经损坏。

en: Hack
zh: 破解

en:
It looks as though you open it with a card.
I'm sure that Mei could hack that.
But she's not here and I don't want to wait for her.
zh:
看起来这地方需要用磁卡才能打开。
我相信王梅能黑进系统。
不过她不在这儿，而我可不想浪费时间等她。

en:
It looks as though you open it with a card.
I'm sure that Mei could hack that.
zh:
看起来这需要刷卡才能打开。
我相信王梅能破解它。

en: Press the aptitude button (<PS2_CIRCLE>) so that Mei can hack.
zh: 按下特技键( <PS2_CIRCLE> )让梅进行破解。

en: It's too high for me to reach.
zh: 太高了，我够不到。

en: Come in, Come in!
zh: 快进来，快进来！

en: Wow! What is in there?
zh: 哇！里面是什么？

en:
Everyone on campus has been making
tea with this flower for a month.
zh:
这一个月来，
校园里的每个人都在用这种花泡茶喝呢。

en: It's time we tried it!
zh: 我们也该尝一尝了！

en: Hey neighbours!
zh: 嘿，邻居们！

en: Hey!
zh: 嘿！

en: Kenny! What are you doing?!
zh: 肯尼！你在做什么？！

en: Great! My sister!
zh: 真行！我老妹来了！

en: Come over here, now!
zh: 现在马上给我过来！

en: I'll see you all at the party!
zh: 我们在派对上见吧！

en: Weird family...
zh: 真是古怪的一家人…

en:
Do you think they'll let us in
to the Delta Theta Gamma party?
zh: 你觉得他们会放我们进德尔塔·西塔·伽马的派对吗？

en: If you're with me that won't be an issue!
zh: 只要你跟我在一起，那就绝对没问题！

en: Here, smell this, it'll melt your nostrils.
zh: 给，闻闻这个，这味儿够顶的。

en: It's really exclusive...
zh: 那个派对真的很难混进去…

en: I'm fed up of waiting!
zh: 我真的不想一直等待了！

en: You were a lot quieter when you were ill.
zh: 你生病那会儿可要安静多了。

en:
Is it the lack of a female presence
that's making you so jittery?
zh: 是因为这儿没有女人，让你感到焦躁不安了吗？

en: Shannon!! You scared me half to death!
zh: 夏侬！！你差点把我吓尿了！

en:
I'm not a baby anymore, Stan.
I shoot just as well as you now.
zh:
我再也不是以前那个小女孩了，斯坦。
我现在枪法跟你一样好。

en: We can't stay here any longer! We gotta keep going!
zh: 我们不能在这儿待下去了！我们要继续前进！

en: There's another boat not far from here.
zh: 这里不远还有另外一艘船。

en: Sven!!
zh: 斯文！！

en: Get out of here Amy! I'll keep him off!
zh: 快离开这儿！艾米！我来挡住他！

en: Now Amy!!!
zh: 就是现在，艾米！！！

en: Welcome to Leafmore, guys.
zh: 欢迎来到利夫莫尔，伙计们。

en: Did you catch him?
zh: 你们抓住他了吗？

en: No.
zh: 没有。

en:
Well the freak that killed Sven is still here.
This is his home, his playground.
zh:
定下心来，杀害斯文的那个变态应该还在里面。
这里是他的家，是他的游乐场。

en:
Kenny... you monster... you didn't...
you wouldn't do that to Amy, would you?
zh:
肯尼…你这个魔鬼…你不会…
你不会对艾米做出那种禽兽不如的事吧？

en: Contractions?
zh: 宫缩了？

en: Stay calm! Relax. You need medical attention.
zh:
保持冷静！放松。
你需要医生救治。

en: I don't care! I want this to be over! For all of us!
zh:
我不管！我只想让这一切早点结束！
让我们所有人解脱！

en: At last we'll be able to let our hair down.
zh: 我们终于能在这儿彻底放松一下了。

en: We are almost in paradise! Man I'm thirsty!
zh: 我们快到天堂了！天呐我真是有够口渴的！

en: I'm saving myself for the dance floor!
zh: 我就留着精力等到时候上舞池去跳了！

en: You can smell the beer from here, that's promising!
zh: 站在这儿都能闻到啤酒香了，这真的很让人期待啊！

en: Hey! Where are you going? The beer's on the other side!
zh: 嘿！你要去哪儿？啤酒在另一边呢！

en:
Hey, where are you going?
You're not scared of having fun are you?
zh: 嘿，你这是要去哪？你不会是害怕去寻欢作乐吧？

en: Once we're inside, I'm heading straight for the bar.
zh: 一进大门，我就会直奔吧台去喝酒。

en: A hot party is guaranteed with that music!
zh: 有这种带感的音乐伴奏，这派对绝对会嗨翻天！

en: I can't take it anymore, I have to dance!
zh: 我真的受不了了，我必须得跳舞！

en: Mmmm. All this bass is nice, it's doing things to me...
zh:
嗯…这重低音真的很带劲，
我的身体都忍不住想跟着摇摆了…

en:
I'm donating my body to mankind now,
and I'll donate it to science later.
zh:
我现在把肉体奉献给人类，
等以后我再把它捐献给科学事业。

en:
The chairs! Get the chairs and
smash them over their heads!
zh:
椅子！去搬那些椅子，
往它们的头上狠狠地砸下去！

en:
There has to be some kind of logic to this thing. We must
be missing a bit otherwise I would have seen the combination!
zh:
这玩意儿的设计肯定有一定的逻辑。
我们绝对是漏掉了什么，否则我早就
看出它的密码组合了！

en: That gallery up there might lead to a way out.
zh: 上面的那条过道也许能通向出口。

en: That gallery up there might lead to a way out.
zh: 上面的那条过道也许能通向出口。

en:
The combination for the shelves must be written down some-
-where. The brothers are bound to have hidden it, for sure!
zh:
打开这些架子的密码一定写在某个地方。
那两兄弟绝对把它藏起来了，我确信！

en: It's closed. Anyhow, the party's not here.
zh: 门关着。反正在这儿是开不成派对的。

en: What a strange little key...
zh: 好奇怪的小钥匙…

en: What a strange little key...
zh: 好奇怪的小钥匙…

en:
There's a note: "Only to be opened in case of an emergency by
authorised persons. Contact Delta Theta Gamma headquarters."
zh:
这里有一张字条：“本系统仅限紧急情况
下由授权人员开启。
如有疑问请联系德尔塔·西塔·伽马总部。”

en: Go sweat somewhere else, big guy.
zh: 去别的地方流汗吧，傻大头。

en: Get lost and take your bimbo with you.
zh: 有多远滚多远，顺便带上你的蠢女人一起。

en:
Get your quarterback to run along now,
I don't want to see you here again.
zh: 快叫你的四分卫滚开，我再也不想在这儿见到你了。

en: Are you just too blonde to grasp it? Get lost!!!
zh: 你的脑瓜子是不是和你的头发一样苍白？滚出去！！！

en:
I'm hurt and they've killed my boyfriend!!! It will soon
be your turn! Take the gun in the billiards room... !!!
zh:
我受伤了，而且他们还残忍地杀害了我的男朋友！！！
很快就该轮到你们了！快去桌球室里把枪拿上…！！！

en:
They're killing each other...
The gun is in a safe in the games room!
zh:
他们正在自相残杀…
武器就放在游戏室的保险箱里！

en:
The code for the safe must be hidden
somewhere in the corner!
zh: 保险箱的密码一定就藏在角落里的某个地方！

en: What a nightmare!...
zh: 这简直就是场噩梦！…

en: What are we going to do?
zh: 我们该怎么办才好？

en: They killed my boyfriend! They ripped his head off!
zh: 他们杀了我男朋友！他们残忍地拧下了他的脑袋！

en: They're going to take us... Just like the others...
zh: 它们会把我们全都抓走的…就像对待其他人那样…

en:
My head is spinning... blasted flower...
I shouldn't have inhaled it...
zh:
我的头一直在眩晕…那该死的花…
我不应该去吸那香气的…

en: Watch out Amy!
zh: 当心，艾米！

en: Look out Kenny!
zh: 小心，肯尼！

en: There it is! Now that I like!
zh: 就是那个！现在我可来劲了！

en: Come here my sweet...
zh: 来吧，我的小宝贝…

en: If you fancy a drink I took a leak in the corner earlier...
zh:
如果你想喝一杯的话，
我刚才在角落里撒了一泡尿…

en: Move, I don't want your implants blowing up in my face.
zh: 走开点，我可不想让你假奶子的硅胶炸到我脸上。

en: Is that the help you promised?! Where are the cops??
zh: 这就是你承诺的支援？！警察都到哪去了？？

en: What's your problem??
zh: 你到底有什么毛病？？

en: She is our responsibility now.
zh: 她现在是我们来负责了。

en:
My dear Stan, the mortifilia that you knew
two years ago was only a dress rehearsal,
zh:
我亲爱的斯坦，两年前你在这儿见识到的魔蒂菲拉，
只是一次彩排罢了，

en:
The Friedmans only just failed. Their plant refused
to be subjected to the demands of the human body.
zh:
弗里德曼兄弟仅仅是棋差一招。
他们的植物当时拒绝对人类的身体结构进行妥协。

en: But this evening, nature has helped us well...
zh: 但今晚，大自然眷顾了我们…

en: Nature?! Not likely! Friedman was still alive!
zh: 大自然？！绝无可能！弗里德曼当时还活着！

en:
"Was"? Oh... At least he will have completed his work.
Your friend has brought us new hope.
zh:
“当时”？噢…但至少，他已经完成了他的心血。
你的朋友为我们带来了全新的希望。

en:
You pig! You watched all those people
die without doing anything!!
zh:
你这个畜生！
眼睁睁看着那么多人死去，却袖手旁观！！

en:
My colleagues were late to arrive, I'm sorry.
These sacrifices were inevitable
zh:
我的同事们迟到了，对此我很抱歉。
但在科学面前，这些牺牲是无法避免的

en: Where is Shannon ?
zh: 夏侬在哪儿？

en: You will be with her soon.
zh: 你很快就会去陪她了。

en: I want to sleep.
zh: 我好想睡觉。

en: of which this is the ultimate evolution.
zh: 而这就是它的终极进化型。

en: A bust. Man that model must have been ugly.
zh: 一座半身像，天哪，模特本人肯定长得很丑。

en: Jeez. A bust of Friedman. When he was he still human.
zh: 天呐。弗里德曼还没变成怪物时的半身雕像。

en: Man... A picture of Friedman. I really ain't nostalgic.
zh: 天…弗里德曼的照片。我可真是一点也不怀旧。

en: A statue. I think I know that dude..
zh: 一座雕像。我想我认得这家伙…

en: You'd think it was a morgue photo.
zh: 你甚至会觉得这是张停尸房里的遗照。

en: A pretty freaky looking picture...
zh: 一张看起来非常诡异的照片…

en:
There's an unobstructed view of
some fine looking boys in there.
zh: 能一览无遗地看见里面有几个帅哥在走动。

en: I can see some pretty girls inside.
zh: 我能看见里面有几个漂亮女孩子。

en: Yeah, I can think of more interesting hobbies than darts.
zh: 啊，比起扔飞镖，我能想到更多有趣的消遣方式。

en: No time for playing darts...
zh: 现在可没闲工夫去扔飞镖…

en: No time for playing darts...
zh: 现在可没闲工夫去扔飞镖…

en:
That's a dart board! Cool! There's better
things to do in this place though.
zh:
那是飞镖靶！挺酷的！
不过在这地方，我们有更重要的事情要做。

en: A display case with university trophies.
zh: 一个陈列着大学奖杯的展示柜。

en: Some ads for spring break in Cancun.
zh: 几张关于坎昆春假的广告传单。

en: Some organ donor cards.
zh: 几张器官捐献卡。

en:
"Assortment of molds for sale for
bacteriology course. Perfect condition."
zh: “出售细菌学实验课程用的各类霉菌。质量完好。”

en:
No time to read the posters.
Some people may be wounded...
zh: 没工夫去看什么海报了。可能有人受伤了…

en: Now's not the time to read. We're not safe here!
zh: 现在可不是看书的时候。我们在这儿一点也不安全！

en:
"Assortment of molds for sale for
bacteriology course. Perfect condition."
zh: “出售细菌学实验课程用的各类霉菌。质量完好。”

en: A diploma under glass - ego on display!
zh: 玻璃框里的毕业证——这纯属虚荣心的炫耀！

en:
A diploma, that reminds me of when
I was selling my test scores.
zh:
一张毕业证书，
这让我想起了当年我私下出卖考试分数赚外快的日子。

en:
A diploma, I'll think about it when
everything's back to normal.
zh: 一张毕业证书，等一切恢复正常后我再考虑它吧。

en: A diploma. It's just a piece of paper.
zh: 毕业证书。不过是一张纸罢了。

en: A diploma. That'll never be worth anything to me.
zh: 毕业证书。这玩意儿对我来说永远一文不值。

en: I think it's a piece of paper called a "diploma".
zh: 我想这是一张被叫作“毕业证”的纸张。

en: Something messed up the TV.
zh: 有些东西把这台电视给砸坏了。

en:
A glass forest of liquor bottles,
flecked with cigarette butts.
zh: 一片由酒瓶构成的玻璃森林，里面还夹杂着很多烟头。

en: What a collection of bottles... Only good stuff!
zh: 好多藏酒啊…全都是极品好货！

en:
A forest of alcohol bottles,
decorated with cigarette butts.
zh: 一片由各种酒瓶组成的森林，点缀着满地烟头。

en: A damn nice set of bottles... Only the good stuff !
zh: 这一大堆好酒可真够带劲的…全都是极品好货！

en: No alcohol less than 40 proof.
zh: 没有低于20度的劣质酒。

en: Nice basement! These guys have taste.
zh: 好赞的地下室！这些家伙很有品味嘛。

en: Nothing less than 80 proof alcohol.
zh: 全都是不低于40度的烈酒。

en:
Awesome alcohol collection!
These guys have excellent taste.
zh: 这藏酒简直绝了！这些家伙的品味确实不错。

en: A skateboard competition... Yeah, whatever.
zh: 滑板锦标赛…好吧，跟我没什么关系。

en:
A skateboard "contest". 
I don't really feel like competing right now...
zh:
一个滑板‘大赛’海报。
我现在可没有参赛的闲情逸致…

en: A skateboarding poster...
zh: 一张滑板运动的海报…

en: A skateboard competition... Yeah, whatever.
zh: 滑板锦标赛…好吧，跟我没什么关系。

en: Just some empty bottles gathering dust.
zh: 只是一些落满灰尘的空酒瓶。

en: A beautiful billiard table with cue stick and balls...
zh: 一张精美的桌球台，上面放着球杆和台球…

en:
A real American billiard table.
This is professional equipment.
zh: 一张真正的美式台球桌。这可是专业级别的设备。

en:
A real American billiard table.
This is professional equipment.
zh: 一张真正的美式台球桌。这可是专业级别的设备。

en: Real American billiards. Professional stuff.
zh: 纯正的美式撞球桌。专业级别的装备。

en:
Oh my God! A fraternity sister is dead
near the billard table... It's horrible...
zh:
我的天啊！
一个兄弟会的女生死在台球桌旁边了…太恐怖了…

en:
The monsters have been by here and have broken everything.
Unfortunately, there's nothing more we can do for her...
zh:
怪物洗劫了这里并砸坏了一切。
可怜的女孩…我们已经回天乏术了。

en:
Oh my God! A fraternity sister is dead
near the billiard table... It's horrible...
zh:
我的天啊！
一个兄弟会的女生死在台球桌旁边了…太恐怖了…

en:
The monsters have been by here and have broken everything.
Unfortunately, there's nothing more we can do for her...
zh:
怪物洗劫了这里并砸坏了一切。
可怜的女孩…我们已经回天乏术了。

en: There must be a lot of money in that safe...
zh: 那个保险箱里一定塞满了现金…

en: A safe. Maybe that's where they put the coke!
zh: 保险箱。也许他们把白粉藏在这儿了！

en:
The black flower... It's the last time
that I'll snort weird things...
zh:
黑花…这是我这辈子最后一次
去吸这些稀奇古怪的东西了…

en: Petals from the flower. They won't hurt anybody now.
zh:
这些花的碎片。
现在它们已经害不了任何人了。

en:
A hallucinogenic created from the black flowers;
prepared to be inhaled. Pathetic.
zh:
从黑花里提取出的迷幻药成分，
已经制成了吸食剂。真是可悲。

en: Remains of a wilted black flower...
zh: 一朵枯萎黑花的残余碎片…

en: Remains of a wilted black flower...
zh: 一朵枯萎黑花的残余碎片…

en: A mix of black flowers... Hello bad trip from hell...
zh:
混合了黑色花瓣的物质…
这绝对会让人经历一次地狱般的幻觉体验…

en: Two students horribly mutilated.
zh: 两名死状极其惨烈的学生尸体。

en:
...Something's got to be done, 
I don't know what, but we have to do something...
zh:
…必须采取行动，虽然我不知道该做什么，
但我们不能坐以待毙…

en:
Hmm, so he's the one who was smelling so much...
he is seriously banged up...
zh:
唔，原来之前散发这股恶臭的就是他…
他已经被揍得血肉模糊了…

en: His jaw's been torn off.
zh: 他的下巴被整个撕扯下来了。

en: I don't want to finish like that!
zh: 我可不想就这样完蛋！

en: Two students horribly mutilated.
zh: 两名死状极其惨烈的学生尸体。

en: Kitchen utensils.
zh: 厨房用具。

en:
Doing these dishes is nothing compared
to cleaning the prison toilets...
zh:
跟在监狱里刷马桶比起来，
洗这些盘子简直是小菜一碟…

en: Doing dishes really gets my energy up...
zh: 洗碗这活儿真够让我来劲的…

en:
We can hide here to protect ourselves
from the monsters, just in case...
zh: 我们躲在这儿可以防止被怪物发现，以防万一嘛…

en:
There's nothing to be done here.
Come on. Let's get out of this place!
zh:
这里已经没有什么有价值的线索了。
来吧，我们离开这个鬼地方！

en: This guy's head is lying on the floor!
zh: 这家伙的脑袋被拧下来扔在地板上！

en: The DJ met his match. He had one party too many.
zh: 这个DJ遇到了索命的主。看来他是狂欢过头了。

en: This poor guy did not die peacefully.
zh: 这个可怜的家伙死得相当痛苦。

zh: 一些毕业合影。

zh: 知识分子们的避风港，真是清静。

en: It looks like this desk hasn't been used for a long time.
zh: 这张办公桌看起来已经尘封许久了。

en: It looks like this desk hasn't been used for a long time.
zh: 这张办公桌看起来已经尘封许久了。

en: Just seeing this office, I'm bored already.
zh: 光是瞅一眼这间办公室，我都开始觉得无聊透顶了。

en:
This strange door is engraved with reliefs.
But it is closed; it is useless to try and open it.
zh:
这扇大门雕刻有浮雕。
门是锁着的，去开也是白费力气。

en:
What's that big door?
It doesn't even have a lock...
zh:
这扇大门是怎么回事？
甚至连锁孔都没有…

en:
This big door must be from the middle ages,
if you go by the scenes carved on it...
zh:
从大门上雕刻的东西来看，
这扇大门绝对是中世纪的古董…

en: This statue was sculpted by Richard ZALINO.
zh: 这座雕像是理查德·萨利诺（ZALINO）雕刻的作品。

en: This strange black thing is blocking access to the fence.
zh: 这团诡异的黑色东西堵住了通往围栏的通道。

en: There's a great view of a group of good-looking guys.
zh: 可以很清楚地看见里面有一群帅哥在走动。

en: I can see cute little butts coming and going inside.
zh: 我可以看见里面有一些漂亮的小屁股晃来晃去的。

en: No time to lose, we gotta go find the others!
zh: 时间紧迫，我们必须马上去找其他人！

en:
It's a murder victim. I had hoped
never to see one in my life.
zh:
一个惨遭杀害的人。
我本来这辈子都不想见到这种惨剧。

en: We really have to find the others, and quickly!
zh: 我们真的必须尽快和大家汇合，一定要快！

en:
Someone or something took out
their anger on this poor guy.
zh:
不知道是什么人还是怪物，
在这个可怜的家伙身上狠狠宣泄了一通怒火。

en:
Someone or something took out
their anger on this poor guy.
zh:
不知道是什么人还是怪物，
在这个可怜的家伙身上狠狠宣泄了一通怒火。

en: A feeling of déjà vu.
zh: 有种似曾相识的感觉。

en:
It's a murder victim. I had hoped
never to see one in my life.
zh:
一个惨遭杀害的人。
我本来这辈子都不想见到这种惨剧。

en:
Someone or something took out
their anger on this poor guy.
zh:
不知道是什么人还是怪物，
在这个可怜的家伙身上狠狠宣泄了一通怒火。

en: Life and Death... and boredom of the reader.
zh: 生死大事…以及读者的无聊消遣。

en:
The dude in this portrait really has
a face like a baboon's backside.
zh:
这幅肖像画里的家伙，
脸长得简直跟狒狒的屁股一模一样。

en: A member of the fraternity who has gone to posterity.
zh: 一位已经名留青史的兄弟会前成员。

en: This guy looks too serious to be honest.
zh: 这家伙看起来太严肃了，感觉不像个老实人。

en:
The young man in this portrait
appears serious and depressed.
zh: 这肖像画里的人看起来既严肃又沮丧。

en:
The young man in this portrait
appears serious and depressed.
zh: 这肖像画里的人看起来既严肃又沮丧。

en:
An "old boy" type from the brotherhood:
gray and really boring.
zh:
兄弟会里的‘资深元老’类型：
死气沉沉，而且非常无趣。

en: This closet won't open without a handle.
zh: 没有拉手的话，这个柜子是打不开的。

en: A painting...
zh: 一幅油画…

en:
They must have wanted to snort...
There's black powder everywhere under the sink.
zh:
他们先前肯定想在这儿吸食…
水槽底下到处都洒满了黑色的粉末。

en:
The moonlight has a hard time
getting through this filthy glass.
zh: 月光很难穿透这块肮脏的玻璃照进来。

en: Administrative papers and sexy magazines.
zh: 一些行政文件和色情杂志。

en: This closet won't open without a handle.
zh: 没有拉手的话，这个柜子是打不开的。

en: This drawer doesn't have anything in it.
zh: 这个抽屉里什么东西也没有。

en: Some empty glasses and some dirty magazines.
zh: 一些空杯子和色情杂志。

en: Former graduates. Same heads, same future.
zh:
历届毕业生。
同样的书呆子长相，同样的未来。

en: Some graduates with half-baked smiles.
zh: 一些脸上带着皮笑肉不笑表情的毕业生。

en: Some graduates. They got some funny heads.
zh:
一些毕业生。
他们的长相真是有够滑稽的。

en: The icy looking faces of former members of this Frat.
zh: 这个兄弟会前成员们那一张张冷若冰霜的脸。

en: A photo of the "elite".
zh: 一张所谓的“社会精英”合照。

en: Graduation picture. They all look alike.
zh:
毕业合照。
他们一个个长得都差不多。

en: The door's been locked from the inside.
zh: 门被从里面反锁了。

en: Some folders filed in haphazard order.
zh: 乱七八糟堆叠在一起的文件夹。

en: A locked strong-box with multiple keys.
zh: 一把需要多钥匙解锁的安全铁箱。

en: A party poster with an elaborate design.
zh: 一张设计考究的派对海报。

en: A bit of a creepy, twilight canvas.
zh: 一幅略显诡异的黄昏落日油画。

en: A photo of a group of former members looking bored.
zh: 一群看起来百无聊赖的兄弟会前成员的合影。

en: No way of leaving here without getting cut.
zh: 如果不被玻璃划伤的话，是没办法从这里出去的。

en: Filthy dishes, cheap sauces. That's student life.
zh:
肮脏的盘子，廉价的酱料。
这就是学生的日常生活。

en: a piece of paper in shreds.
zh: 一堆被撕成碎片的纸屑。

en: This row of books forms an impenetrable wall.
zh: 这一排排密不透风的书籍，筑起了一道坚实的墙壁。

en: These books are all about the history of science.
zh: 这些书全都与科学史相关。

en: Science books on scientific subjects for scientists.
zh: 写给科学家们看的、探讨科学主题的科学书籍。

en: This volume is called "Sexuality of the frog."
zh: 这册书的书名叫做《青蛙的性行为》。

en: All of these books have such complicated titles!
zh: 这些书的名字怎么全都这么复杂！

en: A body. Fleeing across the roof was not a good idea...
zh:
一具尸体。
企图翻越屋顶逃生看来并不是个聪明的决定…

en: Photos of people posing in some exotic location.
zh: 人们在某些极具异域风情的景点摆拍的照片。

en: This black thing is spreading everywhere.
zh: 这种黑色的诡异物质正在四处蔓延。

en: This mutilated body is all that's left poor Matt.
zh: 这具残缺不全的遗体就是可怜的麦特留下的一切了。

en: These closets are lined with naked girls.
zh: 这些柜子的内壁上贴满了裸女海报。

en: This electric panel seems deadly.
zh: 这个配电盘看起来非常危险，随时会电死人。

en: Scattered records; the soundtrack to a massacre.
zh:
散落一地的唱片；
仿佛是一场惨绝人寰的大屠杀的背景配乐。

en: A masterpiece depicting some vegetables.
zh: 一幅描绘了几种蔬菜的‘杰作’。

en: A record with dance music is playing without sound.
zh: 一张刻着舞曲的黑胶唱片正在无声地旋转播放着。

en: Semi-pro mixing consoles. Not too bad.
zh: 半专业级别的调音台。品质还算不错。

en: The typical student regimen: beer and chips.
zh: 典型的学生养生食谱：啤酒加薯片。

en: This hole is enormous. The party was bustling.
zh:
这个破洞太巨大了。
当时派对上的动静肯定闹得极折腾。

en: This table has taken a beating.
zh: 这张桌子曾惨遭疯狂的打砸。

en:
The glass is broken. You can't go through
there without being cut to death.
zh:
玻璃被砸碎了。
要是硬穿过去的话，绝对会被碎玻璃划伤致死。

en:
The mechanism reset completely!
The contraption must be really screwed up.
zh:
机关彻底复位了！
这个设计肯定是出大故障了。

en:
Science books, unadvisable for
people who suffer from narcolepsy.
zh:
对于患有嗜睡症的人来说，
强烈不建议阅读这些枯燥的科学书籍。

en:
The Artificial Insemination or
"The Pleasure of the Test tube".
zh: 关于人工授精的书，又名《试管里的欢愉》。

en: Tons of books, and not one magazine showing some tail.
zh:
堆得像山一样的书，
却连一本印有性感美女的八卦杂志都没有。

en: Philosophy and science books.
zh: 哲学与科学方面的书籍。

en: An entire row of books on scientific ethics
zh: 整整一排关于科学伦理学的著作。

en: A molecular biology section. Rather extensive.
zh: 分子生物学专区。藏书还挺丰富的。

en: The mutilated body of a fraternity member.
zh: 一具残缺不全的兄弟会成员的遗体。

en: The mechanism is blocked, nothing to do about that.
zh: 机关被卡死了，完全无计可施。

en: This bookshelf has been knocked over
zh: 这个书架被人给推倒了。

en: Plates. Some food fossilized on them.
zh: 餐盘。上面的食物残渣都已经风干得像化石了。

en:
Photos of the twins, Herbert and Leonard Friedman,
during their expedition to Africa.
zh:
赫伯特与莱纳德·弗里德曼双胞胎兄弟，
当年在非洲探险时的老照片。

en:
Relics of Leafmore, and a photo of Wickson,
Friedman's wife at the time.
zh:
利夫莫尔高中的遗物，以及一张维克森的照片，
她当时是弗里德曼的妻子。

en:
Research notes and a microscope
that belonged to the Friedmans.
zh: 曾经属于弗里德曼兄弟的研究笔记和一台显微镜。

en:
An esoteric symbol. A clue to
the past of this fraternity.
zh:
一个神秘主义符号。
这是一条通往该兄弟会过去秘密的线索。

en:
The cadavers of a boy and a girl.
Maybe a couple.
zh:
一男一女两具尸体，
他们生前大概是一对情侣。

en: Nothing interesting on the screens, at the moment.
zh: 屏幕目前显示一切正常，没什么值得注意的地方。

en: I'm not going to leave in Mei in this condition...
zh: 我不可能把处于这种险境的梅丢下不管…

en: Well, well, is our lock-picking specialist having a problem?
zh: 哎呀呀，我们大名鼎鼎的开锁专家这是碰钉子了吗？

en: I need something to open this door.
zh: 我需要某种工具才能打开这扇门。

en: Get me out of here!
zh: 快放我出去！

en: I'm not leaving without Shannon.
zh: 如果不带上夏侬，我是绝对不会离开这里的。

en: Go through the pipe.
zh: 穿过管道。

en: The chain falls to pieces
zh: 铁链断成几段了。

en:
One of the players can give the other a boost
if the players are close to each other.
zh:
如果两名玩家靠得足够近，
其中一人可以为另一人进行垫脚助爬。

en: It's too high.
zh: 位置太高了。

en: The door is unlocked.
zh: 门已经开了。

en: Hey! Help me climb up!
zh: 喂！帮我一把，让我爬上去！

en:
It's too high! I won't be able to climb up
there like this.
zh:
实在太高了！只靠我一个人，
这样是根本爬不上去的。

en: Leave us alone!
zh: 离我们远点！

en: This evening, come party in room 200.
zh: 今晚，欢迎来200号房间开派对。

en: We have to look for Mei first.
zh: 我们必须先去找到梅。

en:
Ex-Leafmore High student, Stan Jones is a
solitary bad boy imprisoned by the past.
There is no lock that he can't pick, no
misfortune that he can't turn to his own
advantage. He has learned that life can be
very cruel and has come to terms with that.
Stan is not familiar with the casual idleness
of College life: he has a full-time job as a
delivery truck driver and Fallcreek University
is just an address in his service book.
zh:
作为利夫莫尔高中的前学生，斯坦·琼斯
是个被过去囚禁、独来独往的坏小子。
没有他撬不开的锁，也没有他不能化为己用
的霉运。他早已明白生活有时极其残酷，
并坦然接受了这一点。斯坦对大学那种
悠闲散漫的生活毫无概念：他有份开货车
的全职工作，秋溪大学不过是他工作日志
上的一个地址。

en:
A skater who's no stranger to pain,
Corey Wilde is living proof that man
descends from the ape, and that evolution
does not always lead to progression.
Somewhat of a neurotic, he has an innate
talent for suicidal acrobatics. When it
comes to his car he is totally monogamist,
and only cheats on her with Mei;
his official girlfriend.
zh:
作为一名对伤痛早已习以为常的滑板少年，
科里·怀尔德就是“人类由猿猴进化而来、
而进化并不总等于进步”的活生生证明。
他有点神经质，天生就擅长玩命的杂技。
对自己的爱车他忠贞不二，唯一会为之
“出轨”的对象，就是他的正牌女友王梅。

en:
Is he a hockey player or a reincarnated
Viking? Sven Hansen handles his hockey
stick like it is a battleaxe and only pauses
a game to have a quick drink. His is a
heart of gold drowned in a lake of mead,
a true fighter who honors the strength of
his ancestors. The only things Sven loves
more than Norway are his friends... and
the way Amy looks at him.
zh:
他到底是冰球运动员，还是转世的维京人？
斯文·汉森抡起冰球杆，活像在挥一柄战斧，
唯有匆匆喝水时才会暂停比赛。他有一颗
金子般的心，沉在蜂蜜酒的湖里；他以祖先
的勇武为荣，是真正的战士。斯文这辈子
比爱挪威更爱的，只有他的朋友…
以及艾米看他的眼神。

en:
Former Leafmore High student and full-time
good-looking guy, Kenny Matthews rarely
avoids trouble or any kind of obstacle.
Force is what he uses to push through
anything and anyone on his path. Being a
celebrated quarterback has given Kenny
ample opportunity for conquest among the
female populace of Fallcreek. When faced
with his sister Shannon however, he
quickly reverts to the role of little brother.
zh:
作为利夫莫尔高中的前学生兼知名帅哥，
肯尼·马修斯很少回避麻烦或阻碍。在他
前进的路上，一切人与物都靠蛮力推开。
身为声名显赫的橄榄球四分卫，肯尼在
秋溪的女生中从不缺战果。可一面对
妹妹夏侬，他立刻就被打回小老兄的原形。

en:
Shannon Matthews left her dreams
behind at Leafmore High. Not only
did she survive Evil, she also became
stronger because of it and can now
manipulate the forces of shadow.
She hides a sensitive soul behind
her cool and mature demeanor,
one that is fragile but capable of
surviving the worst. Her only
weakness is her love for her family.
zh:
夏侬·马修斯把梦想留在了利夫莫尔高中。
她不仅从“邪恶”中幸存下来，还因此变得
更强大，如今更能操控暗影之力。
在冷静而成熟的外表下，她藏着一颗敏感
的心，虽然脆弱，却能挺过最险的绝境。
她唯一的软肋，是对家人的爱。

en:
A beautiful young Asian girl but sweet as
sour candy; Mei Wang is a hardcore
gaming fanatic. Jun, her twin sister whom
she adores, is her only rival in this field.
Mei also has a bad habit of hacking all
communication and security devices that
pass within range of her PDA. Life is the
most thrilling game of all to Mei, and her
favorite playing partner is Corey.
zh:
年轻漂亮的亚洲女孩，性子却像酸味糖
一样甜中带刺；王梅是个不折不扣的
硬核游戏狂。她深爱的双胞胎妹妹王珺，
是她在这个领域唯一的对手。王梅还有个
坏毛病：凡是她PDA能扫到的通讯与安防
设备，都要黑上一遍。对王梅来说，
人生就是最刺激的游戏，而她最中意的
玩伴正是科里。

en:
Genuine blond and Miss Wet T-shirt on
campus, Amy Brookes is partly responsible
for the suspicious stickiness of many a bed
sheet belonging to the male student popu-
-lace of Fallcreek. However, her pheno-
-menal skill at deciphering and breaking
near-impossible codes and puzzles, puts
her in a different league than even the
most hard-nosed womanizer is able to
reach. Beautiful, cunning... Inaccessible?
zh:
货真价实的金发美女、校园“湿T恤小姐”，
秋溪大学的男生宿舍里，不少可疑的黏糊
床单都得算上艾米·布鲁克斯一份。
不过，她破译和攻克那些近乎无解的密码
与谜题的本事堪称一绝，这份能耐，
连最难缠的花花公子都望尘莫及。
美丽、狡黠…却又高不可攀？

en:
On Fallcreek campus, many male students
dream about Jun Wang, Mei's twin sister.
Sweet in life, but merciless when playing
video games, Jun has a touch of craziness
that makes her irresistible. She is an
optimist by nature and combines this with
an attractive streak of innocence, which
sometimes leads her into dangerous
situations.
zh:
在秋溪大学校园里，无数男生的梦中情人
都是王梅的双胞胎妹妹王珺。她平日甜美
可亲，一打起电玩却毫不留情，她身上
那份藏不住的疯劲，让她格外让人着迷。
她天性乐观，又带着一股动人的纯真，
这份纯真有时也会把她带进险境。

en:
A professor of biology on the Fallcreek
campus, Richard James is not easily
impressed. Having been forced to tame
the rowdy student populace of Fallcreek
University, there are now few things that
scare or excite him. His scientific
knowledge is a precious tool for inquisitive
minds. A man to consult regularly...
zh:
作为秋溪大学的生物学教授，理查德·詹姆斯
不是个能轻易被打动的人。被迫驯服了
秋溪大学这群闹哄哄的学生之后，如今
已经很少有东西能让他害怕或兴奋了。
对求知若渴的头脑而言，他的学识是一件
无价的工具。一个值得常常去请教的人…

en: Hey, Your party sucks dude!
zh: 嘿，你这派对办得可真够烂的，哥们！

en: My freaking car!
zh: 我操！我的车！！

en: Hey!
zh: 嘿！

en: Have all of you gone crazy or something?
zh: 你们他妈的都是疯了吗？？

en: You'll never catch it!
zh: 你这辈子也追不上的！

en: My car's not far from here, come back you retard!
zh: 我的车就在不远的地方，快给我回来，你这个白痴！

en: Mei ! Answer me I'm begging you
zh: 梅！求求你快回个话啊！

en: We're going to get my sister!
zh: 我们正准备去救我妹妹！

en: Kenny, get over here, we need you!
zh: 肯尼，快过来，我们需要你搭把手！

en: I can't! I ran out of medicine and I need it badly!
zh:
我不行！我的药刚吃完了，
现在难受得很，必须马上吃药！

en: Uh... Ok, dude, just... let us know what's up okay?
zh:
呃…行吧，哥们，
你那边有什么动静记得知会我们一声，好吗？

en: If anything happens to you Corey... I'll kill you!
zh:
要是你敢出点什么事，
科里…我绝对会宰了你的！

en: Damn! What is it Jun?
zh: 该死！怎么了，珺？

en: Stop being such an ass Corey!
zh: 别那么粗鲁，科里！

en:
Some really weird things are happening in the halls,
everyone's gone mad! I'm too scared to leave my room!
zh:
走廊里发生了一些极其恐怖的怪事，
大家都疯了！我太害怕了，不敢离开房间！

en:
Stay where you are! Hide wherever you can.
Just like when we were kids. OK?!
zh:
就待在原地别动！能藏哪儿就藏哪儿。
就像我们小时候那样，好吗？！

en: I'm coming.
zh: 我这就过去。

en: Hurry!
zh: 快点！

en: What on earth is happening?
zh: 天呐，到底发生什么事了？

en: I am starting to feel awful. I need to go to the hospital!
zh: 我感觉浑身越来越难受了。我必须去医院！

en: EINSTEIN
zh: EINSTEIN

en: MAGELLAN
zh: MAGELLAN

en: FRANKLIN
zh: FRANKLIN

zh: 你是谁…

en: Here we are...
zh: 我们到了…

en: Someone will pay for what happened to Jun, I promise.
zh: 我保证，有人会为了珺的下场付出代价。

en: Just focus on getting out of here alive, okay.
zh: 专心应付眼前的难关，活着离开这里，好吗？

zh: 科里！

en: Amy?!
zh: 艾米？！

en: It's you! I almost had a heart attack!
zh: 是你啊！我刚才心跳都要吓停了！

en: It's Sven!
zh: 是斯文！

en: Crap! Where did he take him?
zh: 操！那怪物把他抓去哪儿了？

en: I don't know! I barely had time to hide myself.
zh: 不知道！我当时只勉强来得及把自己藏起来。

en: This just keeps on getting better...
zh: 局势真是越来越‘乐观’了…

en:
Some kind of deformed freak captured him!
Oh my god, what is he going to do to Sven?
zh:
不知道从哪冒出来一个畸形怪人把他给抓走了！
天啊，他要对斯文做出什么恐怖的事？

en: Dad!?
zh: 爸爸？！

en: "Dad"?? This rotten old tree??
zh: “爸爸”？？这棵腐烂的老枯树？？

en:
I don't believe it... It's Friedman!
I thought we killed him 2 years ago!
zh:
我简直不敢相信…是弗里德曼！
我两年前明明已经把他干掉了！

en:
It's this jerk who injected us with
the black spores, when he was still principal!
zh:
就是这个混蛋！在他还是校长的时候，
往我们体内注射了黑色孢子！

en: I need to take daily medication because of this jerk...
zh: 就是因为这人渣，我现在每天都必须吃药…

en: What did you do with those flowers?
zh: 你用那些花做了什么？

en: He was sick... Now... He dreams...
zh: 他曾病入膏肓…而现在…他正在梦乡里…

en:
He grafted the flowers on to himself... That's how
he managed to spread his plague; through the flowers...
zh:
他把那些花嫁接在了自己身上…
这就是他散播瘟疫的手段：利用那些花瓣…

en: and you smelled that thing... man...
zh:
而且你们这帮家伙还吸入了那种香气…
我的老天…

en: Sven... Mei, and Jun...
zh: 斯文…梅，还有珺…

en: It's time to do some weeding.
zh: 是时候给这儿铲铲杂草了。

en:
This jerk knocked down the crash barrier!
He must have ruined my car !
zh:
那个混蛋撞倒了护栏栏！
我的爱车一定被那个家伙弄坏了！

en: There's something moving over there!
zh: 那边有东西在动！

en: Take that!
zh: 吃我这一招！

en: YOU STILL WANT SOME?!?!
zh: 你他妈还没挨够揍是吧？！

en:
My father's shotgun... This thing is just too bad...
Boy, is this thing going to make them angry...
zh:
我父亲的老猎枪…这枪威力真够劲…
好家伙，这铁家伙肯定能把这群怪物彻底激怒…

en: The bridge has collapsed.
zh: 大桥已经坍塌了。

en: Corey! Watch out!
zh: 科里！当心！

en: The telephones aren't working.
zh: 电话坏了打不通。

en: Like the Professor said, the network is dead.
zh: 就像教授说的那样，通讯信号彻底断了。

en:
... Hello?... Somebody hear me... Hello???...
Fallcreek here... We need help... Please!...
Some people died... Answer !!! ...
zh:
…喂？有人能听到我说话吗…喂？？这里是秋溪大学…
我们需要紧急救援…求你们了！
有人死了…快回答我！！！…

en: Hey, don't leave me here!
zh: 喂，别把我一个人丢在这儿！

en: How can anybody do that to a car?!
zh: 怎么会有人对一辆车做出这种残忍的事？！

en: I think that was part of Corey's car.
zh: 我觉得那应该是科里爱车的某块零件。

en:
You just have to put the syringe in deep.
And then draw the proteine out from the muscle-tissue.
zh:
你只需要把注射器深深扎进去。
然后从肌肉组织中抽取出蛋白质成分即可。

en:
You just have to put the syringe in deep.

你只需要把注射器深深扎进去。
然后从肌肉组织中抽取出蛋白质成分即可。

en: I hope you're gonna wash your hands...
zh: 我希望你完事后能记得洗手…

en: I hope you're gonna wash your hands...
zh: 我希望你完事后能记得洗手…

en: How did he dare do that, that idiot???
zh: 那个蠢货怎么敢做出那种事的？？？

en:
Wait me for you bastard!!!
I'm gonna bust you up man!!!
zh:
你给我等着，你这狗日的！！！
老子非把你砸个稀巴烂不可！！！

en:
This dude wrecked my car. My beauty's
a collector's item. He's gonna pay!!!
zh:
这家伙把我的车给毁了。
那可是我最爱的老爷收藏款。他必须付出代价！！！

en:
Take it out on the car why don't you...
That makes me crazy! YOU ARE SO DEAD!!!
zh:
有本事冲我来，拿一辆车撒什么气…
这真把我惹火了！你死定了！！！

en: You're the one who smashed my car, you big bastard!!!
zh: 就是你砸坏了我的车，你这个王八蛋！！！

en:
Hey, where are you going? Don't you think
you're forgetting someone?
zh:
嘿，你这是要去哪？
你难道不觉得你把谁给漏下了吗？

en: Hey! I'm here! Help me up there!
zh: 嘿！我在这儿呢！拉我一把上去！

en: Unbelievable, this was a house before!
zh: 真不敢相信，这里以前居然曾经是一栋房子！

en:
This looks like a squat. Woah, they
used a tire for a pillow!
zh:
这里看起来像是个流浪汉窝点。
我的天，他们居然拿废轮胎来当枕头！

en:
There were some hikers here,
I hope that they got out in time!
zh:
以前曾有一些登山客住在这儿，
希望他们及时逃出去了！

en: That would make good firewood.
zh: 这倒能劈出不少好柴火来。

en:
A tree has fallen over the road. 
How can we clear a path through?
zh:
一棵大树倒在了公路上。
我们该怎么清理出一条通道呢？

en: My beautiful car... only a wreck remains.
zh: 我心爱的车…现在只剩下一堆空壳了。

en: Corey's car. There isn't much left of it.
zh: 科里的爱车。现在只剩一堆废铁了。

en: It serves no purpose to try and cut down this tree.
zh: 试着砍倒这棵树只是白费力气。

en: An uprooted tree. My car couldn't have passed this.
zh:
一棵被连根拔起的枯树。
我的车是无论如何也绕不过这道坎的。

en: An uprooted tree. My car couldn't have passed this.
zh:
一棵被连根拔起的枯树。
我的车是无论如何也绕不过这道坎的。

en: The tunnel has been closed since the last storm.
zh: 自上一次暴风雨过后，这条隧道就被封闭了。

en:
That's my car down there... I must be dreaming...
This is an absolute nightmare...
zh:
那是我摔在下面的车…我肯定是在做梦…
这绝对是场彻头彻尾的噩梦…

en: Corey's car made a short flight.
zh: 科里的车在空中体验了次短暂的飞行。

en: This door hasn't been opened for centuries.
zh: 这扇门大概已经尘封了好几个世纪没有开启过了。

en:
The ambulance really took a hit.
It was traveling at top speed when it crashed.
zh:
这辆救护车撞得可真够惨的。
撞车时它绝对是在全速狂飙。

en: The ambulance is demolished. Next stop: the scrapyard.
zh:
这救护车算是彻底报废了。
下一站可以直接送去废车回收厂了。

en: This tree trunk is blocking the road.
zh: 这根大树干把道路给彻底堵死了。

en: Stan!
zh: 斯坦！

en:
Sven... Sven... Don't leave me...
You have to stay with me!
zh:
斯文…斯文…不要丢下我…你一定要
撑住！我们要在一起！

en: Stay...
zh: 留下来…

en: with you...
zh: 陪着你…

en: Dad?
zh: 爸爸？

en: Oh... Dad is dead, and won't make any more flowers...
zh: 噢…爸爸死了，再也生不出好看的花朵了…

en:
But... you can still chop him into firewood
with that chainsaw of yours.
zh: 不过…你依然可以用你那电锯，把他锯成一堆柴火。

en:
Get a nice fire going, get all warm
and comfy while your daddy burns...
zh:
生起一堆暖洋洋的篝火，一边抱着温暖舒服的身体，
一边看着你爸爸在烈火中化为灰烬…

en: I'm going to hack into this drive in less than two minutes!
zh: 我只要两分钟就能黑进这块硬盘！

en: Mei, would you know how to hack into that?
zh: 梅，你懂怎么黑进那个系统吗？

en: Ok. I'll cover you!
zh: 好的。我来掩护你！

en: My sister is not going to die because of some stupid code!
zh: 我妹妹绝对不能因为这个愚蠢的密码丢了性命！

en: This can't be! The door is blocked!
zh: 这不可能！门被彻底堵死了！

en: There's an obstacle in front of the door!
zh: 门前堆放着障碍物！

en: Mei...
zh: 梅…

en: Hmpff! I could never move them!
zh: 唉！凭我的力气，我怎么也挪不开它们！

en:
Remember Mei: They use the names
of famous people. I have to concentrate.
zh: 记住，梅：密码用的是名人的名字，我必须集中精神。

en: Hey! It's not that way! What are you doing!
zh: 喂！不是走那条路！你在干什么！

en: Hey! It's not that way! What are you doing!
zh: 喂！不是走那条路！你在干什么！

en:
We can see where Jun is with the
monitoring displays on the first floor!
zh:
我们可以通过一楼的监视器屏幕，
查看珺被关在哪里！

en:
We can see where Jun is with the
monitoring displays on the first floor!
zh:
我们可以通过一楼的监视器屏幕，
查看珺被关在哪里！

en: Hey! The cellars are downstairs!
zh: 喂！地下室在下面！

en: Hey! The cellars are downstairs!
zh: 喂！地下室在下面！

en: Jun! Juuuuunnnnnn ! Answer me!!!
zh: 珺！珺！听到了就回个话啊！！！

en: Sven, can you move that??
zh: 斯文，你能把那个推开吗？？

en: Noooo!!! Leave me alone!!!!! PLEASE!!!!!!!
zh: 不要！！！放开我！！求求你们了！！！

en: Let go of my sister!
zh: 快放开我妹妹！

en:
Jun! You see the wire? The door is powered,
you can pass through there!
zh:
珺！看到那根电线了吗？
门是通了电的，你可以从那儿逃出来！

en: Jun, those boards seem to break easily.
zh: 珺，那些木板看来很容易就能被打碎。

en: The telephones aren't working.
zh: 电话坏了打不通。

en: This garbage can smells like death!
zh: 这垃圾桶里散发出一股死尸的恶臭！

en: It's closed. Impossible to open it without keys.
zh: 锁上了。没有钥匙是打不开的。

en: This stretcher smells of ether.
zh: 这担架上有一股浓烈的乙醚味。

en: A stretcher: I have ridden on a few of them in my time.
zh: 一张担架：我这辈子可没少躺这玩意儿。

en: X-rays which show a large number of fractures.
zh: 一张显示有大量骨折处的X光片。

en: Nothing special in this mysterious alcove...
zh: 这个神秘的小壁龛里似乎没什么特别的…

en:
A rest area for interns. It is almost
comfortable for a hospital.
zh:
实习医生的休息区。
对于医院来说，这儿算得上是相当舒适了。

en: This display does not contain anything interesting
zh: 这个显示屏上没有什么值得注意的内容。

en: A scanner. There are no secrets with these things!
zh: 一台扫描仪。在这机器面前，任何秘密都无处遁形！

en: Ah, this brings back memories!
zh: 啊，真是勾起了我的回忆！

en: There is a corpse in this bed.
zh: 这张床上躺着一具尸体。

en: Somebody spent a bad quarter of an hour here.
zh: 曾经有人在这里痛苦地度过了他人生的最后一刻。

en:
The beds are empty. The patients must
have been evacuated... or eaten.
zh:
床位都是空的。病人们肯定早就被撤离了…
或者是被怪物吃掉了。

en:
The girl that changed into that horrific monster
must have lain in this bed until she transformed.
zh:
那个变成了可怕怪物的女生，
在彻底变异之前肯定一直躺在这张床上。

en: A dirty laundry cart
zh: 一辆脏衣物收集车。

en:
Sorry to bring you bad news. Yesterday we lost Bill. He lost
his battle with cancer... Rest in peace, Bill...
zh:
很遗憾通知你这个坏消息，昨天比尔去世了。
他在与癌症的斗争中失败了…愿他安息，比尔…

en:
Sorry to bring you bad news. Yesterday we lost Bill. He lost
his battle with cancer... Cancer. That's bad!
zh:
很遗憾通知你这个坏消息，昨天比尔去世了。
他在与癌症的斗争中失败了…癌症，真是太可怕了！

en: The elevator is stuck.
zh: 电梯被卡住了。

en:
Departmental schedules.
And we think our course plan is bad...
zh:
各科室的排班表。
相比之下，我觉得我们的课程表其实还没那么糟糕…

en: A defibrillator and blood bags.
zh: 一台除颤仪和几袋血浆。

en:
A defibrillator. I was shocked with
one of these once, for a bet.
zh:
一台除颤仪。
有一次跟人打赌，我被这玩意儿狠狠电过一下。

en: Dead bodies, kept cold.
zh: 冷藏保存的死尸。

en: Autopsy x-rays.
zh: 尸检用的X光片。

en: This closet is closed solid.
zh: 这个壁橱被牢牢锁死了。

en: Dead bodies, kept cold.
zh: 冷藏保存的死尸。

en: Anatomical boards.
zh: 解剖图板。

en: A body that has been dead for some time.
zh: 一具死了有些时日的尸体。

en: No. I want to find Corey and Amy before we leave
zh: 不。我想在离开之前，先找到科里和艾米。

en:
Going back would be the same as running away.
The others are counting on us.
zh:
回头走就相当于临阵脱逃。
其他人还在指望着我们呢。

en: Behind this wire fence, there is another parking lot.
zh: 在这道铁丝网围栏的后面，还有另外一个停车场。

en:
The sign is covered with insects
that are drawn to its light.
zh: 这块霓虹招牌上爬满了被其亮光吸引而来的昆虫。

en: A parked car.
zh: 一辆停放着的轿车。

en:
I'm always afraid when Mei drives...
...but it's not a good idea to offend your friends...
zh:
梅开车我总是提心吊胆的…
不过，在朋友面前抱怨这个显然不太礼貌…

en:
I hope you won't break down.
Please down let me down!
zh: 希望你别在半路上抛锚。千万别让我失望啊！

en:
If Thor would send lightning from the skies,
then this wall would surely fall.
zh:
要是雷神索尔能从天上劈下一道闪电，
这面墙肯定会轰然倒塌。

en:
This wall seems rather fragile - a small
detonation would cause it to cave in.
zh:
这面墙壁看起来相当脆弱——
只要来一次小规模的爆炸，它就会彻底坍塌。

en: This wall doesn't seem very solid.
zh: 这面墙壁看起来不怎么结实。

en: This wall doesn't seem very solid.
zh: 这面墙壁看起来不怎么结实。

en: Nobody at reception. Empty rooms. It's depressing.
zh:
接待处一个人也没有。
空空荡荡的房间。这氛围可真够压抑的。

en:
The reception area is deserted.
There's no one to snoop on us.
zh:
前台接待区空无一人。
这下没人能监视我们了。

en: The atmosphere at reception is typical of this place: dead.
zh: 前台的冷清氛围完美契合了这个地方：毫无生机。

en:
The reception area is empty.
Maybe the receptionists escaped.
zh:
接待处空无一人。
也许接待员们都已经逃命去了。

en:
The reception desk is empty.
Maybe the receptionists fled.
zh:
前台接待区空无一人。
也许接待员们都已经逃命去了。

en: The reception area is deserted. Nobody to watch us.
zh: 接待处空无一人。没人在旁边盯着我们。

en: The reception matches the ambiance in this place: lifeless.
zh: 这前台简直和这鬼地方的氛围完美契合：死气沉沉。

en:
Nobody in the reception area. Empty halls
and rooms give me the creeps.
zh:
接待处一个人也没有。
空旷的走廊和房间让我有些害怕。

en: This hospital is big.
zh: 这栋医院的规模可真够大的。

en: A notice board listing hospital announcements.
zh: 一块贴着医院各类公告的告示板。

en:
An ad against cigarettes? I prefer
Norwegian ones to American ones, really.
zh:
反对吸烟的广告？说真的，相比于美国的香烟，
我个人还是更喜欢挪威的香烟。

en:
An anti-smoking ad. Wherever you go, people feel
the need to tell you what you can and can't do.
zh:
一张禁烟海报。无论你走到哪，
总会有人想要对你指手画脚，
告诉你什么能做，什么不能做。

en:
An anti-smoking ad. A boy who smokes
is sexy, but his breath isn't.
zh:
一张禁烟海报。抽烟的男生看起来很性感，
但他们身上的烟味可不性感。

en:
Anti-smoking ad: "Smoking kills". Yeah, monsters
do too, and they are even harder to quit.
zh:
禁烟广告：“吸烟能致命”。
是啊，怪物也能，而且它们比烟瘾更难戒掉。

en: No sports magazines; just medical journals.
zh: 没有体育杂志，全都是些医学期刊。

en:
I don't read much. Except for "MAD", "Heavy Metal"
and the odd dirty magazine perhaps.
zh:
我不怎么看书。顶多翻翻《疯子》杂志、
《重金属》杂志，或者偶尔看点少儿不宜的杂志。

en:
Magazines: knitting, gardening and
housekeeping. Really hot stuff.
zh:
这儿的杂志全是关于针织、园艺和家务的。
真是‘刺激’极了。

en: No videogame magazines at all!
zh: 居然连一本电子游戏杂志都没有！

en: The elevator is permanently broken.
zh: 这台电梯彻底坏了，根本动不了。

en: A board listing the admittances into the emergency room.
zh: 一张登记有急诊室准入情况的告示板。

en:
Everything has collapsed...
like the foam on a flat beer...
zh:
一切都垮塌下来了…
就像倒出来没气的啤酒上面的泡沫一样…

en: Pieces fallen from the ceiling are blocking the way.
zh: 从天花板上掉落下来的碎块彻底堵住了道路。

en: A lot of debris is blocking the way...
zh: 大量的废墟瓦砾挡住了去路…

en:
The ceiling has collapsed...
...someone could have been underneath...
zh:
天花板塌落下来了…
…要是当时有人在底下，那可就惨了…

en: Gas cylinders, medical creams and sterile liquid.
zh: 一些医用气罐、药膏和无菌消毒液。

en: This window is cracked.
zh: 这扇窗户上布满了裂纹。

en: A nice, clean bed.
zh: 一张干净整洁的病床。

en:
Some forceps and scalpels which
appear to have been used recently.
zh: 一些看起来最近才被使用过的手术钳和手术刀。

en: An image of an exposed brain.
zh: 一副展示大脑解剖结构的挂图。

en:
A poster for an exhibition of works
by Francis Bacon, the painter-butcher.
zh:
一张关于著名“屠夫画家”
弗朗西斯·培根画作展览的海报。

en: A line of staff lockers for staff. This is the rest room.
zh: 一排员工更衣柜。这里大概是员工休息室。

en: Medical reviews nestled amongst a selection of x-rays.
zh: 夹杂在大量X光片之中的一些医学评论周刊。

en: A coffee machine: the hospital's nerve center.
zh: 一台咖啡机：这绝对是整栋医院的“神经中枢”。

en:
This is a cozy little place.
Shame we don't have time to linger around.
zh:
这地方还挺温馨的。
只可惜我们现在可没时间在这儿闲逛磨蹭。

en:
A pneumothorax (collapsed lung), two broken
fingers and a scoliosis (curvature of the spine).
zh:
气胸（肺压迫性萎陷）、两根手指骨折，
以及脊柱侧弯（脊柱畸形）的病历图示。

en: A shelf stacked with bandages, ointments and pills.
zh: 一个塞满了绷带、药膏和各种药物的架子。

en: A usage record for the scanner.
zh: 一本关于扫描仪使用的登记手册。

en:
These computers are connected
to the scanner. There is no internet here.
zh: 这些电脑都是连接到扫描仪的，没有连到互联网。

en: This cart is used to transport gloves and compresses.
zh: 这辆手推车是用来运送医用手套和敷料的。

en: Files relating to medical scans to be carried out.
zh: 一些与待执行的医疗扫描相关的病历档案。

en: Somebody left their blood bag here.
zh: 有人把用完的血袋遗忘在了这里。

en: Departmental forms which are filled in after every scan.
zh: 每次做完扫描后都需要填写的科室表格。

en: A stack of medical files and surgical equipment.
zh: 一叠整齐堆放着的医疗档案和手术器械。

en: A dirty laundry cart
zh: 一辆脏衣物收集车。

en: A defibrillator and blood bags.
zh: 一台除颤仪和几袋血浆。

en:
A defibrillator. I was shocked with
one of these once, for a bet.
zh:
一台除颤仪。
有一次跟人打赌，我被这玩意儿狠狠电过一下。

en: You need two magnetic passes to open this door.
zh: 打开这扇门需要同时刷两张磁卡。

en: A locker containing files on emergency patients
zh: 一个存放有急诊病人档案的储物柜。

en: A stack of electrocardiograms.
zh: 一叠心电图纸。

en: A poster giving health advice.
zh: 一张提供健康建议的海报。

en: This bed has not been fastened.
zh: 这张病床的固定锁扣并没有扣上。

en: A meal tray. On the menu: medication.
zh: 一个送餐托盘。今天的食谱：全都是药。

en: A shelf for the patient's belongings.
zh: 一个用来存放病人个人物品的架子。

en: A teddy bear and a spare T-shirt.
zh: 一个泰迪熊玩偶和一件备用的T恤衫。

en: This closet contains first aid supplies.
zh: 这个壁橱里塞满了急救护理用品。

en: Monitoring equipment. This guy must be very sick.
zh: 监护仪器。躺在这儿的家伙以前肯定病得很重。

en: A ventilation mask
zh: 一个呼吸面罩。

en: There is a block of ice in this closet.
zh: 这个冷柜里放着一整块冰砖。

en: Some anti-smoking ads.
zh: 几张禁烟宣传海报。

en: A painting of a country landscape.
zh: 一幅描绘乡村自然风光的油画。

en:
The emergency exit is stuck,
long live automated security!
zh:
安全出口被锁死了，
自动防卫系统万岁！

en:
This vending machine contains enough processed
sugar to cause diabetes in an entire army batallion.
zh:
这台贩卖机里的糖分，
足够让一整个营的士兵全都患上糖尿病了。

en:
This computer has one function: to connect to the internet.
It doesn't do anything else, and right now there is no internet.
zh:
这台电脑只有一个功能：连接互联网。
它做不了别的事，而现在这鬼地方根本没有网络。

en: A notebook computer and some research reports.
zh: 一台笔记本电脑和一些科学研究报告。

en: A microscope and some trinkets of little interest.
zh: 一台显微镜和几个没什么意思的精巧小玩意。

en: Various chemical products.
zh: 各类大大小小的化学试剂制品。

en: Samples that I would avoid breaking.
zh: 一些我可绝不想碰碎的化验样本。

en: An arm articulated under glass
zh: 玻璃罩下的一个机械传动仿生义肢模型。

en: A sink with nothing in it.
zh: 一个空空如也的洗手池。

en: Chemical formula tables.
zh: 一堆化学公式图表。

en:
A notice board listing procedures
for the handling of dead bodies.
zh: 一块标有死者遗体处理流程守则的告示板。

en: Bottles of various products.
zh: 装有各种试剂的瓶子。

en: Another corpse...
zh: 又是一具尸体…

en: Slightly toxic products in glass containers.
zh: 玻璃容器里装着的微毒试剂。

en:
The cart elevator is blocked.
It seems to be out of order.
zh:
推车升降机被卡住了。
看起来似乎是坏了。

en: The fork-lift got caught in the legs of the rack.
zh: 叉车被卡在了货架的支脚中间。

en: Those shelves are loaded with medical supplies
zh: 这些货架上塞满了各种医疗物资。

en:
Those shelves contain medical
supplies worth thousands of dollars.
zh: 这些货架上堆放着价值数千美元的医用物资。

en: There's food for the hospital cantina on those shelves.
zh: 这些货架上摆放着供应医院食堂的食物。

en:
Reviews: "Neurology Illustrated"
and "The Health of Tomorrow".
zh: 医学期刊：《神经学画册》和《明日健康》。

en: A painting in slightly bad taste.
zh: 一幅略显俗气的画作。

en: Painkillers lying beside a yellowing plant.
zh: 放在一盆发黄的植物旁边的止痛药。

en: This window is locked down. It cannot be opened.
zh: 这扇窗户被锁死了。根本打不开。

en: Some garbage.
zh: 一些垃圾废物。

en: This telephone isn't working.
zh: 这部电话坏了，没有信号。

en: This cabinet is securely locked. Too bad...
zh: 这个铁柜被牢牢锁上了。真是不走运…

en: This cart must have been knocked over in the rush
zh: 这辆手推车肯定是在慌乱中被撞倒的。

en: This room is locked
zh: 这间病房被锁上了。

en: It's locked
zh: 门锁上了。

en: The door seems to be locked.
zh: 这扇门似乎被反锁了。

en: The names of these products are unpronounceable.
zh: 这些药品的化学名称根本读不出来。

en: Have an aperitif at Sven's place
zh: 去斯文的宿舍喝一杯

en: Let's go! Sven is waiting for us in his room.
zh: 我们走吧！斯文正在房间里等着我们呢。

en:
We have to get a move on, Mei.
We're going to miss the drinks at Sven's!
zh:
我们要加快动作了，梅。
不然我们就赶不上斯文那儿的接风酒了！

en:
We have to get a move on, Corey.
We're going to miss the drinks at Sven's!
zh:
我们动作得快点，科里。
不然就赶不上斯文那儿的接风酒了！

en: Let's go! Sven is waiting for us in his room.
zh: 我们走吧！斯文正在房间里等着我们呢。

en:
This is freaking me out!
We'll have to go through the cemetary.
zh:
这地方真让我瘆得慌！
我们必须穿过这墓地。

en: We'll have to cut through the cemetary.
zh: 我们只能抄近路穿过墓地了。

en:
We'll have to look for something
to blow that up.
zh: 我们得找点能把这玩意儿炸开的东西。

en:
We need something to smash
these things that are in our way.
zh: 我们需要找点东西把挡在路上的这些障碍物砸开。

en: A weapon would be enough to force our way through!
zh: 有一把武器就足够强行闯过去了！

en: A weapon would be enough to force our way through!
zh: 有一把武器就足够强行闯过去了！

en: I need something to cure my hangover
zh: 我得找点东西来治治我的宿醉。

en: Find Mei.
zh: 寻找王梅

en: Mei is probably in her room. I have to find out if she's okay!
zh:
梅可能在她的房间里。
我必须确认她是否平安！

en: I'm coming, Mei. Your room is not that far.
zh:
我来了，梅。
你的房间离这儿不远了。

en: Enter the fraternity
zh: 进入兄弟会大楼

en:
We're not going to stay outside!
We have to find a way of getting in!
zh:
我们不能一直待在外面！
必须想办法混进去！

en:
We have to find a way of getting in if we want to
have a party!
zh: 要是想参加派对，我们必须想办法混进去！

en: There's no way we're staying outside! The party's inside!
zh: 我们绝对不能在外面干等着！派对在里面呢！

en:
We're not gonna be pushed around.
We have to get inside!
zh:
我们可不是好欺负的。
必须想办法混进去！

en: Find out more about these noises
zh: 查明这些怪声的来源

en:
These noises sound pretty suspicious.
Let's see what's going on!
zh:
这些声音听起来极其可疑。
我们去瞧瞧到底发生什么了！

en:
What are those noises?
We should go and see what's going on!
zh:
那是什么奇怪的声音？
我们应该过去看看是怎么回事！

en: Find a weapon
zh: 寻找一件武器

en: Kenny, we need a gun!
zh: 肯尼，我们手里需要有把枪防身！

en: She's right Amy. We should have a gun!
zh: 艾米说得对。我们手里必须得有把枪！

en: Go see the girl with the weapon.
zh: 去寻找那个带枪的女生

en:
Great Kenny, we've got something to defend ourselves with.
Let's go and see that girl.
zh:
太好了肯尼，我们有防身的家伙了。
走，去找那个女生。

en: Let's go and see that girl, Amy. We've got a weapon now.
zh: 艾米，我们有防身的武器了，去找那个女生吧。

en: Run away from the fraternity
zh: 逃离兄弟会大楼

en: I don't want to die in this place! We have to leave!
zh:
我可不想死在这个鬼地方！
我们必须得离开了！

en: We gotta get out of this dump!
zh: 我们必须得离开这个鬼地方了！

en:
This place freaks me out, Kenny!
We need to find a way to get out!
zh:
这鬼地方真让我脊背发凉，
肯尼！我们必须找条出路逃出去！

en: Amy! We gotta get out of here if we want to see old age!
zh: 艾米！如果还想活命的话，我们必须马上离开这儿！

en: Find the others
zh: 寻找其他人

en:
We can't stay here doing nothing.
Our friends are inside and we have to get them out!
zh:
我们不能坐在这儿无所事事。
我们的死党还在里面，必须救他们出来！

en: The others need us. We must find them!
zh:
其他人现在需要我们。
我们必须找到他们！

en:
If the others are inside, then they're certainly in trouble!
Can't you hack the entrance door?
zh:
如果其他人都在里面，那他们肯定有大麻烦了！
你不能破解大门上的电子锁吗？

en: Maybe I should try to hack the entrance door.
zh: 也许我应该尝试破解大门上的电子锁。

en: Find the others
zh: 寻找其他人

en: We have to find the others Mei; they're certainly in here!
zh:
我们必须找到其他人，梅，
他们肯定就 在这栋楼里！

en:
The others are somewhere around here Corey!
Let's find them!
zh:
其他人一定就在这附近的某个地方，科里！
我们快找到他们！

en: Our buddies are in there Mei and I wanna see them alive!
zh:
我们的兄弟都在里面，梅，
我一定要看到他们活着出来！

en:
The others won't be able to get out
by themselves Corey. They need us.
zh:
只靠他们自己是出不来的，科里。
他们需要我们的帮助。

en: Run away
zh: 逃跑

en:
We're not going to stay here for ever.
We have to go outside.
zh:
我们可不能一辈子被困在这儿。
我们必须到外面去。

en:
We're not going to stay here for ever.
We have to go outside.
zh:
我们可不能一辈子被困在这儿。
我们必须到外面去。

en:
We're not going to stay here for ever.
We have to go outside.
zh:
我们可不能一辈子被困在这儿。
我们必须到外面去。

en:
We're not going to stay here for ever.
We have to go outside.
zh:
我们可不能一辈子被困在这儿。
我们必须到外面去。

en:
Let's find the party hall we were in earlier.
The fire exit is there!
zh:
让我们找找我们刚才在的那个宴会厅。
紧急消防出口就在那儿！

en:
Let's find the party hall we were in earlier.
The fire exit is there!
zh:
让我们找找我们刚才在的那个宴会厅。
紧急消防出口就在那儿！

en:
Let's find the party hall we were in earlier.
The fire exit is there!
zh:
让我们找找我们刚才在的那个宴会厅。
紧急消防出口就在那儿！

en:
Let's find the party hall we were in earlier.
The fire exit is there!
zh:
让我们找找我们刚才在的那个宴会厅。
紧急消防出口就在那儿！

en:
Open the emergency door
of the party room.
zh: 打开宴会厅的紧急消防通道门

en: There must be some way to open this fire exit!
zh: 一定有招能把这个消防出口门弄开！

en: There must be some way to free this fire exit!
zh: 一定有办法可以清理打开这个消防出口！

en: There must be some way to free this fire exit!
zh: 一定有办法可以清理打开这个消防出口！

en: There must be some way to open this fire exit!
zh: 一定有招能把这个消防出口门弄开！

en: Find Corey's car
zh: 寻找科里的爱车

en: Hurry Corey! He can't have gone far!
zh: 快点，科里！那混蛋绝对跑不远的！

en: Let's not mess around! I want to recover my car!
zh: 别磨蹭了！我一定要把我的车给夺回来！

en: If we don't hurry, we're not likely to find your car, Corey!
zh:
如果我们不赶紧的话，
恐怕就再也找不回你的车了，科里！

en: Hurry up Amy! I can't leave my car in the hands of an idiot!
zh:
快点，艾米！
我绝对不能把我的爱车留给那个白痴随意糟蹋！

en: Retrieve the rifle near the car
zh: 拿回车子附近的猎枪

en:
We need to find your car Corey!
Didn't you say you had a shotgun in there?
zh:
科里，我们得先找到你的车！
你刚才不是说里面有一把老猎枪吗？

en: I need to get my shotgun Amy! It's in my car!
zh:
艾米，我必须拿回我的老猎枪！
它就在我的车里！

en: We need to recover your shotgun. It's still in your car!
zh:
我们必须把你的老猎枪找回来。
它还在你的车里放着呢！

en: Quick! I need to get my shotgun. It's still in my car!
zh:
快！我必须拿回我的老猎枪。
它还在我的车里！

en: Leave the forest
zh: 离开森林

en: This forest is horrible Corey! We must get back to town!
zh:
这片森林太可怕了，科里！
我们必须赶紧回镇上去！

en: It's too dangerous here, Amy. We need to leave this forest.
zh:
这儿太危险了，艾米。
我们必须得离开这片森林。

en:
I can't stand these trees any more!
I want to go back to civilization!
zh:
我再也无法忍受这堆烂树了！
我想回到文明社会去！

en: This forest must come to an end...

And we have to rescue Amy!

我们绝不能把科里丢在这种状态不管，斯坦！
而且我们还要去营救艾米！

en: Amy!!
zh: 艾米！！

en: It's time to grow up, Shannon!!
zh: 是时候长大了，夏侬！！

en: Shannon... Come into my arms so I can tear you apart...
zh: 夏侬…快到我怀里来，好让我把你撕成碎片…

en: Quick! Over here!
zh: 快！往这边走！

en: Check on the blonde, I wasn't too gentle with her...
zh: 去看看那个金发妞吧，我刚才对她可不算太温柔…

en:
What did you do to her, you bastard?!
Somebody please blow his head off!
zh:
你对她做了什么，你这个杂种？！
谁来一枪打烂他的脑袋！

en: I thought I taught you to respect women, Kenny.
zh: 肯尼，我原以为我教过你要尊重女性的。

en: Keep an eye on them!
zh: 给我盯紧他们！

en:
Never mind Shannon, I don't think
he understands... He never did.
zh:
算了，夏侬，我想他已经听不懂人话了…
他从来就没懂过。

en: Finally it looks like we're gonna have a little party!
zh: 终于，看来我们要开始狂欢派对啦！

en: Seize
zh: 抓取

en: I don't know how I did it but the lab door is open.
zh:
我也不知道自己是怎么搞的，
反正实验室的门已经被我弄开了。

en:
I've opened the Lab.
Even a blonde can use this thing.
zh:
我把实验室的门打开了。
这玩意儿连无脑金发妞都会用。

en: A staff pass. That should make things easier.
zh: 一张员工通行卡。这下子事情可就简单多了。

en: A staff pass. That should make things easier.
zh: 一张员工通行卡。这下子事情可就简单多了。

en: I don't want to die in bed... not like this anyway.
zh:
我可不想在病床上等死…至少绝对
不想以这种方式死掉。

en: Watch out!
zh: 小心！

en:
The girl that changed into that horrific monster
must have lain in this bed until she transformed.
zh:
那个变成了可怕怪物的女生，
在彻底变异之前肯定一直躺在这张床上。

en: Quick, hurry up!
zh: 快，动作快点！

en: Quick, hurry up!
zh: 快，动作快点！

en:
Going back would be the same as running away.
The others are counting on us.
zh:
回头走就相当于临阵脱逃。
其他人还在指望着我们呢。

en: No. I want to find Corey and Amy before we leave.
zh: 不。在离开之前，我必须先找到科里和艾米。

en: Mei's car.
zh: 梅的车。

en: My car.
zh: 我的车。

en: Hurry up!
zh: 动作快！

en: Hurry up!
zh: 动作快！

en: Wait for me!
zh: 等等我！

en: Wait for me!
zh: 等等我！

en:
There's still static! The whole county
is suffering from blackouts.
zh: 还是有很多杂音！看来整个县都在面临大停电。

en: Shannon! Where are you?!!
zh: 夏侬！你在哪儿？！！

en: Shannoooooonnnnn! Help me Shannon !
zh: 夏侬——！救救我，夏侬！

en: Shannon I need you!!!
zh: 夏侬，我需要你！！！

en: Are you forgetting your family, Shannon!?!
zh: 难道你要忘记你的家人吗，夏侬？！！

en: I'm part of the new generation little sister!
zh: 妹妹，我已经是新一代的先驱了！

en: It's time to grow up, Shannon!! Let me show you how!!!
zh: 是时候长大了，夏侬！！让我来亲手教你怎么做！！！

en:
Management does not allow video games to be installed on
hospital computers. That's too bad for the network admins.
zh:
医院管理层居然禁止在医院的电脑里安装电子游戏。
这对于网络管理员来说真是个悲剧。

en:
They are organizing a round-table discussion
for teenage mothers. What a cool idea!
zh:
他们正在为十几岁的年轻妈妈们举办一期圆桌讨论会。
主意倒是不错！

en:
According to the hospital doctors,
concerts make you deaf... Tsss...
zh:
根据医院医生的说法，听演唱会能让人耳聋…
真是扯淡…

en:
The hospital is running an anti-drug campaign.
My drug is beer. It's legal and it helps with flirting.
zh:
医院正在搞禁毒宣传。
我的‘毒品’只有啤酒，它既合法又能帮我泡妞。

en:
Some guy died because he spent
too much time playing video games?
zh: 居然有人会因为玩太久电子游戏而猝死？

en:
It seems that a new STD was found on campus...
I don't think they take it very seriously though.
zh:
看来校园里发现了一种新型性传播疾病…
不过我觉得他们对此并没有太当回事。

en:
It seems that teenagers have been copying some sort of
crazy stunt program from TV. A lot of them have come in here
with broken bones, second-degree burns and...euww!
To have plastic cars removed from their rectums? Gross man!
zh:
看来青少年们一直在模仿电视里的作死特技。
很多人因为骨折、二度烧伤被送进来…
呃，居然还要医生从他们的直肠里取出塑料小汽车？
真是太恶心了，老兄！

en:
5 hockey players from the Bears were operated on here.
I think I put most of 'em on that operating table.
zh:
这儿动过手术的‘熊队’冰球运动员里有五个
是我亲手打断骨头送上手术台的。

en:
Dead bodies. I have the feeling that I spend
more time with dead people than with the living.
zh:
冰冷的尸体。
我感觉我花在死人身上的时间比花在活人身上还要多。

en:
It's sad to see all these bodies. When a man dies,
it's like losing a potential lover.
zh:
看到这么多尸体真令人伤心。一个男人的死亡，
就意味着这个世界上又少了一个潜在的情人。

en: Better you than me, sorry guys.
zh:
兄弟们，早死早超生，
总比我也躺在这强，抱歉啦。

en:
As my ancestors would say:
they have gone to drink mead with the gods.
zh:
就像我的祖先会说的那样：
他们已经去和众神一起畅饮蜜酒了。

en:
X-rays. I have seen all of Corey's
X-rays. I know him inside out.
zh:
X光片。科里的所有X光片我都看过。
我对他的身体状况了如指掌。

en: X-rays... Peoples insides don't interest me that much.
zh:
X光片…
人体的内部构造可提不起我多大的兴趣。

en: Only minor fractures. I've had worse!
zh:
只是一些轻微的骨折。
我以前受过比这严重得多的伤！

en: X-rays. I've never broken anything. Norwegians are tough.
zh:
X光片。我可从没骨折过。
我们挪威人骨头硬着呢。

en: Shannoooooonnnnn! Help-meeeeee!
zh: 夏侬——！救救我——！

en: HELP ME!!!!!
It's only a dead body... only a dead body...
zh: 这只是一具冰冷的尸体…只是一具尸体罢了…

en: It's just cold meat. I'm more interested in the living.
zh:
不过是一堆凉透了的腐肉。
我还是对活人更感兴趣。

en: He had his time: shame it wasn't any longer.
zh:
他也算活过一回了。
只可惜没能活得更久些。

en: A body lies here, but his soul is in Valhalla.
zh:
一具尸体躺在这里，
但他的灵魂已经进入了英灵殿。

en: The way they swarm and flock: it gives me the creeps!
zh: 看它们成群结队蜂拥而上的样子，真让我瘆得慌！

en: Yuk! Just look at those things! So gross!
zh: 呸！快看看那些恶心的东西！真是倒胃口！

en: I can't stand this filth!!!
zh: 我可受不了这堆脏东西！！！

en: Whew! I thought I was going to join my ancestors!
zh: 呼！我还以为我要去见我的祖先了呢！

en: It's as clean as a whistle!
zh: 这儿干净得简直一尘不染！

en: Mmmm... All my blemishes show up under these lights!
zh:
嗯…在这些强光灯照射下，
我身上的所有瑕疵都暴露无遗了！

en: It's too clean in here. I don't feel comfortable.
zh: 这儿太干净了。让我觉得浑身不自在。

en:
Be careful... Even in this anti-septic
environment we're still vulnerable.
zh:
小心点…即使在这样无菌的环境里，
我们依然不是绝对安全的。

en:
This reinforced glass protects against
dangerous substances. You need a code.
zh:
这层防爆强化玻璃可以保护里面的危险化学试剂。
打开它需要输入密码。

en:
This reinforced glass protects against
dangerous substances. You need a code.
zh:
这层防爆强化玻璃可以保护里面的危险化学试剂。
打开它需要输入密码。

This reinforced glass protects against

打开它需要输入密码。

en:
This reinforced glass protects against
dangerous substances. You need a code.
zh:
这层防爆强化玻璃可以保护里面的危险化学试剂。
打开它需要输入密码。

en:
Come on little computer, show us what
you have in your memory.
zh:
加油，小电脑，
把你的内存里藏着的所有秘密都吐出来吧。

en: OK. We've got the recipe for nitroglycerine!
zh: 大功告成。我们拿到配制硝化甘油的配方了！

en:
Now, we just need to blow open the
newly constructed wall near the entrance!
zh: 现在，我们只需要去把入口旁新建的墙壁炸开就行了！

en: It's time to blow up the wall!
zh: 该把这堵墙炸掉了！

en: I can't wait to try out this fire-cracker!
zh: 我已经等不及要试试这个大炮仗了！

en:
It's time to test out our mixture on the
newly constructed wall near the entrance.
zh:
是时候去入口旁新建的墙壁那儿，
试试我们的混合炸药威力了。

en: SHANNOOOONNNN!!!
Quick! It's going to explode!
zh: 快！要爆炸了！

en: Watch out for the explosion!
zh: 小心爆炸！

en: Get out of the way, quickly!
zh: 快闪开，动作快！

en: Let's not hang around here!
zh: 我们别在这儿傻站着了！

en: Wow. It's really powerful!
zh: 哇。威力真够强劲的！

en: Hey, it burnt my hair!
zh: 嘿，它把我的头发都烤焦了！

en: I'm keeping the recipe, just in case...
zh: 我得把配方留着，以防万一…

en: Nice fireworks.
zh: 这烟花不错嘛。

en:
The storage area! The professor was right.
The ambulance parking lot can't be far away.
zh:
储物区！教授说得对。
救护车停车场肯定就在附近不远了。

en:
The storage area! The professor was right.
The ambulance parking lot can't be far away.
zh:
储物区！教授说得对。
救护车停车场肯定就在附近不远了。

en:
The storage area! The professor was right.
The ambulance parking lot can't be far away.
zh:
储物区！教授说得对。
救护车停车场肯定就在附近不远了。

en:
The storage area! The professor was right.
The ambulance parking lot can't be far away.
zh:
储物区！教授说得对。
救护车停车场肯定就在附近不远了。

en:
There's a door up there, but you'd practically
need to be a monkey to climb up to it!
zh:
上面有一扇门，
但恐怕得像猴子一样灵活才能爬得上去！

en:
There's a door up there, but you'd practically
need to be a monkey to climb up to it!
zh:
上面有一扇门，
但恐怕得像猴子一样灵活才能爬得上去！

en:
There's a door up there, but you'd practically
need to be a monkey to climb up to it!
zh:
上面有一扇门，
但恐怕得像猴子一样灵活才能爬得上去！

en:
I should be able to climb these shelves,
but I need to get up to the right height.
zh:
我应该能爬上这些货架，
但我得先垫到合适的高度。

en: These carts might help.
zh: 这些手推车可能帮得上忙。

en:
This reinforced glass protects dangerous substances.
A code is needed.
zh:
这层防爆强化玻璃可以保护里面的危险物质。
需要密码才能打开。

en: A Norwegian in an English car... That's messed up!
zh: 一个挪威人开英国车…这简直太滑稽了！

en: Come back. I'm closing the gate!
zh: 快回来。我要关大门了！

en: Come back. I'm closing the gate!
zh: 快回来。我要关大门了！

en: Hey! Don't forget I'm here!
zh: 嘿！别忘了我还在这儿呢！

en:
Hey Corey! Get me up!
There's no way I'm staying here on my own!
zh:
嘿科里！拉我一把！
我绝对不要一个人留在这里！

en: Corey!!! Don't leave me!
zh: 科里！！！别丢下我！

en: Friggin' switch! We're running out of time!
zh: 该死的开关！我们快没时间了！

en:
That thing is coming!
Now would be a good time to hurry!
zh:
那怪物追上来了！
现在赶紧逃命才是明智的选择！

en: No! There are too many of them! We have to find cover!
zh: 不！怪物太多了！我们得赶紧找掩护！

en:
The newly constructed wall near the entrance
is the only shortcut to the ambulances.
zh:
入口大厅旁新建的隔离墙，
是去往停放救护车区域唯一的捷径。

en: In a lab like this, I'd try a scientist's name.
zh:
在这种实验室里，
我通常会尝试用某个科学家的名字当密码。

en: In a lab like this, I'd try a scientist's name.
zh:
在这种实验室里，
我通常会尝试用某个科学家的名字当密码。

en: In a lab like this, I'd try a scientist's name.
zh:
在这种实验室里，
我通常会尝试用某个科学家的名字当密码。

en:
Hey Mei, just get the information from the
computer okay? No gaming or surfing the net!
zh:
嘿梅，在电脑上查查资料就行了，懂吗？
不许玩游戏，也不许上网冲浪！

en:
Hey Mei, just get the information from the
computer okay? No gaming or surfing the net!
zh:
嘿梅，在电脑上查查资料就行了，懂吗？
不许玩游戏，也不许上网冲浪！

en:
Hey Mei, just get the information from the
computer okay? No gaming or surfing the net!
zh:
嘿梅，在电脑上查查资料就行了，懂吗？
不许玩游戏，也不许上网冲浪！

en: Oh I'm sorry, do you want to give it a go then?
zh: 噢真抱歉，那要不换你来试试看？

en:
I can see Fallcreek lake... and a dilapidated bridge
crossing it... Did the others take this path?
zh:
我能看到秋溪湖…还有一座横跨其上的废弃大桥…
其他人也是走这条路的吗？

en:
I see a big river... may its waters one day flood the earth,
clean it of its filth and create a new Eden...
zh:
我看到了一条大河…愿它的河水有朝一日能淹没大地，
洗净世间的污秽，创造一个崭新的伊甸园…

en: Bad memories are behind this door.
zh: 这扇门的背后全都是些糟糕的回忆。

en: This door leads to a place of fratricide. I won't open it.
zh: 这扇门通往手足相残之地。我绝对不会打开它。

en: The door is closed solid.
zh: 大门被牢牢锁住了。

en: This vehicle saved our skin.
zh: 这辆车救了我们一命。

en: This van could have been our hearse.
zh: 这辆小货车差点就成了我们几个的灵车。

en: The van's wrecked. My boss is going to make me pay!
zh: 这辆小货车报废了。我老板肯定会要我赔钱的！

en: That van has made it's last trip.
zh: 那辆货车已经完成了它的最后一次行程。

en: A drawing with a high camp factor.
zh: 一幅极具荒诞坎普风的画。

en: A fresco. Fashionable 20 years ago.
zh: 一幅在二十年前挺流行的壁画。

en: A scene from another era...
zh: 一个来自另一个时代的画面…

en: A slightly idiotic drawing. It's not my style.
zh: 一幅有点滑稽的涂鸦。不是我的风格。

en: These cabinets control the power generated by the dam.
zh: 这些控制柜控制着大坝产生的电力。

en: Graffiti.
zh: 涂鸦。

en: It's completed dilapidated.
zh: 这里已经彻底破败不堪了。

en: The bridge is broken. It's no longer possible to cross here.
zh: 桥已经断了。现在不可能从这里通过了。

en: Moldy cardboard boxes.
zh: 发霉的纸箱。

en: The door is closed. The lock is strange.
zh: 门是关着的。锁非常奇怪。

en: The wall has so many holes it looks like Swiss cheese.
zh: 这面墙壁上满是窟窿，看起来就像一块瑞士奶酪。

en: An oil drum filled with waste oil.
zh: 一个装满了废润滑油的油桶。

en: Buttons and rust all around. It's useless now.
zh: 按钮都生锈坏掉了，现在已经没用了。

en: Hydraulic pressure indicator lights.
zh: 液压压力指示灯。

en: I can't climb that high.
zh: 我爬不了那么高。

en: I could climb up there easily!
zh: 我能轻而易举地爬上那儿！

en: This window overlooks a forest.
zh: 这扇窗户外面是一片森林。

en: A firmly closed locker.
zh: 一个紧锁着的储物柜。

en: An electrical cabinet.
zh: 一个配电箱。

en: It has collapsed. We can't get through.
zh: 已经坍塌了。我们无法通过。

en: Oil drums, nothing of interest
zh: 几个油桶，没什么特别的。

en:
The rungs are broken,
we can't take this ladder.
zh: 梯子的横档断了，我们没法爬这个梯子。

en: A control panel in a sorry state.
zh: 一台破烂不堪的控制面板。

en: A control console.
zh: 控制台。

en: The control panel.
zh: 控制面板。

en: This machine doesn't look as though it works.
zh: 这台机器看起来似乎无法运转了。

en: There are way too many buttons on this console.
zh: 这控制台上的按钮也实在太多了点。

en: An electrical cabinet. Better not touch it.
zh: 一个配电柜。最好别碰它。

en: There's no point in going back in.
zh: 没必要再折返回去了。

en:
Buttons and rust all around.
It's all useless now.
zh:
到处都是按钮和铁锈。
现在全废了。

zh: 使用

zh: 查看

zh: 乘船

zh: 特技攀爬

en: STRENGTH
zh: 蛮力

en: BLACK AURA
zh: 暗影黑雾

en: HACKING
zh: 黑客破解

en: DECRYPTING
zh: 破译密码

en: I can't believe that he chose to become... That thing.
zh: 我真不敢相信他居然选择变成了…那个怪物。

en:
You've just killed your brother, Shannon...
This nightmare is changing all of us...
zh:
你刚刚亲手杀死了你的哥哥，夏侬…
这场噩梦把我们所有人都改变了…

en: Forgive me...
zh: 原谅我…

en: Now you are going to know the meaning of regret.
zh: 今天，我让你好好尝尝什么叫追悔莫及。

en: Mei!!
Mei!!! NO!!! WHAT DID YOU DO?!!
zh: 梅！！！不！！！你对她做了什么？！！

en: I didn't do it on purpose.
zh: 我真的不是故意的。

en: Kenny, you've become a major jerk, man.
zh: 肯尼，看来你已经彻底变成了一个不可救药的杂碎。

en: The pain has gone... And I have opened my eyes.
zh: 身上的痛苦已经消失了…我已经彻底看清了世界。

en:
We are no longer family Shannon. The same blood
doesn't run through our veins anymore.
zh:
我们早就不再是一家人了，夏侬。
我们血管里流淌的已经不再是同一种血液了。

en: But now I'm going to have some fun.
zh: 不过接下来，我可要好好乐呵乐呵了。

en: Enough Kenny! Enough!
zh: 够了，肯尼！够了！

en: Reload
zh: 换弹

en: An electrical box. I don't need power for now.
zh: 一个配电箱。目前不需要电力。

en: It's not necessary. It's recharged...
zh: 不需要，已经充好电了…

en: It seems that I've drained it...
zh: 似乎电量已经被我用光了…

en: Recharge
zh: 充电

en: Two years of nightmares and traumas and then this...
zh: 两年的噩梦和心灵创伤，结果还是走到了这一步…

en: Help has arrived. Meet us at the parking lot!
zh: 救援已经到了。我们在停车场碰头！

en: Come on, it's time to go back...
zh: 走吧，是时候回去了…

en: Let's go, Sven is waiting for us.
zh: 我们走吧，斯文正等着我们呢。

en: Don't tell me you're tired!
zh: 别告诉我你累了！

en: Guys don't care about keeping things clean.
zh: 臭男生根本不爱干净。

en: Backed up again! This is too gross!
zh: 又被堵回去了！这真的太恶心了！

en: This piece of art is called "A Hymn to Alcohol".
zh: 这件艺术品的名字叫做‘对酒精的赞歌’。

en: They have rebuilt the pyramid!
zh: 他们居然把啤酒罐金字塔又给搭起来了！

en: Brainless... totally brainless...
zh: 没脑子…彻底没脑子…

en: Crap... what the hell am I doing here?
zh: 靠…我到底在这儿干什么呢？

en:
You're like all the others, Corey!
You can't be trusted... you are a bastard!
zh:
你和所有人一样，科里！
你根本不值得信任…你就是个狗东西！

en: NOOOOO!
My throat is dry...
zh: 我的喉咙干得冒烟…

en: That's much better!
zh: 这下舒服多了！

en:
The way to the exit is blocked.
I'd better find another way out so we can find Mei.
zh:
去出口的路被堵死了。
我最好另找一条路逃生，这样我们才能去找王梅。

en: There's no choice, I have to go that way.
zh: 没得选，我只能走这条路了。

en: Yeah, that's what I'm talking about!
zh: 是的，我说的就是这个！

en: I hope that Mei is OK... That nightmare was really horrible.
zh: 我希望梅没事…那个噩梦可真是太可怕了。

en: Okay... I'll be going then...
zh: 好吧…那我就进去了…

en: I'm going to kill that bastard ! He's blocked the door!
zh: 我要去宰了那个狗日的！他把大门给堵死了！

en: That bastard has blocked the door!
zh: 那个狗日的把大门给堵死了！

en: Have they opened up a club around here, or what?
zh: 这儿难不成是开了个夜店吗？

en: Fallcreek FM, the radio station for the deaf.
zh: 秋溪调频广播电台，专为聋子打造的电台。

en: Geronimooooo!
Oh... my... God!
zh: 我的…天啊！

en: I can't believe it!
zh: 我真不敢相信！

en: I lost my keys. Mei might have them, I had better go and see.
zh:
我的钥匙丢了。
梅身上可能有备用的，我最好去看看。

en: That's why I like living in a student dorm.
zh: 这就是我为什么喜欢住学生宿舍的原因。

en: Get outta of here or I'll call my boyfriend!
zh: 快滚开，不然我就叫我男朋友了！

en:
"Here lies Mei Wang, who only loved her sister because it
was like looking in a mirror". Not true! I love her as a person!
zh:
“这里躺着王梅，她之所以爱她的妹妹，
仅仅是因为这就像是在照镜子。”
才不是呢！我是真心把她当成独立的个体来爱的！

en:
"Here lies Corey Wilde, who lived in anger and died
because of it". Who wrote this crap? Huh? Who??
zh:
“这里躺着科里·怀尔德，他在
愤怒中度过余生，并因此而死。”
到底是哪个王八蛋写了这些垃圾
玩意？啊？到底是谁？？

en: No, it's not just a physical thing...really!
zh:
不，这不仅仅是一夜情…
我是认真的！

en: I can't remember: I was drunk.
zh: 我不记得了，我都喝麻了。

en: I have to go now, sorry...
zh: 我得走了，不好意思…

en: Wow, that is a really nasty tattoo Matt has on his arm.
zh: 哇，麦特手臂上的那个纹身可真是够难看的。

en: Mei... nooooooooooooooooo!!!
Mei...
zh: 梅…

en: What the hell is going on, I need an explanation.
zh: 这到底是怎么回事，我需要一个解释。

en:
Here we are... at the climax of things.
A new beginning... And you Corey...
zh:
我们终于到了…故事的高潮阶段。
一个崭新的开始…而你，科里…

en: ... like a brother. For you and I will be the same...
zh:
…就像兄弟那样。
因为你和我将会合二为一…

en:
Y'know what... Kenny ? There is only
one person I ever belonged to...
zh:
你听好了…肯尼？
这辈子，我心真正属于的人，只有一个…

en:
Even though I took everything you cared for
away from you, you will come to love me...
zh:
即使我夺走了你所珍视的一切，
你最后依然会爱上我的…

en: ... and it was Mei!
zh: …那就是梅！

en: COOOORREEEYYYY!!!!!!!
COOOORREEEYYYY!!!!!!!

Fallcreek lake... I had plans... to go on walks with her... to
share with her... I can't accept that she is dead...
zh:
秋溪湖…我曾经计划过…和她一起在这里散步…
和她分享一切…我真的无法接受她已经死了的事实…

en:
Water... If only I were a little drop of water...
...I wouldn't need to think... I wouldn't have to suffer...
zh:
水…如果我只是一滴小水滴该有多好…
那样我就不需要思考…也不需要承受痛苦了…

en: The dock leads to dark water.
zh: 码头通向漆黑一片的水面。

en: This reminds me of the television series "Dawney's Creek"!
zh: 这让我想起了电视剧《恋爱时代》！

en:
Like this house, the world is based on very fragile
certainties which could collapse at any time...
zh:
就像这栋房子一样，这个世界也是建立在
极其脆弱的安全感之上，
随时都可能会土崩瓦解…

en: An overturned boat.
zh: 一艘倾覆的小船。

en: Another death. How many victims can there be?
zh: 又死了一个。究竟还要出现多少受害者？

en: A fresh cadaver. A feeling of déjà vu.
zh: 一具刚死不久的尸体。有种似曾相识的既视感。

en: A summer party. This hasn't been used much.
zh: 举办夏日派对的地方，这里看起来很久没用过了。

en: So, we are on Turtle Stone island...
zh: 这么说，我们是在龟石岛上了…

en:
Pfff... "Turtke Stone"...
What a stupid name !
zh:
呸…
‘龟石岛’…怎么有这么傻的名字！

en: A boat falling apart - its hull covered with mold.
zh: 一艘破烂不堪的小木船——船壳上已经布满了霉菌。

en: A boat hanging, high up.
zh: 一艘高高悬挂着的小船。

en: The boat is starting to take in water. Too dangerous.
zh: 这艘船开始进水了。太危险了。

en: No need to go back to this lake.
zh: 没必要再返回这个湖了。

en: The boat will not support a second trip.
zh: 这艘船无法承受第二次往返航行了。

en: A fridge in filthy condition.
zh: 一个脏得要命的冰箱。

en: This door won't open.
zh: 这扇门打不开。

en: You can't see inside. It's too dark.
zh: 里面太黑了，什么也看不见。

en: What a terrible death!
zh: 死得好惨！

en:
"Here lies John Billups, the greatest
eel hunter the world has ever known."
zh:
“此处长眠着约翰·比卢普斯，
世间最伟大的捕鳗人。”

en: There must be some way to move this wall.
zh: 一定有什么办法能移动这面墙。

en: Open
zh: 打开

en: Look
zh: 查看

en: The circuit is broken. I need a new one
zh: 电路板烧坏了，我需要换一块新的。

en:
I've installed the new circuit.
It seems to work...
zh: 我已经装上了新的电路板，似乎起作用了…

en: I need a soldering iron to fix this...
zh: 我需要一把电烙铁来修复这个…

en:
It's starting to... make me lose...
my love of waterfalls... all this nonsense.
zh:
看着这堆烂事…
真的开始让我连对瀑布的喜爱也消耗殆尽了。

en: Will you help me up?
zh: 你能拉我一把上去吗？

en:
There's a broken plaque at the entrance
to the cemetery... Would you like to have a look?
zh:
墓地入口处有一块碎掉的石板…
你要不要过去看一眼？

en: These stone slabs seem to form a picture.
zh: 这些石板拼起来似乎能组成一幅画。

en: It think you need to look at it from a certain angle...
zh: 我觉得你得换个特定的角度去观察它…

en:
Did you see the cross over there?
There's a hole in the middle of it!
zh:
你看到那边的那个十字架了吗？
它的正中间有一个圆孔！

en: It worked!!
zh: 起作用了！！

en: They've sabotaged the bridge!
zh: 他们把桥给破坏了！

en: Oops! We hit something!
zh: 哎呀！我们撞到东西了！

en: You can join me now.
zh: 你现在可以过来和我汇合了。

en: Freshly cut logs... There must be people living here.
zh: 新砍下来的木头…这儿肯定住着人。

en: Invasive shrubbery.
zh: 野蛮生长的灌木。

en:
C'est le bordel, les chaises trainent n'importe comment...
Faudrait les virer ou les dégommer pour passer...
zh:
太乱了，椅子横七竖八地散落了一地…
必须把它们搬开或打碎才能过去…

en: An old and moldy class photo on the wall.
zh: 墙上挂着一张发霉的旧毕业合影。

en: Books about botany, encyclopedias...
zh: 都是关于植物学的书籍

en: This guy's portrait is a monument to depression.
zh: 这家伙的肖像画简直就是忧郁症的活化石。

en: A portrait. Hello, funeral face.
zh: 一幅肖像画。你好啊，苦瓜脸。

en: Portrait of Depression, 1920.
zh: 《忧郁症自画像，1920年》。

en:
A portrait. I may end up having
the same face tomorrow.
zh: 一幅肖像画，明天我说不定也是这张死人脸。

en: Meat rotting in the open air.
zh: 暴露在空气中腐烂发臭的生肉。

en:
The windows are so dirty
 it's hard to see through them.
zh: 窗户太脏了，根本看不清外面。

en: The cabinet is empty.
zh: 柜子是空的。

en: Forgotten wheel rims and trash..
zh: 被遗弃的轮毂和一堆垃圾。

en:
I look more and more sallow...
I really need to rest...
zh:
我的气色看起来越来越蜡黄病态了…
我真的需要好好休息一下了…

en:
It's hard to accept your image after prison... You have the
feeling that everyone knows and you always feel guilty...
zh:
坐过牢之后，真的很难面对镜子里的自己…
你总觉得每个人都知道你的过去，
而且你心里永远充斥着罪恶感…

en:
In an ideal world, I would live in a big tower drowned in storms
where all the mirrors on the walls would be  broken... just like my life...
zh:
在一个理想的世界里，我应该住在一座被
风暴淹没的巨塔中，
墙上所有的镜子都会被打碎…就像我的一生那样…

en:
A mirror... who am I, really? Am I a good person?
Are my parents proud of me?
zh:
镜子…我到底是谁？我算是个好人吗？
我父母会为我感到骄傲吗？

en: Nothing interesting there.
zh: 这儿没什么值得注意的。

en: We have to find a way of getting in.
zh: 我们必须得找到进屋的办法。

en:
Garbage cans dripping with blood.
The smell is unbearable.
zh:
流着鲜血的垃圾桶。
这味道真让人作呕。

en:
That must be the bed of the mad man.
It makes me shudder...
zh:
那肯定是那个疯子的床。
看得我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩…

en:
The canopy bed of the weirdo who
lives here. Pretty filthy.
zh:
住在这里的那个怪胎的带顶篷的床。
脏得不成样子。

en: A canopy bed; classy but rotten.
zh:
一张四柱带顶篷的床，
样式倒挺古典，可惜都烂透了。

en: This canopy bed smells of urine.
zh: 这张四柱床闻起来有一股尿骚味。

en: A playpen as old as the house.
zh: 跟这栋房子一样古老的婴儿围栏。

en: Old toys.
zh: 旧玩具。

en: A clown as pale and stiff as a cadaver.
zh: 一个脸色苍白、肢体僵硬得宛如死尸的小丑玩偶。

en:
African masks. They don't really
match the rest of the decor.
zh:
非洲面具。
跟屋里其他的装潢实在是不搭调。

en: Strange masks. They're anything but comforting.
zh:
奇怪的面具。
看得人心里发毛，毫无安全感可言。

en: Masks representing gods and demons.
zh: 供奉神灵和恶魔的面具。

en: African masks. They're not really my style.
zh: 非洲面具，完全不符合我的风格。

en: African masks that come from far away; like me.
zh:
漂洋过海运过来的非洲面具，
就像我一样。

en: A strange black flower.
zh: 一朵诡异的黑花。

en: Photos and darkroom equipment.
zh: 照片和暗房冲洗设备。

en: A mirror that has been violently broken.
zh: 镜子被暴力地砸碎了。

en:
Plants that are slightly twisted
but otherwise in good shape.
zh: 一些枝干有些扭曲、但生长还算良好的植物。

en: A sink used for handling plants.
zh: 一个用来处理植物的水槽。

en: Gardening and home-repair products.
zh: 一些园艺和房屋维修工具。

en: Shears and hedge clippers: a gardener's weapons
zh: 大剪刀和绿篱修剪机：园丁的武器。

en: The window is barricaded.
zh: 窗户被木条封死了。

en: Scientific books.
zh: 科学专业书籍。

en: A jerrycan... what's that doing here?
zh: 一个塑料油桶…这玩意儿怎么会在这？

en: Books about botany.
zh: 关于植物学的书籍。

en: An african statue.
zh: 一尊非洲木雕神像。

en: The wardrobe is empty.
zh: 衣柜里是空的。

en: Nothing useful on these shelves...
zh: 这些架子上没有一件派得上用场的东西…

en: An old portrait of a child with a deformed face.
zh: 一张面部畸形儿童的泛黄旧照片。

en: A crucifix, half rusted away.
zh: 一个锈蚀了一半的耶稣十字架。

en: I'm sure that Stan could pick that.
zh: 我敢肯定斯坦能把这把锁撬开。

en: I can pick it, it's easy.
zh: 我可以撬开它，小菜一碟。

en: I'm sure that Stan could pick that.
zh: 我敢肯定斯坦能把这把锁撬开。

en: I'll open that for you with my eyes closed.
zh: 我闭着眼都能把这玩意儿撬开。

en: You need to be a master locksmith to pick that.
zh: 得是一个开锁大师才能撬开这把锁。

en: That door is locked.
zh: 门是锁着的。

en: The control box is locked.
zh: 控制电箱锁上了。

en:
Wow... Pretty house.
Do you think there's people living here?
zh:
哇…挺漂亮的一栋房子。
你觉得这里会有人住吗？

en: It's a jungle in here.
zh: 这里简直就像个热带雨林。

en:
Hey... that's the flower we used!!
Whoever lives here is growing it!
zh:
嘿…那就是我们之前使用过的黑花！！！
住在这里的家伙居然在人工培育它！

en:
Hey... that's the flower we smelled!!!
Whoever lives here is growing it!
zh:
嘿…那就是我们之前闻过的黑花！！！
住在这里的家伙居然在人工培育它！

en: Cockroach invasion!
zh: 蟑螂大军入侵了！

en: It sounds as though the shouts are coming from below!
zh: 听声音，惨叫声像是从地下传出来的！

en:
This was where he got to Sven...
I hope we'll find him quick!
zh:
这里就是他袭击斯文的地方…
希望我们能快点找到他！

en:
The child in the photos is handicapped.
Some people have no luck in life.
zh:
照片里的这个孩子有残疾。
真是同人不同命啊。

en:
The child in the photos is handicapped.
Some people have no luck in life.
zh:
照片里的这个孩子有残疾。
真是同人不同命啊。

en:
The child in the photos is handicapped.
Some people have no luck in life.
zh:
照片里的这个孩子有残疾。
真是同人不同命啊。

en: That kid in the photos doesn't look normal.
zh: 照片里的那个小孩看着可不怎么正常。

en:
This guy is sick. And it's not
something that started recently!
zh:
这家伙病得不轻。
而且这毛病绝对不是最近才开始的！

en:
This guy is sick. And it's not
something that started recently!

这家伙病得不轻。
而且这毛病绝对不是最近才开始的！

这家伙病得不轻。
而且这毛病绝对不是最近才开始的！

en: A clown doll. I wouldn't sleep with that in my room.
zh:
一个小丑玩偶。
我可绝不敢把它放在卧室里陪我睡觉。

en: A clown doll. I wouldn't sleep with that in my room.

一个小丑玩偶。
我可绝不敢把它放在卧室里陪我睡觉。

zh:
一个小丑玩偶。
我可绝不敢把它放在卧室里陪我睡觉。

en: I think I am becoming allergic to all these plants!
zh: 我觉得我快要对这儿所有的植物过敏了！

en: The flowers make me want to throw up...
zh: 这些花闻得我直想吐…

en: These damn flowers again!
zh: 又见这该死的花！

en:
We've paid a huge price for
having sniffed this stupid flower.
zh:
闻了这朵愚蠢的花，
我们可是付出了惨痛的代价。

en:
His father?! With a son who looks like that,
what's he going to be like?
zh:
他的父亲？！生了个长成这样的儿子，
他当爹的能是什么好鸟？

His father?! With a son who looks like that,
what's he going to be like?
zh:
他的父亲？！生了个长成这样的儿子，
他当爹的能是什么好鸟？

His father?! With a son who looks like that,
what's he going to be like?
zh:
他的父亲？！生了个长成这样的儿子，
他当爹的能是什么好鸟？

en: It's Sven ! He's locked up down there!
zh: 那是斯文！他被关在下面了！

en: It's Sven ! He's locked up down there!
zh: 那是斯文！他被关在下面了！

zh: 那是斯文！他被关在下面了！

zh: 那是斯文！他被关在下面了！

en: A cross? Is our psychopath a believer?
zh:
十字架？难道我们遇到的人面兽心的变态杀人狂
还是个虔诚的信徒？

en: Weird. A cross in this crazy house.
zh:
真诡异。
这个疯子家里居然会挂着一个十字架。

en: This reminds me of that movie with the exorcism.
zh: 这让我想起了那部驱魔人的经典恐怖片。

en: Weird. A cross in this crazy house.
zh:
真诡异。
这个疯子家里居然会挂着一个十字架。

en: This freak seems to like photos... and children.
zh: 这个怪胎似乎很喜欢照片…还有小孩。

zh: 这个怪胎似乎很喜欢照片…还有小孩。

en: Oh! That's shocking! Poor kid!
zh: 噢！太触目惊心了！可怜的孩子！

en: Shannon!

旧的考试成绩单。

en: These roots seem dead... That's good news.
zh: 这些树根似乎死掉了…这算是个好消息。

这栋建筑结构看着不太稳固。
最好当心点。

en:
A toilet bowl bearing the traces of thousands
of buttocks that have sat on it.
zh: 一个承载了成千上万个屁股坐过痕迹的马桶圈。

zh: 一个普通的马桶，底部还有已经石化的排泄物。

zh: 马桶，我可绝不会坐在这肮脏的马桶圈上。

en: A computer cemetery.

An abandoned wheel barrow.
The high school is being demolished.
zh:
一辆被废弃的独轮手推车。
这所高中正在被拆除中。

zh: 这些花似乎是从树根底部长出来的。

zh: 一块写有拆迁公司名称的招牌。

en: The sign says the area is dangerous. I agree.
zh: 招牌上写着该区域危险，我深表赞同。

zh: 这个垃圾箱最多能装750公斤的建筑瓦砾。

of toilet paper, we know where to go.

各种尺寸的书籍。
如果哪天缺擦屁股纸了，我们知道该去哪找。

zh:
书本。人们写这些玩意儿就是为了
折磨那些偷懒的学生的。

zh: 这些显示器上的尘土分辨率挺高的。

zh: 专门为想要自杀的人准备的楼梯。

zh:
另一台起重机。
这些工人的活干得可真是隐秘。

zh: 架子上空出来的地方比摆的书还要多。

Books with illuminated illustrations.
These sure aren't paperbacks.
zh:
配有精美插图的书籍。
这绝对不是什么平装本。

Containers holding liquids
that are unlikely to be drinkable.
zh: 装有液体的容器，这液体怎么看都不太像能喝的样子。

en: A small collection of house plants.

zh: 显微镜对准了肉眼看不见的寄生微生物。

zh: 这个弹坑是由一次相当剧烈的爆炸造成的。

A poster showing a toxic lymphocyte
destroying a human cell.
zh: 一张展示致命的淋巴细胞正在摧毁人体细胞的海报。

en:
A beautiful piece of furniture that is
destined to end up as toothpicks.
zh:
一件精美的家具，
可惜注定要落得个被劈成牙签的下场。

en: Old ads offering trips abroad during spring break.
zh: 以前在春假期间提供出国旅游的老广告。

en:
"A train leaves the station at 4:00 pm...".
I've outgrown this stuff.
zh:
“一列火车于下午4:00驶离车站…”。
我已经过了做这种应用题的年纪了。

学生档案。
年纪轻轻，就已经在档案里记上一笔了…

en: A poster showing test tubes. Pedagogical decoration.
zh:
一张画有试管的海报。
纯属教学用的装饰品。

en: Senior-level text books. I recognize some of these.

高年级教科书。

en: These desks are covered with graffiti.

zh: 一个装满了工具、等待着被使用的工具箱。

These books will soon be leaving for
another shelter. Or to be burned.
zh:
这些书很快就要被运往另一个避难所。

赫伯特和莱纳德·弗里德曼兄弟：
“在探寻永生之门的途中，

利夫莫尔学校的遗物，以及一张维克森的照片，

zh:
《蠕虫之秘密》。
这书名看着可真让人心里发毛。

zh:
《曼陀罗之液》。
这怎么看都不像是本烹饪菜谱…

《元素的平衡》…
大概是一本强身健体的健身书吧。

zh:
《蔷薇十字的秘密》。
一个勾人探寻的书名。

zh: 一本名为《自然魔法哲学》的古书。

《迷信通论》。
这本书居然是1559年出版的！

"The Gnostic Mysteries", a book
written by an obscure alchemist.
zh:
《诺斯替秘仪》，
一个名不见经传的炼金术士写成的书。

"Major Codices of the Order of the Temple".
At least one thousand pages.

《圣殿骑士团大典》。
起码有一千多页。

This is one of the monsters that we fought

这是两年前我们在利夫莫尔学校打过的怪物之一。

Photos of the twins Herbert and Leonard Friedman

en:
"Leafmore private school was voted
to be closed for demolition yesterday"
declared our mayor, Mr. Hazelhof.

The high school, built in 1902 by
the brothers Leonard and Herbert Friedman,
apparently has serious water drainage problems.
A team of experts was sent to the site and found
that the basement of the school was flooded
and that there was some kind of parasite infestation.

Parents took the opportunity to bring up the case
of the unexplained disappearance of students
from the boarding school. "It is unacceptable
to ignore the pain of the parents in this way",
declared Mr. Craig, the father of one
of the victims, who thinks that "the cover-up
of this matter seems to be convenient for a lot
of people in high places" [...]

“利夫莫尔私立学校已于昨日经投票决定
关闭并予以拆除，”

这所由莱纳德与赫伯特·弗里德曼兄弟于
1902年建造的高中，
显然存在严重的排水问题。
一队专家被派往现场，发现学校地下室被淹，
并且存在某种寄生虫泛滥的情况。

家长们借此机会提起了该学校学生离奇失踪的事件。
“像这样无视家长们的痛苦是无法让人接受的，”
其中一名受害者的父亲克雷格先生声称，
他认为“对此事的蓄意隐瞒，
似乎迎合了许多高层人士的利益”…

en:
THE CODE OF HONOR
OF DELTA THETA GAMMA

The mission of the Delta Theta Gamma
fraternity is to offer future Science
graduates an experience of brotherhood,
mutual aid and absolute friendship. 

It also has the aim of transmitting
to students the noble values that
come from the three pillars of the
fraternity.

 "Knowledge and excellence in the
service of humanity."
zh:
德尔塔·西塔·伽马荣誉准则

德尔塔·西塔·伽马兄弟会的使命是，
向未来的科学毕业生提供兄弟般的情谊、
互助以及绝对的友谊。

它的宗旨还在于向学生传授源自
兄弟会三大支柱的高尚价值观念。

“以知识与卓越，服务于人类。”

en:
1st pillar : Knowledge

" When you open up a school,
you close down a prison."
Victor Hugo

Obscurantism imprisons Man,
knowledge frees him.

Our Brothers and Sisters must thirst for
knowledge. Their culture and their openness
will enlighten their choices and will guide
their steps.
zh:
第一支柱：知识

“当你打开一所学校的大门，
你就关闭了一所监狱的大门。”
——维克多·雨果

愚昧禁锢人类，知识解放人类。

我们的兄弟姐妹们必须对知识充满渴望。
他们的文化素养与开放心态将启发他们的选择，
并指引他们的脚步。

en:
2nd pillar : Excellence

"He who seeks perfection
obtains excellence."
Jori Cazilhac

Achievement of self is the key which will
allow you to overcome all obstacles.
Our Brothers must have tremendous will
to exceed their limits.

Perfection and excellence will
guide their steps.
zh:
第二支柱：卓越

“追求完美之人，终能获得卓越。”
——乔里·卡齐拉克

实现自我，是让你克服一切障碍的钥匙。
我们的兄弟必须拥有超越自身极限的强大意志。

完美与卓越将指引他们的脚步。

en:
3rd pillar: Philanthropy

"A life spent making mistakes is not only
more honorable but more useful than a life
spent doing nothing."
George Bernard Shaw

Humanity is the first of the virtues.
Our Brothers and Sisters must always
reflect on the consequences of their
actions and place humanity at the forefront
of their priorities.

Altruism and philanthropy will guide
their steps.
zh:
第三支柱：慈善

“一个充满错误的人生，
不仅比碌碌无为一生更光荣，也更有用。”
——乔治·萧伯纳

仁爱是诸般美德之首。
我们的兄弟姐妹必须时刻反思其行为的后果，
并将人性置于其首要考虑的地位。

利他主义与慈善将指引他们的脚步。

en:
Explosion of the Leafmore
high school gymnasium!

Yesterday, the Leafmore high school
gymnasium exploded for unknown reasons.
Three victims were seriously injured:
Stanley JONES,
Kenny and Shannon MATTHEWS.

The latter two were so traumatized that
they weren't able to speak. Two other
students were reported missing:
Josh CARTER and Ashley THOMPSON...
zh:
利夫莫尔高中体育馆发生大爆炸！

昨日，利夫莫尔高中体育馆因不明原因发生爆炸。
三名受害者重伤：
斯坦利·琼斯、
肯尼与夏侬·马修斯。

后两人因惊吓过度而失语。
另有两名学生被报告失踪：
乔什·卡特与艾什莉·汤普森…

en:
Leafmore High is unhealthy!

After investigating the origin of the
gymnasium explosion, the experts have
declared that basic safety conditions 
were not met: "
The cafeteria circuit breaker does not work,
the refectory is completely moldy...
it's a miracle that no student has been
fatally injured! "

This is very bad publicity for this
high school which now risks being
closed for health reasons...
zh:
利夫莫尔高中的卫生状况堪忧！

在对体育馆爆炸原因进行调查后，
专家宣布该校未能达到基本的安全标准：
“食堂断路器失灵，食堂完全发霉…没有学生
死亡简直是奇迹！”

这对于这所现在面临因卫生原因而被
关闭风险的高中来说，
无疑是非常糟糕的负面宣传…

en:

zh:

en:
