...Audit of the accounts of the
Delta Theta Gamma fraternity:

The financial picture is largely positive,
thanks to the  generous contributions
of our members working in  show-business,
the pharmaceutical industry, real estate
and the Senate... But our most generous
donor  remains our President.

...Everyone wished to defend the values
of our fraternity by doing whatever
is needed to cover up the Leafmore
incident.

This mission was successful thanks
to the work of our brothers who were
working as experts on the Safety
Committee...
zh:
…德尔塔·西塔·伽马兄弟会的账目审计：

多亏了我们在演艺界、制药业、房地产业以及
参议院工作的成员的慷慨赞助，财务状况非常乐观…
但我们最慷慨的捐助者依然是我们的会长。

…每个人都希望通过竭尽所能掩盖利夫莫尔事件，
来捍卫我们兄弟会的价值。

得益于我们在安全委员会担任专家的兄弟们的努力，
这项掩盖任务成功完成了…

en:
...in a purified form, Mortifilia stops the
aging of cells, which is tantamount to
giving eternal life... The problem
(already outlined in 1789 by our brother
Thomas MALTHUS) is the risk of
overpopulation with, as corollary,
a world-wide famine and the premature
extinction of our species...
zh:
…在净化形式下，死亡之花可以阻止细胞衰老，
这无异于赐予永生…问题
（已由我们的兄弟托马斯·马尔萨斯于1789年指出）
是人口过剩的风险，
其必然结果是全球性饥荒和我们物种的过早灭绝…

en:
The only variety of Mortifilia that
we have contains a major drawback:
the organs and tissues of the subject
literally melt under the sun.

To live eternally, the subject must also
eternally hide from the sun's light...
zh:
我们所拥有的死亡之花唯一品种存在一个重大缺陷：
受试者的器官和组织在阳光下会字面意义上地融化。

为了获得永生，
受试者也必须永远躲避阳光的照射…

en:
Absolute knowledge requires that a balance
be maintained between enlightened souls
and the ignorant masses.

The members of Delta Theta Gamma will
use this knowledge for the benefit of society.
Honor nature and reveal to Men gifts
they cannot see!

You, the spiritual elite of this world,
must sacrifice everything for the benefit
of Humanity, including, if necessary,
humans themselves.

You will thus guarantee the triumph
of reason over the ignorance of mankind. 

Medicus curat, natura sanat.
The doctor treats, but it is nature that heals.

Jared Crowly, Founding Father (1760-1852)
zh:
绝对的知识要求在开悟的灵魂与
愚昧的大众之间保持平衡。

德尔塔·西塔·伽马的成员将利用这些知识造福社会。
向自然致敬，并向人类展示他们看不见的恩赐！

你们，这个世界的精神精英，
必须为了人类的利益牺牲一切，
包括在必要时，牺牲人类自身。

你们将以此确保理性战胜人类的愚昧。

Medicus curat, natura sanat。
意思是“医生负责调理，大自然负责治愈。”

——杰拉德·克劳利，创始人（1760-1852）

en:
May 6, 1904. 103rd Traditional Ceremony
of the Assembly of Lodges; Paris, in the
basement of 51 rue de Montmorency. 

We thank each Head Lodge of our ninety-six
brother countries to have sent their Master
of Ceremonies on this occasion. 

On the occasion of this celebration,
the High Brothers have unanimously
voted to enscribe the recent works
of Leonard and Herbert Friedman
in the Fraternity's codices. 

Their discoveries concerning the possibility
of eternal life promise Delta Theta Gamma
a paramount place among the prominent
powers of this planet.
zh:
1904年5月6日。
第103届传统集会仪式在巴黎蒙莫朗西街
51号的地下室举行。

在此我们感谢来自96个友好国家的各分会
派出了他们的代表。

在此次庆典上，高阶兄弟们一致投票通过，
将莱纳德和赫伯特·弗里德曼最近的科学
成果载入兄弟会法典。

他们关于永生可能的发现，
将许诺德尔塔·西塔·伽马在地球的
各大顶峰势力中占据至高无上的地位。

en:
From William James, October 25, 1902.

Dear Leonard,
We can no longer deny that the incredible
plant you brought back from Africa slows
down the cellular aging process. In fact,
it stops it completely! We shall cure
humanity of its greatest affliction:
we will kill death itself!

We still need to refine the process so
that it will be compatible with the human
body. I understand the passion you put
into your quest, but as none of your
guinea pigs have survived to date,
it would be suicidal
to try it on yourself! [...]





From William James, May 8, 1903.

Dear Herbert,
We know that the noose is drawing tighter.
Using your students as guinea pigs was
the height of foolishness! Fortunately,
the complaints from the parents will
not have any consequences.

The fraternity has already called upon
highly placed former members in the government.
The case will soon be hushed.

Research must continue! We must save
your brother Leonard, and this project.
To this end, we will regularly send you
new test subjects through unofficial channels. [...]
zh:
来自威廉·詹姆斯，1902年10月25日。

亲爱的莱纳德：
事实已确凿无疑——
你从非洲带回的那株奇迹植物，
确实能延缓细胞衰老。
甚至，它能彻底阻止衰老！

我们将拯救人类最大的苦难：
彻底消灭死亡！

这项工艺仍需改良，
必须确保与人体完全相容。
我理解你对探索的狂热，
但至今还没有一个实验体能活下来。
拿你自己试药，无异于自杀！[...]



来自威廉·詹姆斯，1903年5月8日。

亲爱的赫伯特：
我们知道，形势正愈发紧迫。
拿你们自己的学生当活体实验，
简直是蠢透了！
好在家长的抗议不会掀起任何波澜。

兄弟会已调动政府高层的人脉，
这起事件很快就会被压下去。

研究绝不能停！
我们不仅要保住这个项目，
更要救你的兄弟莱纳德。
为此，我们将通过秘密渠道，
定期为你输送新的实验体。[...]
